confirmed_broken.title: Inline status/priority edits revert on screen after any parent re-render
confirmed_broken.evidence: useEffect(() => { setRows(table.rows); }, [table]);  — `table` is rebuilt as a new object literal on every render of the parent (AllClientsNoticesPage.tsx:182 `const table: ReportTable = {…}` with no useMemo) and the parent's `records` state is never updated by patchRow/applyBulkStatus (lines 391-398, 438-443), so the next parent render (switching Types Of Notices via setParams at :149-153, or the tab toggle at :115-119) resets `rows` to the stale pre-edit values.
confirmed_broken.why_it_matters: Reproduction: on /notices-all mark a row Closed (toast says 'Status updated'), then change the Types Of Notices dropdown — the row shows Open again. The DB has 'Closed', so staff either re-do the edit or distrust the page; the KPI tiles on the dashboard also don't reflect the change until a full reload.
confirmed_broken.proposed_fix: Wrap `table` in useMemo keyed on `filtered`, and pass an `onRowPatched(rowId, patch)` callback up so AllClientsNoticesPage updates `records` (or simply call fetchAll after a successful write). Same for the per-client report path that feeds this view.

reasons: CONFIRM: NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx:210 `useEffect(() => { setRows(table.rows); }, [table]);`. In AllClientsNoticesPage.tsx:182 `const table: ReportTable = {…}` is a fresh object literal every render (not memoized), and handleStatusChange/applyBulkStatus/saveEdit (NoticeWorkflowListView :400-407, :438-450, :496-520) only call patchRow/setRows locally — the parent's `records` state is never updated. Any parent re-render (setParams from the Types dropdown at :149-153 or tab toggle at :115-119) rebuilds `table` from stale `filtered` and the effect resets rows to pre-edit values.

CONFIRM: Confirmed for the /notices-all path. NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx:210 `useEffect(() => { setRows(table.rows); }, [table]);` and AllClientsNoticesPage.tsx:182 `const table: ReportTable = {` is a plain object literal rebuilt on every render (no useMemo). handleStatusChange/applyBulkStatus/saveEdit (:404-411, :438-449, :496-524) only patch the child's local `rows`; `records` in the parent is never updated. Any parent state change — setParams from the Types Of Notices select (:149-153) or tab toggle (:115-119) — re-renders the parent, creates a new `table`, and the effect resets rows to the stale pre-edit values even though the DB holds the new value. The per-client path via ReportPreviewDialog.tsx:55 receives a `table` held in dialog state, so it is likely stable there; the finding's 'same for the per-client report path' is unverified. Fix (useMemo on filtered + onRowPatched callback or refetch) is sound.

confirmed_broken.title: All dashboard queries ignore Supabase errors; a failed query renders as an empty firm
confirmed_broken.evidence: const [refundRes, drc03Res] = await Promise.all([ supabase.from('gst_refund_applications').select('arn, status'), supabase.from('gst_drc03_filings').select('arn, status') ]); … setRefundRows((refundRes.data || []) as StatusRow[])  — `error` is never read here, nor at lines 106-108, 177-182, 190-195; fetchAllRows (src/lib/fetchAllRows.ts:22) breaks on error and returns []. Line 553-554 then shows 'No notices on record yet.'

confirmed_broken.proposed_fix: Capture `error` from each call, toast.error with the message, keep a `loadError` state that renders an inline 'Could not load notices — Retry' panel instead of the empty-state copy.

reasons: CONFIRM: NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:162-168 destructures only `.data` from the refund/DRC-03 queries; :106-108, :177-182, :190-195 likewise ignore `error`; fetchAllRows.ts:22 `if (error || !data) break;` returns [] on a first-page error. :553-554 then renders 'No notices on record yet.' with no toast or retry. A failed query is indistinguishable from an empty firm.

CONFIRM: Confirmed. NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:162-168 destructures only `.data` from the refund/drc03 queries, :106-108, :177-182 and :190-195 likewise; fetchAllRows.ts:22 `if (error || !data) break;` returns [] on error. confirmed_broken.title: Hooks are called after a conditional early return in three Notices pages
confirmed_broken.evidence: if (!isStaffRole()) return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />;  followed by useMemo at lines 145 and 151, useEffect at 167 and useMemo at 246. Same pattern in AllClientsNoticesPage.tsx:147 (before useMemo at 160 and 211) and CompanyProfilePage.tsx:206 (before useMemo at 247).
confirmed_broken.why_it_matters: If isStaffRole() ever changes while the page is mounted (permission snapshot refresh via get_user_snapshot changing the role, or AuthContext setUser(null) at AuthContext.tsx:462 rendering before MainLayout swaps to <Navigate> at MainLayout.tsx:30), React throws 'Rendered fewer hooks than expected' and the page goes blank. It also fails the repo's ESLint rules-of-hooks check.
confirmed_broken.proposed_fix: Move the `if (!isStaffRole()) return <Navigate …/>` below all hook calls (or wrap the page body in a child component rendered only for staff).

reasons: CONFIRM: Confirmed hook ordering: CompanyListPage.tsx:142 `if (!isStaffRole()) return <Navigate …/>` precedes useMemo at 145/151, useEffect at 167, useMemo at 246; CompanyProfilePage.tsx:206 precedes useMemo at 247; AllClientsNoticesPage.tsx:147 precedes useMemo at 160 and 211. eslint.config.js spreads reactHooks.configs.recommended.rules, which includes rules-of-hooks as an error, so `npm run lint` flags these. The stated runtime trigger is weaker than claimed: on logout MainLayout.tsx:29-31 swaps to <Navigate> and unmounts the page rather than re-rendering it, so only an in-place role change (snapshot refresh) would actually throw. Real but low-probability; severity low stands.

The causal link to Open=1060/Total=1060 is inference, but it is consistent with src/pages/AllClientsNoticesPage.tsx:166 ('most rows have staff_status = null'). Not refuted; critical is justified: irrecoverable loss of staff data on every Sync All.

CONFIRM: Confirmed. extension/background.js:102-105 `replaceNotices` does `del('gst_notices', client_id=eq.X)` then a plain POST; the rows built in extension/content.js:2532-2537 (get/notices) and :2609-2613 (case/task) contain only client_id, source, reference_number, notice_type, description, issue_date, due_date, status, issued_by, case_id, pdf_url — none of the eight staff columns from 20260824100700 / 20260824104900 (staff_status, priority, reply_*, order_*, submission_*, amount_of_demand, remarks, assign_to, financial_year, extended_due_date). No read-before-write exists anywhere in extension/ (grep for staff_status/assign_to returns only background.js:103-104). AddNoticeDialog.tsx:73-85 inserts with `source: 'notices'` and no origin marker, so manual notices are deleted by the same query. Worse, the failure paths at content.js:195, 2471 and 2744 call replaceNotices with a single sentinel row, so a mere API/DB failure also wipes the client's real rows. Realistic-data caveat: whether the 1060/1060 Open=Total figure is *caused* by wipes or by staff never having set statuses cannot be proven from code (AllClientsNoticesPage.tsx:166 notes 'most rows have staff_status = null'), but the destruction occurs on every sync regardless. FIX IS UNSOUND AS WRITTEN: (1) PostgREST `on_conflict=client_id,source,reference_number` compiles to `ON CONFLICT (client_id,source,reference_number)` with no WHERE predicate, and Postgres cannot infer a PARTIAL unique index for that arbiter — the upsert would 400 with 'no unique or exclusion constraint matching the ON CONFLICT specification'. (2) Rows whose reference_number is NULL (case/task rows with no refId — content.js:2606 `refId = t.refId || null`) never conflict, so they would accumulate duplicates every sync. (3) `reference_number=not.in.(…1000 refs…)` in a GET/PATCH URL risks URL-length limits. Stop writing sentinel rows (finding 2) so a failed pull never touches the table. gst_refund_applications/gst_drc03_filings have no staff-edited columns today (only extension-patched `documents`/pdf_url), so they can stay delete-then-insert for now; gst_case_folder_items is portal-only and scoped per case, so its delete-then-insert is fine.

CONFIRM: Confirmed. supabase/migrations/20260817180000_notices_refund_drc03.sql declares only idx_*_client (lines 27, 44, 62) and no UNIQUE; no later migration adds one (grep of supabase/migrations for gst_notices/gst_refund_applications/gst_drc03_filings shows only ALTER ... ADD COLUMN). CONFIRM: Confirmed. clients has policy 'Anyone can view clients for development' FOR SELECT USING (true) (supabase/migrations/20260103121605:8-11) with no later restriction, and the anon key is compiled into the Vite bundle; gst_password is a plain text column (types.ts:3527) selected verbatim by extension/background.js:63-64, by the web app (ClientsPage, EditClientPage, GSTPortalLink, allClientsReports) and by agent/src/supabase.ts:99 / login.ts:50. confirmed_broken.title: Every Sync All wipes staff workflow state on gst_notices (delete-then-insert), so no alert can ever be based on Open/Closed/assignee/reply state
confirmed_broken.evidence: background.js:102-105 `replaceNotices: async (clientId, rows) => { await del('gst_notices', `client_id=eq.${clientId}`); return rows.length ? post('gst_notices', rows) : true; }`; the row built in extension/content.js:2532-2537 carries only portal fields (`client_id, source, reference_number, notice_type, description, issue_date, due_date, status, issued_by, case_id, pdf_url`) — a grep for `staff_status`, `priority`, `assign_to`, `reply_date` in content.js returns nothing, so the 15 staff-edited columns added in 20260824100700/20260824104900/20260825120000 are dropped on every re-pull. The live screenshot confirms it: Open Notices 1060 = Total Notices 1060 and the Replied column is all dashes; and `Last 24 Hours` (NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:254 `daysAgo(r.pulled_at) <= 1`) shows 64 because every re-inserted row gets a fresh pulled_at.
confirmed_broken.why_it_matters: Staff mark a notice Closed / High priority / assigned to X, the next Sync All silently erases it. Beyond the data loss, this makes any state-based alerting (due ladder that stops when Closed, assignment emails, status-change events, 'new notice' detection by INSERT trigger) impossible — an INSERT trigger would fire for all ~1060 rows on every sync and email the team a thousand times.
confirmed_broken.proposed_fix: Migration: `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_gst_notices_client_ref ON gst_notices(client_id, reference_number) WHERE reference_number IS NOT NULL` and `ADD COLUMN first_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()`. Change `replaceNotices` to `post('gst_notices?on_conflict=client_id,reference_number', rows, 'resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal')` (the exact pattern already used for filing_status at background.js:65) and have the extension send only portal columns so PostgREST's merge leaves staff columns untouched; rows without a reference_number (LUT/case-task rows) get a synthetic `reference_number = case_id || arn`. Then a BEFORE UPDATE trigger keeps `first_seen_at` and staff columns when the incoming row is a portal refresh. Remove the delete; add an optional `pulled_at` refresh only.

reasons: CONFIRM: Traced end to end and the finding holds literally. extension/background.js:102-105 `replaceNotices` does `del('gst_notices', 'client_id=eq.'+clientId)` followed by a plain `post('gst_notices', rows)` with no on_conflict/merge (contrast the filing_status upsert at line 65 which uses `on_conflict=...&resolution=merge-duplicates`). The row built in extension/content.js:2532-2537 carries only `client_id, source, reference_number, notice_type, description, issue_date, due_date, status, issued_by, case_id, pdf_url`; grep for staff_status/priority/assign_to/reply_date across background.js, content.js, inject.js, db.js returns nothing except an unrelated `priority: 1` at background.js:31. No DB trigger exists on gst_notices (grep of all seven gst_notices migrations shows no TRIGGER; only `idx_gst_notices_client` at 20260817180000:27, no unique index on (client_id, reference_number)). No app-side snapshot/merge of staff columns exists in src/ (grep for preserve/merge/snapshot around staff_status/assign_to returns nothing; AllClientsNoticesPage, NoticeSummaryReportPage, CompanyListPage just read the table). So the 15 staff-editable columns added in 20260824100700 (staff_status, priority, reply_ref_number, reply_date, order_number, order_date, submission_arn, submission_date), 20260824104900 (extended_due_date, amount_of_demand, remarks, financial_year, assign_to) and 20260825120000 (priority tier) are wiped on every Sync All. The `Last 24 Hours` claim is also correct: `pulled_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()` (20260817180000:22), the extension never sets it, and NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:254 counts `daysAgo(r.pulled_at) <= 1`, so every re-inserted row counts as new. Additional corroboration not in the original finding: the delete is by client_id only (no source filter), so notices entered manually via AddNoticeDialog.tsx:73-75 (`insert({... source: 'notices' ...})`) are also deleted on the next sync, and the PULL FAILED diagnostic paths at content.js:195/2471/2744 call the same replaceNotices and thus wipe the whole client's notice history plus staff state on a failed pull. The only soft spot is the inference that 'Open 1060 = Total 1060' on the screenshot proves the wipe (it could equally mean staff never set a status), but the code-path itself is unambiguous.

CONFIRM: Confirmed from code. extension/background.js:102-105 `replaceNotices` does `del('gst_notices', 'client_id=eq.'+clientId)` then `post('gst_notices', rows)` with no `source` filter and no upsert. The row shape built in extension/content.js:2532-2537 (and the task-row shape at 2610-2613) carries only `client_id, source, reference_number, notice_type, description, issue_date, due_date, status, issued_by, case_id, pdf_url`; a grep of extension/ for `staff_status|assign_to|reply_date|priority` returns nothing (the only `priority` hit is the declarativeNetRequest rule at background.js:31). No migration defines any trigger on gst_notices (grep TRIGGER + notice = 0 hits), so nothing restores state. The staff-edited columns are written only by id in src/components/reports/views/NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx:404/435/455/496, and each sync issues fresh ids, so even a cached id would be dangling. Two aggravations the finding under-states: (1) src/components/notices/AddNoticeDialog.tsx:73-86 inserts manually added notices with `source: 'notices'` and an uploaded `pdf_url` — the unfiltered per-client DELETE wipes those too; (2) the exact same failure-path (`content.js:195, 2471, 2744`) replaces a client's whole notice list with a single 'PULL FAILED' diagnostic row, so a failed sync erases every real notice and its staff state for that client. Minor exaggeration: 13 columns are staff-only (case_id and issued_by are portal-captured per 20260824104900), not 15. The screenshot inference (Open=Total, Replied all dashes, Last 24 Hours 64 from `daysAgo(r.pulled_at) <= 1` at NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:254) is consistent but not proof by itself — the code path is proof enough. Data loss on every routine sync of a litigation tracker is correctly critical.

FIX SOUNDNESS — the proposed fix has a blocking flaw: a PARTIAL unique index (`... WHERE reference_number IS NOT NULL`) cannot be used by PostgREST's `on_conflict=` because PostgREST emits `ON CONFLICT (client_id, reference_number) DO UPDATE` without the index predicate, and Postgres refuses to infer a partial index without a matching WHERE clause ('no unique or exclusion constraint matching the ON CONFLICT specification'). Use a plain `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_gst_notices_client_ref ON gst_notices(client_id, reference_number)` (NULLs are distinct, so NULL-ref rows simply never conflict) and give every extension row a non-null key: `reference_number = noticeOrderId || refId || case_id || (docId-based synthetic)`. Other corrections: (a) with `resolution=merge-duplicates` PostgREST only SETs columns present in the payload, so no BEFORE UPDATE trigger is needed to protect staff columns and `created_at` already serves as first_seen_at once DELETE is gone — but the extension must OMIT `pdf_url`/`status`/`case_id` keys when they are null (today it sends `pdf_url: null` on every failed PDF capture, content.js:2537, which would clobber a previously captured PDF), and must send `pulled_at: new Date().toISOString()` explicitly because column defaults do not apply on the UPDATE arm; (b) the 'PULL FAILED' sentinel rows (content.js:195/2471/2744) must move to `client_sync_log` (already exists, 20260828100000) instead of being written as gst_notices rows, otherwise they accumulate as NULL-ref rows on every failure; (c) rows that disappear from the portal will no longer be removed — add `last_seen_at timestamptz` updated by each sync and hide/flag rows whose last_seen_at < latest sync for that client, rather than reintroducing DELETE; (d) AddNoticeDialog rows should get `source: 'manual'` (or the sync should never touch them) so manual notices survive regardless.

confirmed_broken.title: email_outbox schema physically blocks team alerts: kind CHECK, client_id NOT NULL, single to_email, template_key FK, no dedupe key
confirmed_broken.evidence: Lines 43-61: `client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.clients(id)`, `to_email text NOT NULL`, `kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('reminder','confirmation'))`, `template_key text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.email_templates(key)`, `return_type public.return_type`; the only idempotency guard is lines 65-67 `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_email_outbox_confirmation ON email_outbox(client_id, return_type, period_month) WHERE kind = 'confirmation'`. reasons: CONFIRM: Substance confirmed; one evidence detail is stale. The email_outbox columns are exactly as quoted at supabase/migrations/20260725120000_gst_reminders.sql:43-61: `client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`, `to_email text NOT NULL`, `template_key text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.email_templates(key)`, and the only unique/dedupe index is `uq_email_outbox_confirmation ... WHERE kind = 'confirmation'` (lines 65-67). No later migration relaxes client_id (the only `ALTER COLUMN client_id DROP NOT NULL` in the repo is on gst_update_versions, 20260209101945), adds cc/bcc/attachments/dedupe_key, or adds any notice-related kind. Correction: the kind CHECK is no longer `('reminder','confirmation')` — it has been widened three times by the builder migrations and currently reads `CHECK (kind IN ('reminder','confirmation','builder_setup','builder_fsi','builder_cancellation','builder_agreement_confirm'))` (20260811160000_builder_bu_agreement_confirm.sql:133-135, same list on email_templates at :130-132). That does not change the conclusion: there is still no notice/team/digest kind, so an INSERT with kind='notice_alert' or NULL client_id is rejected. Reminder dedupe is done only application-side in queue-gst-reminders/index.ts:284-286 (a SELECT on client/return/period/kind before insert), not by a DB key, so the 'no dedupe key' point stands. No notice email exists anywhere today (grep for 'notice' in gstReminders.ts, taskReminders.ts, both edge functions returns nothing; the `kind: 'notice'` hits in CompanyProfilePage.tsx:158/176 are a local timeline discriminator, unrelated to email_outbox). CONFIRM: The substance holds but the evidence is stale and the category/severity are overstated. Confirmed today: `client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.clients(id)` (20260725120000:45) has never been relaxed (no later ALTER touches it); `to_email text NOT NULL` single address and supabase/functions/send-gst-email/index.ts:50-56 builds `toRecipients: [{ emailAddress: { address: to } }]` only — no CC/BCC, and the file header says 'No attachments'; `template_key text NOT NULL REFERENCES email_templates(key)` unchanged; the only unique index is uq_email_outbox_confirmation. STALE: the kind CHECK quoted (`kind IN ('reminder','confirmation')`) was replaced three times — the live definition is supabase/migrations/20260811160000_builder_bu_agreement_confirm.sql:134-136 `CHECK (kind IN ('reminder','confirmation','builder_setup','builder_fsi','builder_cancellation','builder_agreement_confirm'))` — still no notice kind, so the conclusion is unchanged. OVERSTATED: nothing is 'broken today' — no code inserts notice alerts, so this is category (b) MISSING prerequisite, not a defect; and the 'double-email on re-run' claim is hypothetical, since the existing reminder ladder dedupes in code (queue-gst-reminders/index.ts:283-286 queries email_outbox for an existing kind='reminder' row before inserting). FIX SOUNDNESS — the proposed migration would BREAK the builder module: its replacement `email_outbox_kind_check` list omits 'builder_setup','builder_fsi','builder_cancellation','builder_agreement_confirm'. `ADD CONSTRAINT ... CHECK` validates existing rows, so the migration fails if any builder email has ever been queued, and if none has, every future builder FSI/cancellation/agreement email insert is rejected. The corrected CHECK must be a superset of the live 20260811160000 list. Also required but not mentioned: send-gst-email must be extended to read `cc_emails/bcc_emails/attachments` and add `ccRecipients/bccRecipients/attachments` to the Graph payload (schema columns alone are inert), and `_shared/email.ts:25` falls back to `SHELL.reminder_1` styling for any unknown template key, so notice templates need their own SHELL entries or every team alert renders as a 'Reminder 1' client email. The 'channel whatsapp/sms' column is speculative scope with no sender behind it; drop it from the prerequisite migration.

A nullable `portal_missing_since timestamptz` set by a follow-up PATCH for refs absent from the latest pull is a reasonable soft-delete, and the failure paths should only write to client_sync_log.

confirmed_broken.title: Plaintext GST portal passwords are copied into chrome.storage.local for every queued client
confirmed_broken.evidence: clients: withCreds.map((c) => ({ clientId: c.id, creds: { user: c.gst_user_id, pass: c.gst_password, name: c.name, gstin: c.gstin, ... } })) ... await chrome.storage.local.set({ gstk_active_job: job });  -- the full credential list of every client stays in extension storage until the job is cleared (or forever if the 20-minute guard never runs because no portal page is loaded).
confirmed_broken.why_it_matters: Any staff PC running Sync All holds every client's portal password in unencrypted local extension storage; a stolen laptop or a malicious extension with storage access exposes all 92 GSTIN logins at once.
confirmed_broken.proposed_fix: Store only clientIds in the job and fetch the current client's credentials on demand in handleLogin via GSTKdb.getClient (already exists at background.js:63); clear creds from storage after login; also clear gstk_active_job from background.js on tab close (chrome.tabs.onRemoved for job.tabId).

reasons: CONFIRM: Confirmed. background.js:405-417 startAllClientsSectionPull builds `clients: withCreds.map((c) => ({ clientId: c.id, creds: { user: c.gst_user_id, pass: c.gst_password, name: c.name, gstin: c.gstin, ... } }))` for every credentialed client and persists it with `chrome.storage.local.set({ gstk_active_job: job })` (line 417); every other start* function (276, 292, 314, 331, 347, 375, 433, 458, 499, 529, 602) and popup.js:63-69 do the same. content.js reads cur.creds.pass at 482 and never strips creds from the job (grep for `delete cur.creds` / `creds = null` is empty). The job is removed only by clearJob() at job end/cancel, the popup Stop button (popup.js:75), or the 20-minute guard at content.js:148 — which only runs when a gst.gov.in page loads; there is no chrome.tabs.onRemoved handler in background.js. Note the passwords are already stored in plaintext in the clients table and fetched with the anon key, so the extension storage copy is an additional exposure surface rather than the root of it; low severity as claimed is right.

CONFIRM: Confirmed mechanism: background.js:410-413 puts `pass: c.gst_password` for every credentialed client into the job and :417 `await chrome.storage.local.set({ gstk_active_job: job })`; content.js reads it per client and nothing strips creds after login (no onRemoved/cleanup in background.js — grep shows only the storage.set sites). However the impact is overstated: chrome.storage.local is isolated per extension, so 'a malicious extension with storage access' cannot read it; and the same PC already holds the app's localStorage session plus the anon key, which can read clients.gst_password in plaintext directly (background.js:63-64 `getClients: () => sel('clients?select=...,gst_password,...')`), so the extension storage copy is incremental exposure, not a new class. The root problem is plaintext gst_password in the clients table readable by the anon key under open RLS. Fix as proposed (fetch creds per client in handleLogin, keep name/gstin in the job since handleNotices/handleRefunds use cur.creds.gstin, clear job on tab close) is sound but secondary to moving credential reads behind a service-role edge function.

confirmed_broken.title: Every Sync All wipes all staff workflow data on gst_notices (status, priority, assignee, reply/order/submission, remarks)
confirmed_broken.evidence: replaceNotices: async (clientId, rows) => { await del('gst_notices', `client_id=eq.${clientId}`); return rows.length ? post('gst_notices', rows) : true; } — and the rows content.js builds (extension/content.js:2532-2536) contain only client_id, source, reference_number, notice_type, description, issue_date, due_date, status, issued_by, case_id, pdf_url; grep for staff_status/priority/assign_to/reply_ref in extension/ returns nothing.
confirmed_broken.why_it_matters: Anything staff mark on a notice (Closed, High priority, assigned to X, reply filed on date Y, remarks) is deleted the next time anyone presses Sync All or Sync on Company List. This is why the live dashboard shows Open = Total = 1060 and Replied all dashes: the workflow layer cannot survive a sync, so nobody's work sticks and the firm cannot trust any status in the system.
confirmed_broken.proposed_fix: Replace delete-then-insert with an upsert keyed on a new UNIQUE (client_id, source, reference_number) index (migration), posting with on_conflict + resolution=merge-duplicates and a column list limited to portal fields (reference_number, notice_type, description, issue_date, due_date, status, issued_by, case_id, pdf_url, pulled_at) so staff columns are never touched; delete only rows whose reference_number is no longer returned by the portal AND that have no staff data (or soft-delete via a portal_removed_at column).

reasons: CONFIRM: Confirmed verbatim. extension/background.js:102-105 `replaceNotices: async (clientId, rows) => { await del('gst_notices', `client_id=eq.${clientId}`); return rows.length ? post('gst_notices', rows) : true; }` — plain DELETE by client_id (all sources, not even scoped to source='notices') followed by INSERT. The rows built in extension/content.js:2532-2536 carry only client_id, source, reference_number, notice_type, description, issue_date, due_date, status, issued_by, case_id, pdf_url. `grep -n staff extension/*.js` returns only a comment (background.js:439); no on_conflict/merge-duplicates is used for gst_notices (only filing_status uses it, background.js:65). The staff columns added by 20260824100700 (staff_status, priority, reply_ref_number, reply_date, order_number, order_date, submission_arn, submission_date) and 20260824104900 (extended_due_date, amount_of_demand, remarks, financial_year, assign_to) are therefore dropped on every Sync All. There is no UNIQUE index on gst_notices (only idx_gst_notices_client), so an upsert is not possible today without a migration. The comment at background.js:131-134 even acknowledges delete-then-insert 'blanks' data versus a true upsert. Nothing in the sibling pages mitigates this — NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx:404/435/455/496 writes staff_status/priority/etc. via .update() straight into rows the next sync deletes.

CONFIRM: Confirmed. extension/background.js:102-105 `replaceNotices` runs `del('gst_notices', client_id=eq.X)` (not even source-scoped) then re-POSTs rows; content.js:2532-2536 builds rows with only client_id/source/reference_number/notice_type/description/issue_date/due_date/status/issued_by/case_id/pdf_url, and content.js never reads gst_notices back (only call sites are replaceNotices at 195/2471/2723/2744). grep for staff_status/assign_to/reply_ref/priority in extension/ hits only the DNR rule's `priority: 1`. No DB trigger or archive table preserves the workflow columns added in 20260824100700/20260824104900/20260825120000. So every Sync All / Company List Sync irreversibly drops staff_status, priority, reply_*, order_*, submission_*, extended_due_date, amount_of_demand, remarks, financial_year, assign_to. Fix is sound with one correction: reference_number is nullable and some rows (LUT/case-task rows with no refId, GSTR-3A rows without noticeOrderId) can have it NULL; a plain UNIQUE (client_id, source, reference_number) treats NULLs as distinct, so those rows would duplicate on every upsert and never merge. Use a NOT NULL `portal_key` (COALESCE(reference_number, case_id, md5(description||issue_date))) as the conflict target, or NULLS NOT DISTINCT (PG15+). With PostgREST `resolution=merge-duplicates` only the posted columns are overwritten, so staff columns survive as long as the POST body stays limited to portal fields (it already is); `pulled_at` must then be posted explicitly since the default only fires on insert.

confirmed_broken.title: A failed portal read replaces the client's entire notice history with one fake 'PULL FAILED' row

reasons: CONFIRM: Confirmed at three call sites, not two: extension/content.js:195 (session bounced 3x), :2471 (get/notices fetch failed) and :2744 (DB write failed) each call `GSTKdb.replaceNotices(cur.clientId, [{ client_id, source: 'notices', description: 'PULL FAILED: ...' }])`, which runs `del('gst_notices', client_id=eq.X)` first (background.js:103). The diagnostic row has notice_type null, so classifyNoticeCategory (src/utils/noticeCategoryClassifier.ts:47 `const type = r.notice_type || 'Uncategorised'`) buckets it as 'Uncategorised', and NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:256 counts it as Open because staff_status is null. One wording nuance: the PDF files themselves remain in the return-pdfs storage bucket (uploadPdf uses x-upsert), and because the portal returns full history from 01/01/2017 a later successful sync restores the portal-sourced rows; what is unrecoverable is the staff workflow data and any manually added notices for that client. CONFIRM: Confirmed at content.js:2471 (portal API read failure), :2744 (DB write failure) and also :195 (session-drop path, same `replaceNotices(... 'PULL FAILED: session kept dropping ...')`). replaceNotices deletes all of the client's gst_notices rows first, then inserts one row with notice_type NULL and reference_number absent. noticeCategoryClassifier.ts:47 buckets it as 'Uncategorised'; NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:252/256 count it in Total and Open (staff_status null); NoticeWorkflowListView's isSentinel (line 41-46) only matches 'not captured|not pulled', so 'PULL FAILED' rows are not filtered anywhere in src/ (grep returns nothing). Severity downgraded to high rather than critical: the portal rows are recoverable on the next successful pull (the portal returns full history from 01/01/2017 and PDFs are re-uploaded with x-upsert; storage objects are never deleted), and the irreversible staff-data loss is already finding 0 — a *successful* sync destroys it identically. The 2744 path also deletes nothing extra: by then del() has already run and the post failed, so the data is gone regardless; only the upsert fix (finding 0) repairs that path. Make logSyncAttempt unconditional (action = job.mode) at the same time.

confirmed_broken.title: Manually added notices (Add Notice dialog) are deleted by the next sync

reasons: CONFIRM: Confirmed. src/components/notices/AddNoticeDialog.tsx:73-86 inserts into gst_notices with `source: 'notices'` and the chosen client_id, with no origin marker; extension/background.js:103 `del('gst_notices', `client_id=eq.${clientId}`)` deletes by client_id alone (no source filter at all), so manual rows are wiped on the next Sync All for that client. CONFIRM: Confirmed. AddNoticeDialog.tsx:73-86 inserts with `source: 'notices'` and the chosen client_id; background.js:103 deletes by `client_id=eq.X` with no further predicate, so manual rows (and their `manual/<clientId>/...` pdf_url references) vanish on the next sync of that client. missing_and_improvements.title: No matter/case entity — a single litigation lifecycle is scattered across unrelated notice rows
missing_and_improvements.evidence: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.gst_notices ( id uuid …, client_id uuid …, reference_number text, notice_type text, source text …) — the only grouping key is case_id text (added 20260824104900), and content.js:2536 sets `case_id: null` for every get/notices row, so a DRC-01A, its DRC-01, the reply, the DRC-07 order and the APL-01 for the same dispute are five unrelated rows with five independent staff_status values.

missing_and_improvements.title: No stage/status state machine — staff_status is free text with only 'closed' recognised

missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: On gst_matters: stage text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new' CHECK (stage IN ('new','under_review','awaiting_client_docs','reply_drafted','reply_filed','ph_scheduled','order_awaited','order_received','rectification_filed','appeal_filed','gstat_filed','closed_dropped','closed_paid','closed_favourable','closed_partly')); CREATE TABLE gst_matter_stage_history (id uuid PK, matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, from_stage text, to_stage text NOT NULL, changed_by uuid, changed_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), note text); trigger AFTER UPDATE OF stage inserts a row; ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD CONSTRAINT gst_notices_staff_status_check CHECK (staff_status IS NULL OR staff_status IN ('Open','Closed','Replied','On Hold')).

Missing an appeal limitation is unrecoverable for the client and an exposure for the firm; today nothing in the DB can even list orders whose 3-month window ends this week.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: CREATE TABLE gst_matter_deadlines (id uuid PK, matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE SET NULL, kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('reply_due','ph_date','appeal_limitation','appeal_condonable_limit','rectification_s161','gstat_limitation','pre_deposit_due','internal_target','other')), basis_section text, computed_from date, due_on date NOT NULL, is_statutory boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, is_met boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, met_on date, notes text, created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matter_deadlines (due_on) WHERE NOT is_met; add a SQL function gst_seed_statutory_deadlines(matter_id) that inserts reply_due = issue_date + 30, appeal_limitation = order_date + interval '3 months', appeal_condonable_limit = + '4 months', rectification_s161 = order_date + '6 months'; the dashboard's Over Due / 7 Days Due then read this table.

missing_and_improvements.title: No hearings/adjournments table
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ALTER TABLE public.gst_notices ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS case_id text, … extended_due_date date, amount_of_demand numeric, remarks text, financial_year text, assign_to text; — this is the complete set of workflow columns; no personal-hearing date, adjournment, outcome or attendee anywhere in supabase/migrations.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Personal hearing dates are the single most time-critical event in a GST dispute; today they live in someone's diary, so the dashboard calendar (issue/due only) cannot show them and no email can remind the GST team or the client the day before.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: CREATE TABLE gst_hearings (id uuid PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE SET NULL, scheduled_on timestamptz NOT NULL, venue text, mode text CHECK (mode IN ('physical','video','written')), attended_by uuid, counsel_id uuid, outcome text CHECK (outcome IN ('scheduled','held','adjourned_by_dept','adjourned_by_us','ex_parte','cancelled')), adjourned_to timestamptz, notes text, created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_hearings (scheduled_on) WHERE outcome = 'scheduled'; feed the dashboard calendar and an 'upcoming hearings' email from it.

missing_and_improvements.title: Demand is a single number — no tax/interest/penalty × CGST/SGST/IGST/cess breakdown, no admitted vs disputed vs paid
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS amount_of_demand numeric, — one free numeric per notice; by contrast gst_drc03_filings (20260818140000) carries igst/cgst/sgst/cess/interest/late_fee/penalty per filing, so the two sides of the same dispute are recorded at different granularity and cannot be reconciled.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The firm cannot report total disputed demand by client/FY/forum, the amount admitted and paid, or the contingent liability figure auditors ask for; pre-deposit for an appeal (10% of disputed tax) cannot be computed from the data.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: CREATE TABLE gst_demand_lines (id uuid PK, matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE SET NULL, document_stage text CHECK (document_stage IN ('drc01a','drc01','drc07','apl04','gstat_order','other')), financial_year text, act text NOT NULL CHECK (act IN ('CGST','SGST','IGST','CESS')), head text NOT NULL CHECK (head IN ('tax','interest','penalty','late_fee','other')), demanded numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, admitted numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, disputed numeric GENERATED ALWAYS AS (demanded - admitted) STORED, paid numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE (matter_id, document_stage, financial_year, act, head)); keep gst_notices.amount_of_demand as a denormalised total maintained by trigger.

missing_and_improvements.title: DRC-03 payments are not linkable to the notice/matter they discharge (pre-deposit, payment against order)
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ALTER TABLE public.gst_drc03_filings ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS financial_year text, section text, … pdf_url text; — no notice_id/matter_id; cause_of_payment is the portal's free label (20260817180000:52). The UI ties DRC-03 to notices only by string equality arn = case_id (AllClientsDrc03Page.tsx:92-96).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: 'Has the 10% pre-deposit for this appeal been paid?' and 'how much of this demand has already been paid voluntarily?' cannot be answered; ITC-vs-cash split per matter is lost; DRC-03 rows are shown as their own 'notice' category rather than as payments inside a dispute.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: ALTER TABLE gst_drc03_filings ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN payment_purpose text CHECK (payment_purpose IN ('voluntary_s73_5','voluntary_s74_5','against_scn','against_order','pre_deposit_s107','pre_deposit_s112','annual_return','audit','other')), ADD COLUMN linked_by uuid, ADD COLUMN linked_at timestamptz; CREATE INDEX ON gst_drc03_filings (matter_id); gst_demand_lines.paid can then be rolled up from linked DRC-03s.

missing_and_improvements.title: No document repository — one pdf_url text per notice, three different jsonb shapes elsewhere, all in a PUBLIC bucket
missing_and_improvements.evidence: VALUES ('return-pdfs', 'return-pdfs', true) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING; … CREATE POLICY "Anyone can view return PDFs" ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO public USING (bucket_id = 'return-pdfs'); — extension/background.js:242-252 uploads every notice/DRC-03/case-folder PDF into this bucket and returns '/storage/v1/object/public/return-pdfs/…'; AddNoticeDialog.tsx:64-70 does the same via getPublicUrl. Documents are scattered across gst_notices.pdf_url (text), gst_refund_applications.documents jsonb [{tab,label,url}] (20260819030000) and gst_case_folder_items.attachments jsonb [{label,url}] (20260828160000:21); replies, annexures, APL-01, hearing notes have no home at all.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Show-cause notices and orders contain client GSTIN, turnover and alleged evasion figures; anyone with a URL (guessable: notices/<client uuid>/<reference>.pdf) can read them with no login. Staff cannot attach the reply they filed or the annexures, so the matter file lives outside the ERP.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id,name,public) VALUES ('litigation-docs','litigation-docs',false); CREATE TABLE gst_documents (id uuid PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES clients ON DELETE CASCADE, matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE SET NULL, drc03_id uuid REFERENCES gst_drc03_filings ON DELETE SET NULL, refund_id uuid REFERENCES gst_refund_applications ON DELETE SET NULL, doc_type text NOT NULL CHECK (doc_type IN ('notice','intimation','reply','annexure','order','apl01','apl02','apl04','hearing_notes','drc03','refund_doc','client_communication','other')), title text NOT NULL, storage_bucket text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'litigation-docs', storage_path text NOT NULL, mime_type text, size_bytes bigint, sha256 text, portal_doc_id text, folder_section text, uploaded_by uuid, source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'portal' CHECK (source IN ('portal','manual')), created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (storage_bucket, storage_path)); CREATE INDEX ON gst_documents (matter_id); serve via createSignedUrl(path, 3600) in the app; migrate existing pdf_url/documents/attachments rows into it and move objects to the private bucket.

missing_and_improvements.title: assign_to is free text, not a user FK — no owner workload, no assignment history, no email-to-owner
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS assign_to text; — written verbatim from a text input at src/components/reports/views/NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx:508 `assign_to: editForm.assignTo || null`. profiles(user_id, first_name, email) exists (types.ts) but is not referenced.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: 'Harsh', 'harsh', 'Harsh P' are three different owners; the dashboard cannot show 'my notices' or per-employee load, and an assignment email cannot be addressed because there is no email behind the name.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN assigned_to uuid REFERENCES profiles(user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN assigned_by uuid, ADD COLUMN assigned_at timestamptz; same three columns on gst_matters; UPDATE gst_notices n SET assigned_to = p.user_id FROM profiles p WHERE lower(trim(n.assign_to)) = lower(p.first_name); keep assign_to for one release then drop; CREATE INDEX ON gst_notices (assigned_to) WHERE staff_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Closed'; replace the text input with a staff picker (user_roles where role <> 'client').

missing_and_improvements.title: No audit trail of who changed what on a notice — audit_log covers only 'clear_data'
missing_and_improvements.evidence: action TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'clear_data', — audit_log's only writer in src/ is ClearDataDialog.tsx and advanceSetoffOverrides.ts; there is no trigger on gst_notices, gst_drc03_filings or gst_refund_applications, and the tables have no created_by/updated_by columns.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: When a notice is found Closed with no reply on file, nobody can tell whether a staff member closed it or a sync wiped the status. For a CA firm, the litigation file's change history is itself evidence of due diligence.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: CREATE TABLE gst_matter_activity (id bigserial PK, matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid, table_name text NOT NULL, row_id uuid NOT NULL, action text NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('insert','update','delete','sync')), changed_fields jsonb, old_values jsonb, new_values jsonb, actor_id uuid, actor_source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'app' CHECK (actor_source IN ('app','extension','agent','system')), created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matter_activity (matter_id, created_at DESC); CREATE FUNCTION log_gst_row_change() RETURNS trigger … computes hstore/jsonb diff of OLD vs NEW, reads actor from current_setting('app.user_id', true) (set by the app via a tiny RPC before writes) … ; CREATE TRIGGER trg_gst_notices_audit AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON gst_notices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION log_gst_row_change(); same on gst_matters, gst_drc03_filings, gst_matter_deadlines, gst_hearings.

missing_and_improvements.title: Email pipeline cannot carry a notice — kind CHECK and templates have no notice/litigation kind and no notice_id
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ALTER TABLE public.email_outbox ADD CONSTRAINT email_outbox_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('reminder', 'confirmation', 'builder_setup', 'builder_fsi', 'builder_cancellation', 'builder_agreement_confirm')); — email_outbox columns are client_id, return_type, period_month, filing_status_id (20260725120000:41-59); there is no notice_id/matter_id, no 'notice_*' template in email_templates, and supabase/functions/queue-gst-reminders only walks filing_status. Nothing in the notices module inserts into email_outbox.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The principal's core ask — 'emailing everything to the GST team for every important matter' — has no schema path: an INSERT with kind='notice_alert' is rejected by the CHECK, and even a hand-crafted row could not be traced back to the notice it was about.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: ALTER TABLE email_outbox DROP CONSTRAINT email_outbox_kind_check, ADD CONSTRAINT email_outbox_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('reminder','confirmation','builder_setup','builder_fsi','builder_cancellation','builder_agreement_confirm','notice_new','notice_due_soon','notice_overdue','notice_hearing','notice_assigned','notice_closed','matter_digest')); same list on email_templates_kind_check; ALTER TABLE email_outbox ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN audience text CHECK (audience IN ('client','gst_team','assignee','partner')), ADD COLUMN cc_emails text[]; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_email_outbox_notice_event ON email_outbox (notice_id, kind, coalesce(reminder_step,0)) WHERE notice_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'cancelled' (prevents double-alerting on re-sync); seed email_templates rows notice_new / notice_due_soon / notice_hearing / matter_digest; add a firm-level setting table gst_notice_alert_settings (id, gst_team_emails text[], digest_time time, due_soon_days int DEFAULT 7); add an edge function queue-notice-alerts on the existing pg_cron pattern (20260726130000).

missing_and_improvements.title: No communications log tying emails/calls/WhatsApp to a notice
missing_and_improvements.evidence: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.email_outbox ( id uuid …, client_id uuid NOT NULL …, to_email text NOT NULL, kind text …, return_type public.return_type, period_month text, … filing_status_id uuid …) — the only communication record in the schema, scoped to returns; nothing records 'client informed of SCN on <date>' or 'documents requested from client'.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Litigation follow-up is communication-heavy; without a log the dashboard cannot show 'client not yet informed' or 'awaiting client docs for 12 days', and there is no defensible record that the client was told of a deadline.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: CREATE TABLE gst_matter_communications (id uuid PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE SET NULL, channel text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('email','phone','whatsapp','meeting','portal','letter')), direction text NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('outbound','inbound')), counterparty text NOT NULL CHECK (counterparty IN ('client','department','counsel','internal')), email_outbox_id uuid REFERENCES email_outbox(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, subject text, summary text, occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), logged_by uuid, follow_up_on date); trigger on email_outbox AFTER UPDATE OF status WHEN new.status='sent' AND new.matter_id IS NOT NULL inserts a communications row automatically.

missing_and_improvements.title: Reminders/tasks cannot reference a notice — staff_task_reminders uses client as free text
missing_and_improvements.evidence: client TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', reminder_frequency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', deadline DATE, allocated_to TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', — no client_id FK, no notice_id/matter_id, allocated_to is text; privacy is per user_id so a task about a notice is invisible to the rest of the GST team.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A 'draft reply by Friday' task cannot appear on the notice, cannot roll up to the matter, and cannot be reassigned when the employee is on leave.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: ALTER TABLE staff_task_reminders ADD COLUMN client_id uuid REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN allocated_to_user_id uuid, ADD COLUMN visibility text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private' CHECK (visibility IN ('private','team')), ADD COLUMN remind_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN notify_email boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false; CREATE INDEX ON staff_task_reminders (matter_id) WHERE NOT is_done; queue-notice-alerts picks up remind_at <= now() AND notify_email.

missing_and_improvements.title: No notes/comments thread — remarks is a single overwritable text column
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS remarks text, — overwritten wholesale by NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx:506 `remarks: editForm.remarks || null`; no author, no timestamp, no history.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Case notes accumulate over months (officer's oral observations, client's explanation, counsel's view); one text box means the previous note is lost and nobody knows who wrote what.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: CREATE TABLE gst_matter_notes (id uuid PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE SET NULL, body text NOT NULL, is_pinned boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, author_id uuid NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), edited_at timestamptz); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matter_notes (matter_id, created_at DESC); migrate existing remarks into one note each; keep remarks as a short 'headline' only.

missing_and_improvements.title: No counsel/advocate, authority or forum details
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS issued_by text, — the only authority field, copied from the portal's issuedBy string (content.js:2536). There is no counsel, no appellate authority, no jurisdiction (Centre/State, range/division) and no forum column anywhere.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Appeals and tribunal matters are argued by external counsel; the firm needs to know who holds the brief, their fee, and which authority/forum the matter is before to prepare the right form (APL-01 vs APL-05).
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: CREATE TABLE gst_counsels (id uuid PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name text NOT NULL, firm text, email text, phone text, bar_enrolment_no text, default_fee numeric, is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true); ALTER TABLE gst_matters ADD COLUMN counsel_id uuid REFERENCES gst_counsels(id), ADD COLUMN jurisdiction text CHECK (jurisdiction IN ('centre','state')), ADD COLUMN authority_designation text, ADD COLUMN authority_office text, ADD COLUMN vakalatnama_doc_id uuid REFERENCES gst_documents(id); ALTER TABLE clients ADD COLUMN gst_range text, ADD COLUMN gst_division text, ADD COLUMN gst_commissionerate text (portal profile already exposes these via gst_taxpayer_profile — copy on sync).

missing_and_improvements.title: No fees/billing hook per matter
missing_and_improvements.evidence: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.gst_notices ( … ) — no fee, estimate, invoice or time columns in any notice/refund/drc03 migration; grep for 'fee' across supabase/migrations only finds late_fee_amount (DRC-03) and builder tables.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Litigation is separately billable from monthly compliance; without a hook the firm cannot see unbilled matters, counsel disbursements to recover, or fees quoted vs collected per dispute.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: CREATE TABLE gst_matter_fees (id uuid PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, fee_type text NOT NULL CHECK (fee_type IN ('professional','counsel','pre_deposit_funding','court_fee','disbursement','other')), description text, quoted numeric, billed numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, collected numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, billed_on date, invoice_ref text, counsel_id uuid REFERENCES gst_counsels(id), created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE VIEW gst_matter_fee_summary AS SELECT matter_id, sum(quoted) quoted, sum(billed) billed, sum(collected) collected FROM gst_matter_fees GROUP BY matter_id.

missing_and_improvements.title: No tags or SLA fields on notices/matters
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ALTER TABLE public.gst_notices ADD CONSTRAINT gst_notices_priority_check CHECK (priority IN ('Low', 'Medium', 'High') OR priority IS NULL); — priority is the only triage attribute; no tags, no first_response_due, no escalation level, no internal target date.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The GST team cannot group matters by theme (e.g. 'ITC 16(4)', 'RCM on legal fees', 'Amnesty 128A') to reuse replies, and the dashboard has no basis for 'not looked at within 2 working days of receipt' escalation emails.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: ALTER TABLE gst_matters ADD COLUMN tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', ADD COLUMN first_response_due timestamptz, ADD COLUMN first_responded_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN escalation_level smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN internal_target_date date; CREATE INDEX ON gst_matters USING gin (tags); ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN first_viewed_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN first_viewed_by uuid (set by the app on first open); a firm-level gst_notice_alert_settings.first_response_hours int DEFAULT 48 drives the escalation.

missing_and_improvements.title: gst_case_folder_items has no FK to the notice, no unique key, typed columns are absent — delete-then-insert again
missing_and_improvements.evidence: case_id text not null, -- matches gst_notices.case_id for the parent row … create index if not exists gst_case_folder_items_case_idx on public.gst_case_folder_items (client_id, case_id); — join by text convention only; extension/background.js:144 `await del('gst_case_folder_items', client_id=eq.…&case_id=eq.…)` then post; raw_json is the only place issue/due dates live (the migration's own comment: 'typed columns below are best-effort').
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The Additional Notice Folder page must parse raw_json client-side for every date, so the folder's reply-due and order dates can never feed the dashboard, deadlines or emails; a case whose notice row is deleted leaves orphan folder items (no FK cascade from gst_notices).
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: ALTER TABLE gst_case_folder_items ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN item_type text, ADD COLUMN issue_date date, ADD COLUMN due_date date, ADD COLUMN section_ref text, ADD COLUMN portal_item_id text; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_case_folder_item ON gst_case_folder_items (client_id, case_id, folder_section, coalesce(portal_item_id, reference_number)); switch the extension to on_conflict upsert; a SQL function gst_extract_folder_dates() fills issue_date/due_date from raw_json->>'dtOfIssue' / 'dueDate' for the proven ORDRS/NOTCE shapes.

missing_and_improvements.title: client_sync_log has no run/job id and mixes diagnostic actions with sync outcomes
missing_and_improvements.evidence: action text not null, -- e.g. 'notices' … status text not null check (status in ('success', 'failed')), — extension/content.js:2740 also writes action 'notices_gstr3a_debug' with status 'failed'; the dashboard filters .eq('action','notices') (NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:~180) but CompanyListPage.tsx:107 reads all actions and takes the latest per client for its Status column.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A debug row can flip a client to 'Failed' on the Company List while the dashboard tile says 0, and there is no way to see 'this Sync All run covered 92 clients, 3 failed' as one unit or to count notices added/removed per run.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: ALTER TABLE client_sync_log ADD COLUMN run_id uuid, ADD COLUMN level text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'outcome' CHECK (level IN ('outcome','debug')), ADD COLUMN rows_seen int, ADD COLUMN rows_new int, ADD COLUMN rows_gone int, ADD COLUMN pdfs_ok int, ADD COLUMN pdfs_failed int, ADD COLUMN started_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN duration_ms int; ADD CONSTRAINT client_sync_log_action_check CHECK (action IN ('notices','notices_bundle','refunds','drc03','taxpayerprofile','notices_gstr3a_debug')); CREATE TABLE sync_runs (id uuid PK, mode text, started_by uuid, started_at, finished_at, clients_total int, clients_failed int); readers filter level='outcome'.

missing_and_improvements.title: Missing indexes for the dashboard's actual access paths
missing_and_improvements.evidence: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gst_notices_client ON public.gst_notices (client_id); — the sole index; every dashboard/report query filters on source (NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:149), staff_status, due_date, case_id (AdditionalNoticeFolderPage.tsx:374 .eq('case_id', caseId)), notice_type (AllClientsRefundsPage.tsx:69 .eq('notice_type','Refunds')).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: At 1,060 rows this is invisible; at 10 clients × 5 years of history it becomes sequential scans on every dashboard load, and case_id lookups from the folder page are already unindexed.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_source_status ON gst_notices (source, staff_status); CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_due ON gst_notices (due_date) WHERE staff_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Closed'; CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_case ON gst_notices (client_id, case_id) WHERE case_id IS NOT NULL; CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_type ON gst_notices (notice_type); CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_issue ON gst_notices (issue_date DESC); CREATE INDEX idx_gst_refund_status ON gst_refund_applications (client_id, status); CREATE INDEX idx_gst_drc03_fy ON gst_drc03_filings (client_id, financial_year).

missing_and_improvements.title: No 'new notice landed' event or email — a notice can sit unseen until someone opens the dashboard
missing_and_improvements.evidence: `kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('reminder','confirmation'))` on email_outbox (line 47) and on email_templates (line 20); a repo-wide grep for files containing both 'notice' and 'email|outbox' returns only CompanyProfilePage.tsx (displays `client.email`, line 331-334) and the corporate template SQL — nothing enqueues mail for gst_notices, gst_refund_applications, gst_drc03_filings or gst_case_folder_items. The only send paths are queue-gst-reminders (filing_status Data Pending) and gstReminders.ts:86-98 enqueueConfirmation (Filed).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The firm's stated goal is 'emailing everything to GST team for every important matter'. A show-cause notice with a 7-day reply window that lands during a sync no one reviews is exactly the litigation miss this ERP exists to prevent.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: New table `gst_notice_events (id uuid pk, notice_id uuid references gst_notices on delete cascade, client_id uuid, event_kind text check (event_kind in ('notice.new','notice.due','notice.overdue','notice.assigned','notice.status_changed','hearing.upcoming','refund.status_changed','drc03.new','sync.failed')), payload jsonb, occurred_at timestamptz default now(), processed_at timestamptz, dedupe_key text unique)`. DB trigger `trg_gst_notices_new_event AFTER INSERT ON gst_notices FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.source='notices' AND NEW.reference_number IS NOT NULL AND NEW.description NOT LIKE 'PULL FAILED%')` inserts an event with dedupe_key `'notice.new:'||NEW.id` (requires the upsert fix so INSERT only fires for genuinely new rows; the manual AddNoticeDialog path is covered automatically). New edge function `notify-notice-events` scheduled by pg_cron `*/15 * * * *` (same vault-anon-key http_post pattern as gst_email_cron.sql:11-24): reads unprocessed events, groups by client, renders template `notice_new` with vars {client_name, gstin, notice_type, reference_number, issue_date, due_date, amount_of_demand, issued_by, portal_url, app_url}, inserts email_outbox kind 'notice_alert' (cc team list, attachments=[pdf_url]) and a staff_notifications row, marks processed_at, then invokes send-gst-email immediately. Optional extension callback: after `GSTKdb.replaceNotices` at content.js:2723 POST `{clientId}` to the function so the email goes out within seconds of the CAPTCHA run instead of at the next 15-min tick.

missing_and_improvements.title: No due-date escalation ladder for notices (T-7 / T-3 / T-1 / T0 / overdue) — the 473 overdue rows never trigger anything
missing_and_improvements.evidence: queue-gst-reminders reads only `client_reminder_settings` (line 213-217 `.select('client_id, interval_days, escalate, max_reminders').eq('enabled', true)`) and `filing_status` rows with status 'Data Pending'; the notice due logic exists purely client-side and only for tiles — NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:257-258 `const dueSoon = displayRows.filter((r) => r.due_date && daysUntil(r.due_date) >= 0 && daysUntil(r.due_date) <= 7)`, `const overdue = ... daysUntil(r.due_date) < 0`. Neither `extended_due_date` (20260824104900 line 12) nor `staff_status` feed any scheduled job.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The screenshot shows Over Due 473 of 1060 and 7 Days Due 0. Missing a reply deadline under s.73/74 converts a notice into an ex-parte order; the firm's exposure is the sum of amount_of_demand on those rows and nobody is being nudged.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: New edge function `queue-notice-reminders`, pg_cron `gst-queue-notice-reminders-daily` at `30 3 * * *` (09:00 IST). Query: `gst_notices where source='notices' and lower(coalesce(staff_status,'')) <> 'closed' and coalesce(extended_due_date, due_date) is not null`. Compute days_left in IST; steps: 7→`notice_due_t7`, 3→`notice_due_t3`, 1→`notice_due_t1`, 0→`notice_due_today`, <0 and (−days_left % 3 = 0, max 5 sends)→`notice_overdue`. dedupe_key `notice.due:{notice_id}:{step}` (overdue: `:overdue:{n}`), kind 'notice_due', to = assignee email (new `assigned_to_user_id` → profiles.email) fallback team list, cc gst_manager users from T-1, cc partner list once overdue. Vars {client_name, gstin, notice_type, reference_number, issue_date, due_date, days_left, amount_of_demand, priority, assignee, app_url}. Add `firm_alert_settings` single-row table (team_emails text[], partner_emails text[], ladder_days int[] default '{7,3,1,0}', overdue_repeat_days int default 3, overdue_max int default 5) editable on RemindersPage so partners can tune the ladder without a deploy.

missing_and_improvements.title: No daily digest to the GST team and no weekly portfolio summary to partners
missing_and_improvements.evidence: The only two cron jobs are line 11 `cron.schedule('gst-queue-reminders-daily', '0 4 * * *', ...queue-gst-reminders)` and line 26 `cron.schedule('gst-send-outbox-hourly', '0 * * * *', ...send-gst-email)`. missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Partners and the GST team currently only learn the state of 1060 notices by logging in and looking at tiles; a 'what needs attention today' push is the single highest-leverage habit change for a litigation desk and the cheapest to build on the existing outbox.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Two edge functions. (a) `notice-daily-digest`, pg_cron `0 3 * * 1-6` (08:30 IST Mon-Sat): sections New since yesterday (first_seen_at > now()-1d), Due in 7 days, Overdue (sorted by amount_of_demand desc), Unassigned open, Hearings this week, Failed logins (latest client_sync_log per client = 'failed'), Not synced in 7+ days, Refund deficiency memos / rejections, DRC-03 filed in last 24h; template `notice_digest_daily`, kind 'notice_digest', client_id NULL, to = firm_alert_settings.team_emails, cc = every profiles.email whose user_roles.role in ('superadmin','gst_manager'); dedupe_key `digest:daily:{yyyy-mm-dd}`; skip when every section is empty. (b) `partner-weekly-summary`, cron `30 3 * * 1` (Monday 09:00 IST): port `computeNoticeSummary` to `supabase/functions/_shared/noticeSummary.ts`, add ageing buckets (0-7/8-30/31-90/90+ days open), total demand exposure, per-staff open counts, week-over-week deltas; template `partner_weekly_summary`, kind 'partner_weekly', to = partner_emails, dedupe_key `digest:weekly:{iso-week}`. Both render with a new `digest` shell in _shared/email.ts (table per section, links back to /notices-all?filter=...).

missing_and_improvements.title: Failed portal logins are recorded but nobody is told — no sync-failure or stale-sync alert
missing_and_improvements.evidence: content.js:308 `try { await GSTKdb.logClientSync(cur.clientId, 'notices', status, message || null); }` writes client_sync_log (20260828100000 line 7-14, `status text not null check (status in ('success','failed'))`); the only consumer is the tile at NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:264 `failedLoginsCount = Array.from(latestLogByClient.values()).filter((l) => l.status === 'failed').length` and CompanyListPage. Worse, on failure content.js:195/2471/2744 insert a placeholder row into gst_notices (`description: 'PULL FAILED: ...'`) that counts as a notice.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A client whose portal password changed silently drops out of monitoring; the team assumes 'no new notices' when in fact the pull never ran. The extension is manual and CAPTCHA-gated (extension/README.md:40-41 'It's not a silent overnight job'), so a client that nobody re-syncs is invisible for weeks.

Add a 'Stale sync' section to the daily digest: clients with gst_user_id set whose latest success is older than 7 days (or never). Stop writing PULL FAILED placeholder rows into gst_notices (content.js:195, 2471, 2744) — the sync log already holds the failure — or write them with `source='pull_failed'` so the `.eq('source','notices')` query at NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:149 and the new-notice trigger exclude them.

Replace the free-text input in NoticeWorkflowListView's edit dialog and AllClientsNoticesPage bulk toolbar with a staff Select (profiles joined to user_roles where role in staff roles). Trigger `trg_gst_notices_assigned AFTER UPDATE OF assigned_to_user_id ... WHEN (NEW.assigned_to_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.assigned_to_user_id AND NEW.assigned_to_user_id IS NOT NULL)` → event 'notice.assigned' → template `notice_assigned` to the assignee's profiles.email, cc team list, plus a staff_notifications row. missing_and_improvements.title: No hearing-date, appeal-limitation or order-received reminders
missing_and_improvements.evidence: Workflow columns are `staff_status, priority, reply_ref_number, reply_date, order_number, order_date, submission_arn, submission_date` (lines 7-15) plus `extended_due_date, amount_of_demand, remarks, financial_year, assign_to` (20260824104900). missing_and_improvements.title: No client-facing 'notice received — here is what we need' email

Missing one is a lost appeal, not a late reply.
