missing_and_improvements.title: Outcome tracking: status vocabulary is only Open/Closed, so win-rate and 'how did it end' are unknowable
missing_and_improvements.evidence: const STATUS_OPEN_CLOSED = ['Open', 'Closed']; — and src/utils/noticeSummaryReport.ts line 44: export const isClosed = (s: string | null) => (s || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'closed';
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A CA firm's litigation record needs dropped / confirmed / partly confirmed / remanded / set aside / withdrawn / appealed further / recovered / time-barred per stage. 'Closed' cannot tell the partner whether the firm won or the client paid.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add outcome enum (dropped, confirmed_full, confirmed_part, set_aside, remanded, withdrawn, appealed, paid_settled, amnesty_128a, time_barred) on litigation_matters and per stage on matter_events; replace the Open/Closed Select with a Stage + Outcome control; Notice Summary gains Dropped/Confirmed/Appealed columns.

missing_and_improvements.title: Authority is a free-text issued_by: no CGST vs SGST, no officer/range/division master, jurisdiction captured but never joined
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS issued_by text, — filled from the portal as-is (extension/content.js:2530 `issued_by: n.issuedBy || null`); the taxpayer profile already stores jurisdiction_state / jurisdiction_centre (20260817200000_taxpayer_challan_transitional.sql lines 19-20, content.js:3229 `jurisdiction_state: j.stj || null, jurisdiction_centre: j.ctj || null`) but no notice page reads it; folder items carry todtls.dg / todtls.nm (AdditionalNoticeFolderPage.tsx line 180, 213).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The firm cannot filter or report by Centre vs State, by Commissionerate/Division/Range, or by officer — which is how a practice decides who argues, which precedent applies and where the appeal lies (Appellate Authority differs for CGST and SGST orders).
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Master table tax_authorities (id, administration [CGST, SGST, DGGI, Appellate, GSTAT, HC], designation, office_name, commissionerate, division, range, state, email, address) + authority_id on litigation_matters; auto-suggest from issued_by / todtls and gst_taxpayer_profile jurisdiction; filters and MIS by authority.

missing_and_improvements.title: Section of law and financial year are free text; multi-FY notices cannot be represented; portal sec/fy fields are discarded
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS financial_year text, — edited via <Input id="financial-year" placeholder="e.g. 2025-2026" ...> (NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx ~line 1079); there is no section column on gst_notices at all, although the folder JSON exposes them: AdditionalNoticeFolderPage.tsx line 182 `{ label: 'Section Number', render: (raw) => str(subDetail(raw)?.sec) }` and line 183 `{ label: 'Financial Year', render: (raw) => str(subDetail(raw)?.fy) }`.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Most s.73/74 SCNs cover several FYs (e.g. 2017-18 to 2020-21) with different limitation dates per FY; without section + FY[] the firm cannot group by issue (17(5), 16(4), RCM, e-way bill), cannot run s.128A eligibility (s.73, FY 17-18 to 19-20 only) and cannot report exposure per FY.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add section_of_law text[] and financial_years text[] (validated 'YYYY-YY' picker) to litigation_matters and gst_notices; a sync-time backfill reads sdtls.sec / sdtls.fy from gst_case_folder_items.raw_json; child table matter_periods (matter_id, financial_year, demand per head) for per-FY exposure.

missing_and_improvements.title: Lifecycle capture gaps: appeals, GSTAT, recovery, e-way bill, DRC-01B/01C, REG-17/21, SPL-01/02, summons are neither pulled nor enterable in a typed way
missing_and_improvements.evidence: fetch('https://services.gst.gov.in/services/auth/api/get/notices' ...) (line 2461), case/task/get (line 2490), case/folder/items (2628/2674), case/search caseTypeCd 'RFUND' (2886) and 'ADJVP' (3152) are the only litigation endpoints; the classifier only regex-buckets descriptions — src/utils/noticeCategoryClassifier.ts line 18-19 `/ITC mismatch|liability mismatch|DRC-01B|DRC-01C/i`, line 40 `'Waiver Scheme U/S 128a': 'Others'`; NoticesDashboardPage.tsx lines 10-14 admit 'Appeal, ASMT 10, Audit, Enforcement, Recovery ... have no portal capture in this app yet'.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: An appeal filed on the portal (APL-01 → APL-02 ack → APL-04 order), a GSTAT appeal (separate gstat.gov.in portal), a DRC-13 garnishee, an MOV-09 penalty order, a REG-17 SCN with 7-day reply, or a summons received offline never enters the system unless someone types it into a two-field Add Notice dialog — the dashboard silently under-reports exactly the highest-stakes matters.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: (1) Extension roadmap: enumerate case/search caseTypeCd values beyond RFUND/ADJVP (appeal 'APL', audit 'ADT', recovery, registration) and pull them into matter_events; (2) typed manual-entry forms per matter_type (Appeal form with order-appealed, pre-deposit, grounds; Recovery form with DRC-13/16/22 fields; E-way bill MOV form; Summons form with appearance date; Amnesty SPL-01/02 form) replacing the generic AddNoticeDialog; (3) GSTAT / HC matters as manual matters with document upload.

missing_and_improvements.title: No reply-drafting workspace, templates or precedent library
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reply_ref_number text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reply_date date, — only post-facto fields; the Add Notice dialog accepts one PDF (src/components/notices/AddNoticeDialog.tsx line 353 `supabase.storage.from('return-pdfs').upload(path, file)`); no reply/draft table or page exists (grep for 'template' outside email_templates returns nothing in src/pages/*Notice*).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Replies to ASMT-10, DRC-01A, DRC-01, RFD-08 and appeal grounds are the firm's actual product; without drafts, versioning, standard paragraphs (16(4), 17(5), RCM, e-invoice) and past winning replies, quality depends on which employee remembers which file.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Table matter_documents (matter_id, kind [notice, intimation, order, reply_draft, reply_filed, annexure, working, precedent, correspondence], version, file_url, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, filed_on_portal boolean, portal_ref) and reply_templates (matter_type, stage, section, title, body_docx_url, tags); 'Draft reply' action on the matter creating a versioned draft, partner approval, then 'Mark filed' capturing ARN/date; precedent search by section/issue/outcome.

missing_and_improvements.title: Documents are scattered across five storage prefixes and three column shapes; no per-matter document repository
missing_and_improvements.evidence: const path = 'notices/' + cur.clientId + '/case-folder/' + t.arn + '/' + doc.id + '.pdf'; (2699) alongside 'notices/<client>/<ref>.pdf' (2546), 'refund/<client>/<arn>/<doc>.pdf' (3068), 'drc03/<client>/<arn>.pdf' (3182) and 'manual/<client>/...' (AddNoticeDialog.tsx 352); stored as gst_notices.pdf_url text, gst_case_folder_items.attachments jsonb, gst_refund_applications.documents jsonb. 'Download all visible PDFs' just opens tabs: NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx lines 385-387 `urls.forEach((url, i) => { setTimeout(() => window.open(url, '_blank', ...), i * 150); });`
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: For an appeal or a hearing the team needs the complete paper book of a matter in one place — SCN, annexures, reply, order, DRC-03 challans, appeal memo — today they must hunt across pages and open PDFs one by one.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Unify into matter_documents (see reply workspace finding) with a Documents tab per matter, folder tree (Notices / Replies / Orders / Payments / Working papers / Correspondence), 'Download paper book (zip)' via an edge function, and full-text index of PDF text for search.

missing_and_improvements.title: No partner review / approval workflow; edit_notice_status is the only permission
missing_and_improvements.evidence: edit_notice_status: false, — the sole notice-related key in DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS (lines 41-64); status/priority/edit writes go straight to the row (NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx line 404 `supabase.from('gst_notices').update({ staff_status: newStatus })`, line 496 `supabase.from('gst_notices').update({ priority: ..., reply_ref_number: ... })`).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A junior can close a matter, change an amount of demand or record a reply as filed with no maker-checker; replies and appeal grounds go out without a documented partner sign-off — a professional-liability exposure for the firm.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Table matter_approvals (matter_id, subject [reply_draft, appeal_grounds, close_matter, settle_amnesty], requested_by, approver, requested_at, decided_at, decision, comments); new permissions review_litigation and approve_litigation_filing (superadmin/gst_manager implicit); 'Awaiting my approval' tile on the dashboard; closing a matter or marking 'filed' requires an approved record.

missing_and_improvements.title: Assignment is a free-text name; no per-stage tasks, no 'my matters' queue, no workload view
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS assign_to text; — edited as <Input id="assign-to" placeholder="Staff member" ...> (NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx ~line 1083); staff_task_reminders is private per user with `client TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''` and no notice reference (20260828110000_staff_task_reminders.sql lines 12-24).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Nobody can list 'all matters assigned to Harsh due this week', re-assign on leave, or see that a matter has no owner; the personal Task Reminder grid duplicates data by hand and never links back to the notice.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Change to assigned_to uuid REFERENCES profiles(user_id) (backfill by name match, keep assign_to as legacy); table matter_tasks (matter_id, stage, title, due_date, assignee uuid, status, created_by, done_at); '/litigation/my-queue' page and an Unassigned tile; optional sync of matter_tasks into staff_task_reminders.

missing_and_improvements.title: No e-mail alerts to the GST team for notices, due dates, overdue, hearings, orders or limitation expiry
missing_and_improvements.evidence: kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('reminder','confirmation')), — later widened only to builder kinds (20260811160000_builder_bu_agreement_confirm.sql line 132); supabase/functions/queue-gst-reminders/index.ts lines 1-6 'For every client with reminders enabled whose return for `period` is still "Data Pending", enqueue the next ladder reminder'; supabase/functions/send-gst-email/index.ts line 5 '// ... No attachments.'
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The principal's explicit ask — 'emailing everything to GST team for every important matter' — has no plumbing: a new SCN pulled at 9 am, a reply due in 3 days, a DRC-07 order received, an appeal window closing in 15 days or a hearing tomorrow produce zero e-mails today.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Extend email_outbox.kind with notice_new, notice_due, notice_overdue, hearing_reminder, order_received, limitation_warning, litigation_digest, client_matter_statement; add table notice_alert_rules (kind, days_before, recipients [gst_team, assignee, partner, client], enabled, template_key); new edge function queue-notice-alerts (daily via the existing pg_cron block in 20260726130000_gst_email_cron.sql, plus a post-sync trigger from the extension's logClientSync) rendering per-matter e-mails with links to /litigation/matters/:id; add attachment support (notice PDF) to send-gst-email; seed templates in email_templates.

missing_and_improvements.title: No client-facing status report or portal view of their matters
missing_and_improvements.evidence: export const exportNoticeFormatToPDF = ({ clientName, clientGstin, financialYear, outward, inward }...) — the only 'notice' PDF is a GSTR-9 reconciliation format; no page under src/pages or component under src/components/dashboard/ClientDashboard.tsx queries gst_notices for a client role, and email_templates has no client-facing litigation template.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Clients ask 'what is pending against me and what do you need from me'; today the answer is composed by hand each time, and clients cannot see hearing dates or amounts paid themselves.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Monthly client_matter_statement e-mail (template + PDF via jspdf/reportTheme letterhead) listing open matters, stage, next date, documents awaited; client-portal page /portal/matters reading litigation_matters for the logged-in client (role 'client'), read-only, with 'upload requested document' action.

missing_and_improvements.title: MIS absent: no ageing, exposure by client/officer/section/FY, stage funnel or win-rate — only Total/Open/Closed/Replied counts
missing_and_improvements.evidence: export interface CategoryRow { type: string; total: number; open: number; closed: number; replied: number; ... } — Replied only increments when staff typed reply_date (line 90 `if (r.reply_date) entry.replied += 1;`), which the sync never sets, hence the all-dashes Replied column; GstinWiseNoticeCountPage.tsx repeats the same four counts per client.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A litigation practice is managed on ageing buckets, rupee exposure, per-officer patterns and outcomes; the partner has none of these numbers for 1060 rows / 92 GSTINs.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: New /litigation/mis page fed by a view v_litigation_mis over litigation_matters + matter_demands + matter_deadlines: ageing (0-30/31-90/91-180/180+ days since issue and since last action), exposure heat-map client x FY, by section and by authority, stage funnel (SCN → reply → order → appeal), outcome statistics (dropped %, confirmed %), average days to reply, upcoming limitation list; Excel export via renderReportToExcel.

missing_and_improvements.title: Open (1060/1060) and Over Due (473) are inflated: null status counts as open, and portal closure signals (orders, closure items, LUT/ack rows) are ignored on the dashboard
missing_and_improvements.evidence: const openNotices = displayRows.filter((r) => !isClosed(r.staff_status)).length; — while AdditionalNoticeFolderPage.tsx line 440 already derives closure from the folder: `const displayStatus = header?.staff_status || (hasClosureItem || (isRefundCase && hasOrderItem) ? 'Closed' : 'Open');` but only on that page; LUT rows (65) and DRC-03 acknowledgements are 'notices' too.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: When every notice is 'Open' and half are 'Over Due' the tiles stop meaning anything and the team stops looking at them; genuine overdue replies are hidden in noise.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add a computed system_status on gst_notices/matters set at sync from case-folder items (ORDRS / CLOSURE / DRC7A present → stage advanced), treat informational types (LUT, acknowledgements, RFD-11A) as non-actionable, and make Open = actionable & no reply logged, Over Due = actionable & past due & no reply; show a 'Needs action' tile and a separate 'Awaiting order' tile.

missing_and_improvements.title: Counsel / external advocate management does not exist
missing_and_improvements.evidence: <Route path="/notices-dashboard" element={<NoticesDashboardPage />} /> ... <Route path="/drc03-all" element={<AllClientsDrc03Page />} /> — the full notices route family (lines 106-114) has no counsel/advocate page, and no migration creates a counsels table (grep 'counsel' over supabase/migrations returns nothing).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: GSTAT/HC matters and many first appeals are argued by outside counsel; the firm needs who holds the brief, when the brief was sent, fee status and contact details per matter.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Master counsels (name, firm, forum expertise, phone, email, fee_basis) and matter_counsels (matter_id, counsel_id, role, brief_sent_on, fee_agreed, fee_paid, notes); show on the matter header and in the hearing record.

missing_and_improvements.title: No litigation fee / cost tracking or time log per matter
missing_and_improvements.evidence: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.gst_notices (...) — no fee, billing or time columns; no *_fees or *_time_entries table exists anywhere under supabase/migrations for notices.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Litigation is billed separately from compliance retainers; without quote/billed/received per matter the firm under-bills reply drafting and hearings and cannot compute matter profitability.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Table matter_fees (matter_id, stage, quoted, billed, invoice_no, received, received_on) and optional matter_time_entries (matter_id, user_id, minutes, work_date, note); Fees tab on the matter and a 'Unbilled litigation work' report.

missing_and_improvements.title: Refund lifecycle stages (RFD-02/03 deficiency, RFD-08 SCN, RFD-09 reply, RFD-06 order, RFD-05/PMT-03) are not modelled and RFD-08 due dates never reach the KPIs
missing_and_improvements.evidence: status text, — the only lifecycle field on gst_refund_applications; the NOTAC folder item does carry a due date (AdditionalNoticeFolderPage.tsx line 253 `{ label: 'Due Date of Reply', render: (raw) => toDisplayDate(raw?.sdtls && (raw.sdtls as Record<string, unknown>).duedate) }`) but src/pages/CompanyProfilePage.tsx ~line 231 excludes refunds from Open/Due: `const workflowRows = filteredNotices.filter((n) => n.kind !== 'refund' && n.kind !== 'drc03');`
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: An RFD-08 has a 15-day reply window and an unanswered one becomes an RFD-06 rejection; the dashboard's 7 Days Due tile cannot see it, and deficiency memos (which restart the 2-year limitation clock) are invisible.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add refund stages to the matter stage machine (filed, acknowledged_rfd02, deficiency_rfd03, scn_rfd08, reply_rfd09, order_rfd06, payment_rfd05, recredit_pmt03, withdrawn) fed from gst_case_folder_items (APLCN/NOTAC/REPLY/ORDRS) at sync; push RFD-08 due dates into matter_deadlines so they count in 7 Days Due / Over Due and trigger e-mails.

missing_and_improvements.title: Recovery and attachment proceedings (DRC-13/16/22, DRC-07A) have no structured tracking or stay status
missing_and_improvements.evidence: // ... DRC7A/APLCN (recovery and appeal proceedings, also seen live) aren't among Notice Alert's 5 fixed sections, so they get their own section labeled with the raw code ... — DRC7A items therefore render through the generic fieldsOf() dump (lines 266-293) and 'Pre-Gst Recovery' maps to a bare 'Recovery' bucket (noticeCategoryClassifier.ts line 39).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Bank-account garnishee (DRC-13) and provisional attachment (DRC-22) are emergencies with statutory objection windows (7 days for DRC-22A); the firm also needs to record that filing APL-01 with pre-deposit gives a deemed stay (s.107(7)) to stop recovery.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Table matter_recovery_actions (matter_id, form [DRC-07A, DRC-13, DRC-16, DRC-22, DRC-22A, DRC-23], issued_on, addressed_to (bank/debtor), amount, objection_due, stay_status [none, deemed_s107_7, court_stay], stay_reference, released_on); typed columns for DRC7A folder items; 'Recovery' stage and red 'Attachment active' badge on the matter and dashboard.

missing_and_improvements.title: s.128A amnesty (SPL-01/SPL-02) matters lose their identity by being bucketed as 'Others'
missing_and_improvements.evidence: 'Waiver Scheme U/S 128a': 'Others', — inside CASE_NOTICE_TYPE_MAP (lines 33-41); no eligibility flag, SPL form stage or payment deadline exists on any table.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The waiver scheme is the single biggest settlement opportunity for s.73 demands of FY 2017-18 to 2019-20 (interest and penalty waived if tax paid by the notified date); the firm should see which open matters qualify, which SPL-01/02 were filed, and which SPL-05/07 orders came back.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Dedicated category 'Amnesty (s.128A)' with stages spl01_filed / spl02_filed / spl03_scn / spl04_reply / spl05_order / spl07_rejection; an 'eligible for 128A' computed flag on matters where section = 73 and FY in the scheme window and no fraud allegation; payment-deadline entry in matter_deadlines.

missing_and_improvements.title: Documents of one dispute are not chained (no parent/matter link), so dashboard totals count the same matter 3-4 times and no timeline exists
missing_and_improvements.evidence: const row = { client_id: cur.clientId, source: 'notices', reference_number: n.noticeOrderId || null, notice_type: n.type || null, description: n.descr || null, issue_date: ..., due_date: ..., status: n.status || null, issued_by: n.issuedBy || null, case_id: null, pdf_url: null }; — get/notices rows always get case_id: null, so DRC-01A, DRC-01, reminder and DRC-07 for one dispute are unlinkable; only case/task/get rows carry case_id (line 2614 `case_id: t.arn || null`).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Total Notices = 1060 mixes intimations, reminders and orders of the same disputes; the team cannot open one record and read the chronology from intimation to order to appeal.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add matter_id to gst_notices; at sync, group by case_id/arn where present and otherwise by (client_id, section, FY, issuing officer) heuristics with a manual 'Link to matter' action in the list; dashboard toggle 'Count: Matters | Documents'; Timeline tab on the matter built from litigation_matter_events.

missing_and_improvements.title: No 'what needs my attention today' work queue on the dashboard
missing_and_improvements.evidence: const kpiCards = [ { label: 'Total Notices', ... }, { label: 'Last 15 Days', ... }, { label: 'Last 24 Hours', ... }, { label: 'Total GSTIN', ... }, { label: 'Open Notices', ... }, { label: '7 Days Due', ... }, { label: 'Over Due', ... }, { label: 'Failed Logins', ... } ]; — all tiles are counts; the page has no list of concrete items due, no owner, no hearing, no approval queue.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Staff open the dashboard and still do not know which five things to do before lunch; the partner has no single view of what is at risk this week.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Replace the empty space under Company/Calendar with an 'Action Centre' panel: sections Due today / Due in 7 days / Hearings this week / Limitation expiring ≤30 days / Awaiting my approval / Unassigned / New since last sync, each row = client, matter, stage, date, owner, quick actions (assign, log reply, open portal); filter 'Mine | Team'.

missing_and_improvements.title: No audit trail of who changed status, priority, amounts or assignment on a notice
missing_and_improvements.evidence: const { error } = await supabase.from('gst_notices').update({ staff_status: bulkStatus }).in('id', ids); — likewise line 455 (priority) and 496-509 (all edit fields); gst_notices has updated_at but no updated_by (20260817180000 lines 24-25) and no history table.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: In a litigation file, 'who marked this closed and when' and 'who changed the amount of demand' are evidentiary questions; bulk updates over 50-500 rows with no log are unrecoverable mistakes.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add updated_by uuid to gst_notices/litigation_matters (set from the app's AppUser.id on every update) and a gst_notices_audit table (row_id, changed_by, changed_at, old jsonb, new jsonb) via a trigger; 'History' drawer on the matter.

missing_and_improvements.title: No new-vs-updated detection or change log for notices
missing_and_improvements.evidence: handleNotices builds each row from scratch ('const row = { client_id: cur.clientId, source: 'notices', reference_number: n.noticeOrderId || null, ... }' lines 2532-2540) and replaceNotices discards the previous rows; nothing compares old vs new, no gst_notice_events or history table exists in supabase/migrations (grep gst_notice_ returns only gst_notices/gst_notice_case columns).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The firm cannot answer 'what came in since yesterday', 'which due dates were extended', 'which SCN got an order' without opening the portal. Every email alert, escalation and audit trail for litigation depends on knowing the delta.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Create gst_notice_events(id, client_id, notice_id, reference_number, event text check in ('new','due_date_changed','status_changed','order_received','pdf_captured','missing_from_portal'), old_value jsonb, new_value jsonb, sync_run_id uuid, created_at, notified_at). Have the upsert_portal_notices RPC emit these rows by diffing existing vs incoming. Surface on the dashboard as an 'Activity since last visit' feed and as the source for e-mail alerts.

missing_and_improvements.title: No hook to e-mail the GST team when new notices, orders or due dates land
missing_and_improvements.evidence: kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('reminder','confirmation')), template_key text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.email_templates(key)  -- the outbox is filing-reminder only. queue-gst-reminders/index.ts header: 'For every client with reminders enabled whose return for `period` is still Data Pending, enqueue the next ladder reminder'; pg_cron (20260726130000_gst_email_cron.sql) schedules only gst-queue-reminders-daily and gst-send-outbox-hourly. grep -i notice across supabase/functions/*/index.ts, src/lib/gstReminders.ts and src/lib/taskReminders.ts returns nothing; there is no trigger on gst_notices.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A show-cause notice with a 7-day reply window can sit unseen unless someone opens the dashboard. The principal explicitly asked for 'emailing everything to GST team for every important matter'; today nothing is e-mailed for notices, refunds, DRC-03 or overdue replies.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Extend email_outbox.kind to include 'notice_alert','notice_digest','notice_escalation' and add templates (notice_new_team, notice_new_client, notice_due_7d, notice_overdue, daily_digest_team) in email_templates via the existing editable-template UI. Add a Postgres trigger on gst_notice_events (event='new' or 'due_date_changed') that inserts a pending outbox row addressed to the GST team mailbox (and optionally the client's email, subject to a clients.notice_alerts_enabled flag), with notice reference, type, issue/due date and PDF link; send-gst-email already delivers hourly. Add a second cron 'gst-notice-digest-daily' at 04:00 UTC that builds one digest per assignee (new/7-days-due/overdue) using a new edge function queue-notice-digest. Record notified_at on the event to guarantee once-only sends.

missing_and_improvements.title: Last successful sync time per client / data freshness is not shown on the dashboard
missing_and_improvements.evidence: The client_sync_log fetch (lines 175-183) selects only 'client_id, status, created_at' and is used exclusively for failedLoginsCount (line 264); no tile, header or Company card cell renders a 'last synced' time. Company List's 'Last Download Date' (line 342) comes from the latest row regardless of status, so a client whose last three runs failed still shows a recent date.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Users cannot tell whether 'Over Due 473' reflects today's portal state or a pull from last month; for litigation deadlines, stale data is worse than no data. The firm also has no list of GSTINs never synced or not synced in N days.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add a view client_sync_status (client_id, last_success_at, last_attempt_at, last_status, last_message) and show on the dashboard: a header chip 'Portal data as of <max last_success_at> · <n> clients stale >7d · <n> never synced' linking to Company List ?status=stale; add a 'Last synced' column and a red clock icon per client in the Company card; use last_success_at (not latest attempt) for 'Last Download Date'.

missing_and_improvements.title: No sync-run summary or completion signal; the dashboard never refreshes after Sync All
missing_and_improvements.evidence: The only message the app receives is the start acknowledgement: 'if (d.__gstkPullSectionAllClientsResult) { setSyncing(false); ... toast.success(`Sync started for ${count} client(s). Complete the CAPTCHA for each as it comes up.`)' (lines 205-211). appbridge.js relays no per-client progress or completion (its storage listener handles only 2B/2A/GSTR-1/GSTR-3B results), and advance() in content.js only writes a banner into the portal tab ('All N client(s) done' line 297). There is no sync_runs table.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Staff must switch to the portal tab to know where the run is, and must manually reload the dashboard to see new counts. A run that dies leaves no record that it ever existed.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add sync_runs(id, started_by, started_at, finished_at, mode, clients_total, clients_done, clients_failed, new_notices, aborted_reason) written by background.js at start and by content.js on each advance/finish; add run_id to client_sync_log. Subscribe the dashboard to Supabase Realtime on sync_runs/client_sync_log to show a progress strip ('Syncing 12/92 · 2 failed · started 10:12 by Priya') and re-query tiles when finished_at is set.

missing_and_improvements.title: No retry/backoff for Supabase writes, PDF uploads or portal API errors, and no 'retry failed clients' path
missing_and_improvements.evidence: const post = async (table, rows, prefer = 'return=minimal') => { const r = await fetch(base + table, ...); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('POST ' + table + ' -> ' + r.status ...); }  -- single attempt for sel/patch/post/del. The only retries are the session-bounce guard (content.js:185 'job.retries > 2') and wrong-CAPTCHA reload (line 505 'tries < 3'). PDF captures are best-effort 'catch (e) { pdfFail++; }' (line 2545) with no retry. The agent's portal_jobs.attempts column is incremented (agent/src/index.ts:16) but nothing re-queues a failed job.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A transient 502 from Supabase during the delete+insert of a client's notices leaves that client with zero rows (delete succeeded, insert failed) until someone notices and re-runs a full firm-wide sync with 92 CAPTCHAs.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Wrap sel/post/patch/del in a retry helper (3 attempts, 500 ms/2 s/5 s backoff, retry on network error and 5xx/429); make the write transactional through the upsert RPC so a failed insert never follows a successful delete; add a 'Retry failed' button on Company List that starts notices_bundle scoped to clients whose latest status is failed (the clientIds parameter at background.js:395 already supports this).

missing_and_improvements.title: Extension version is never checked by the app
missing_and_improvements.evidence: function announce() { window.postMessage({ __gstkExtensionReady: true }, '*'); }  -- no version field; manifest.json:4 is "version": "0.2.3" and content.js records the build only in debug messages ('build=' + chrome.runtime.getManifest().version, line 3010). The dashboard's listener (NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:204) only sets a boolean.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The extension is side-loaded ('Load unpacked', extension/README.md) on each staff PC and does not auto-update. Older builds still run older scrape logic (e.g. before the GSTR-3A Referer fix), so different staff PCs can produce different data and nobody knows which build wrote what.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Include version in the announce message ({__gstkExtensionReady:true, version}) and in every client_sync_log row (new column extension_version); keep MIN_EXTENSION_VERSION in the app and show an 'Update the GST Keeper extension (you have 0.2.1, need 0.2.3)' banner on the dashboard and Company List; disable Sync All when below minimum.

missing_and_improvements.title: No unattended/headless notice sync exists: agent has no notices job, nothing enqueues jobs, schedule disabled, CAPTCHA unsolved
missing_and_improvements.evidence: export const HANDLERS = { LOGIN_TEST, SYNC_ALL, PULL_2B, PULL_LEDGERS, PULL_GSTR1, PULL_FILING_STATUS, PUSH_GSTR1_SAVE, PUSH_GSTR3B_SAVE }  -- no PULL_NOTICES; handleSyncAll (line 476) runs only PULL_2B/PULL_LEDGERS/PULL_FILING_STATUS. grep portal_jobs|portal_agent_heartbeat in src returns only types.ts, so no app screen enqueues a job. .github/workflows/portal-agent.yml:19-23: 'Automatic schedule disabled at the firm's request ... workflow_dispatch: {}'. agent/src/captchaSolver.ts returns null; agent/src/login.ts parks the job as needs_human and waits 180 s (supabase.ts waitForHumanResponse). portal_sessions (20260715120000) stores Playwright storageState per client so a valid session skips the CAPTCHA (login.ts:19 'Reused existing session').
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Today one human must solve one CAPTCHA per client per run (92 CAPTCHAs for a full sync), so syncs happen rarely and the dashboard is chronically stale. The building blocks for a nightly job exist but are not wired to notices, and the legal position on CAPTCHA automation (agent/README.md 'Legal / risk') has not been decided by the firm.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: (1) Add PULL_NOTICES_BUNDLE to the agent that calls the same JSON endpoints the extension already proved (services/auth/api/get/notices, litserv/auth/api/case/task/get, case/folder, case/search) via page.request with the saved session, then the upsert RPC and client_sync_log; (2) add an 'Agent' panel on the dashboard showing portal_agent_heartbeat status and a 'Queue nightly sync' toggle that inserts portal_jobs for every credentialed client whose portal_sessions.updated_at is fresh; (3) a needs_human inbox in the app (CAPTCHA image from human_prompt) so staff answer only expired sessions; (4) a pg_cron job that enqueues at 02:00 IST and a repository_dispatch (already declared in the workflow) or an office-PC runner to execute; (5) a written firm decision on the CAPTCHA/ToS risk before enabling any solver. Also fix the agent's claimNextJob race for multiple runners (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED RPC, noted in agent/src/supabase.ts).

missing_and_improvements.title: Sync progress and failures are only visible as a banner inside the portal tab; the dashboard offers no live status strip
missing_and_improvements.evidence:
Extension not detected — install/enable the GST Keeper extension to use Sync All.

-- the only sync-related UI on the page apart from the Sync All button; progress text lives in content.js banner() calls such as 'client ' + (job.idx + 1) + '/' + job.clients.length (line 171) rendered inside the gst.gov.in tab.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The person who pressed Sync All has to keep the portal tab in the foreground to type CAPTCHAs anyway, but everyone else on the team (and the principal looking at the dashboard) sees no indication that a sync is running, which client is stuck, or that the run aborted.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Replace the 11px hint with a sync status card: extension state (with version), agent heartbeat state, current run progress from sync_runs (realtime), last completed run summary (ok/failed/new notices), and buttons Sync All / Retry failed / Queue for agent. Show per-client failures inline with the message from client_sync_log and a 'Fix credentials' link to the client's Credentials tab when action='login'.

missing_and_improvements.title: No email alert when a new notice is pulled or a due date approaches (every benchmark product has this)
missing_and_improvements.evidence: queue-gst-reminders reads only `.from('filing_status').select('id, client_id, return_type, period_month, target_date, status')` (line 224) and `client_reminder_settings` (line 214); `email_outbox.kind` is constrained to `CHECK (kind IN ('reminder','confirmation'))` (supabase/migrations/20260725120000_gst_reminders.sql line 47). A repo-wide grep for 'notice' across the reminders migrations, both edge functions, gstReminders.ts, taskReminders.ts and RemindersPage.tsx returns zero hits. Benchmarks: Notice Alert — "Upon successful downloading of a notice, the system can trigger notifications or alerts to the designated recipients" and "Due date reminder via email & Google / Outlook calendar" (https://www.microvistatech.com/gst-incometax-tds-notice-alert); GSTHero — "you will receive an email notification on new notice or due dates" (https://gsthero.com/gst-litigation-management-tool/); Masters India — "instant email notifications ... automatic alerts 7 and 14 days before deadlines" (https://www.mastersindia.co/notice-management-software/, via search summary); My Notice Track — "Detailed notifications sent instantly to your inbox the moment a notice is issued" (https://mynoticetrack.com/).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: 473 of 1060 notices are already overdue on the screenshot. Nobody in the GST team is told when a notice lands or when a reply window is closing unless they open this page; a missed DRC-01 reply window converts to an ex-parte order and a demand.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Extend the existing pipeline rather than build a new one: (a) widen `email_outbox.kind` CHECK to add 'notice_new','notice_due','notice_overdue','notice_digest'; (b) add `notice_id uuid` to email_outbox; (c) new edge function `queue-notice-alerts` scheduled on the same pg_cron block (20260726130000_gst_email_cron.sql) that scans gst_notices where pulled_at > last run (new-notice alert to a firm-level `notice_alert_recipients` list stored in settings), due_date/extended_due_date in {7,3,1} days (reminder to assignee + GST team), and due_date < today with staff_status != 'Closed' (escalation to gst_manager/superadmin); (d) three editable templates in `email_templates` (merge fields: GSTIN, trade name, notice type, ref no, issue/due date, amount of demand, PDF link); (e) a 'Notice alerts' tab on RemindersPage to configure recipients and offsets. send-gst-email already drains the outbox hourly, so delivery needs no new code.

missing_and_improvements.title: No WhatsApp channel for notice alerts
missing_and_improvements.evidence: The only transport is `async function sendMail(token: string, to: string, subject: string, body: string)` (line 47); `grep -rni 'whatsapp\|sms' src supabase/functions` returns no notice-related hits. Benchmarks: Turia — "Update clients over WhatsApp and email" (https://turia.in/notice-management-software/); My Notice Track — "Get critical alerts on WhatsApp for instant access" (https://mynoticetrack.com/); GST Notice AI — "WhatsApp alerts 7 days and 3 days before due date" (https://gstnoticeai.com/); Suvit — "built-in WhatsApp and email integrations that automate follow-ups with clients" (https://www.suvit.io/suvit-chat, via search summary).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Indian SME clients read WhatsApp, not email. A reply-window reminder that reaches the client's phone is what actually gets the documents in.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add a `channel` column ('email' | 'whatsapp') to email_outbox and a second sender in _shared (WhatsApp Cloud API or a provider like Interakt/Gupshup, credentials in Supabase secrets). Reuse the queue-notice-alerts function to enqueue one row per channel; store `clients.whatsapp_number` (or reuse `mobile`). Keep templates in email_templates with a `channel` discriminator since WhatsApp templates must be pre-approved.

missing_and_improvements.title: Only Open/Closed status — no litigation lifecycle stages, forums or case grouping
missing_and_improvements.evidence: `const STATUS_OPEN_CLOSED = ['Open', 'Closed'];` (line 69) and `supabase.from('gst_notices').update({ staff_status: newStatus })` (line 404) are the entire workflow. Migration 20260824100700 adds only staff_status/reply_*/order_*/submission_* columns; there is no stage, forum, outcome or parent-case column and no linking table between an SCN row, its order row and an appeal row. Benchmarks: Cygnet — "tracks the entire lifecycle of a case from notice of issuance ... through replies, hearings, appeals, and higher judicial forums" and "Tasks should move and be tracked through stages like 'received,' 'in progress,' 'awaiting response,' and 'closed'" (https://www.cygnet.one/blog/key-features-of-gst-litigation-management-software/, https://www.cygnet.one/blog/what-is-litigation-management-system/); IRIS LMS — "manage appeal processes across various forums including ... CESTAT, High Courts, and Supreme Court" (https://irisgst.com/gst-litigation-management-system/, via search summary; page now redirects to sovos.com); Jamku — "Stay on top of orders, additional notices, proceedings, appeals, and closure orders" (https://portal.jamku.app/).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The dashboard shows Open = Total (1060/1060) because 'Open' is the only non-terminal state. A partner cannot tell which matters are awaiting reply, which are at personal hearing, which have an order that is inside the 3-month APL-01 window, and which are at appellate/tribunal level — the core question of a litigation ERP.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add `stage text` to gst_notices with a CHECK on a fixed ladder: 'Received','Under Review','Reply Drafted','Reply Filed','PH Scheduled','Order Received','Appeal Filed','Appellate Order','Tribunal','High Court','Supreme Court','Closed'; add `forum text`, `outcome text` ('Dropped','Confirmed','Partly Confirmed','Remanded'), `appeal_due_date date` auto-derived as order_date + 3 months. Add a `gst_litigation_cases` table (id, client_id, title, section, financial_year, stage, amount_at_stake, assigned_to) and `gst_notices.litigation_case_id` FK so SCN → order → APL-01 → APL-04 rows roll up into one matter; the Additional Notice Folder page becomes the matter view. Replace the Status Select in NoticeWorkflowListView with a stage picker; the dashboard Notice Summary gains a stage-wise breakdown (a 'Stage' pivot next to the category pivot).

missing_and_improvements.title: No hearing-date tracking or hearing calendar
missing_and_improvements.evidence: The full staff-editable column set is `case_id, issued_by, extended_due_date, amount_of_demand, remarks, financial_year, assign_to` (lines 8-14) — no hearing_date. The dashboard calendar only marks `issue_date` and `due_date` (NoticesDashboardPage.tsx lines 296-305). Benchmarks: IRIS LMS — "alerts for various due dates for pending replies, appeals, personal hearings, and written submissions ... court hearing calendars and alerts" (https://irisgst.com/gst-litigation-management-system/, via search summary); GST Notice AI — "Track all hearing dates across notices and clients. AI generates preparation notes and document checklists for each hearing" (https://gstnoticeai.com/); Cygnet — "court hearing calendars and alerts" (https://www.cygnet.one/blog/what-is-litigation-management-system/).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Personal hearing dates under s.75(4) are the one deadline where non-attendance directly produces an adverse order; today they live in someone's diary, not the system.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add `hearing_date date`, `hearing_time text`, `hearing_mode text` ('Physical','Video'), `hearing_officer text`, `adjournment_count int` to gst_notices (or a child `gst_notice_hearings` table to keep the adjournment history). Add a third marker colour on the dashboard calendar and a 'Hearings this week' list widget in the empty space under Company/Calendar. Include hearing_date in the queue-notice-alerts reminders (D-3, D-1).

missing_and_improvements.title: No Google/Outlook calendar export of issue, due and hearing dates
missing_and_improvements.evidence: Calendar day buttons only `onClick={() => navigate(drillParams({ date: iso }))}` (line 507); no .ics generation or calendar link exists anywhere in the notices pages. Benchmark: Notice Alert — "Add due date, issue dates and compliance date to outlook & Google calendar" (https://www.microvistatech.com/gst-incometax-tds-notice-alert).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Staff and partners already run their day from Google Calendar; a due date that is not in that calendar is a due date that gets missed.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add an 'Add to calendar' action in the NoticeWorkflowListView edit dialog and case folder page that builds an .ics blob client-side (due_date, extended_due_date, hearing_date) and a Google Calendar deep-link; optionally an edge function `notices-ical` that serves a per-staff subscribable feed (token in URL) so due/hearing dates auto-appear in Outlook/Google.

missing_and_improvements.title: No demand-at-risk / amount-exposure view on the dashboard
missing_and_improvements.evidence: `kpiCards` (lines 279-288) are all row counts; `amount_of_demand` exists on gst_notices (20260824104900 line 12) and is selected on AllClientsNoticesPage but is never summed or shown on the dashboard. There are no columns for tax/interest/penalty split, pre-deposit or risk class. Benchmarks: ClearTax — leadership dashboard with "real-time overview of overdue cases, demand at risk and time-critical cases" (https://cleartax.in/s/gst-notice-management-at-scale); GSTHero — "You can clearly understand the no. of notices asking for demand amount through various graph" (https://gsthero.com/gst-litigation-management-tool/); Cygnet — "Risk classification using PPR (Possible, Probable, Remote)" and "Penalties, pre-deposits, and litigation-related payments are logged against individual cases" (https://www.cygnet.one/blog/key-features-of-gst-litigation-management-software/).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A partner's first question is 'how much money is under dispute and where' — for contingent-liability notes in client audits and to prioritise a ₹40 lakh DRC-01 over forty ₹5,000 late-fee notices.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add `tax_amount, interest_amount, penalty_amount numeric`, `pre_deposit_paid numeric`, `risk_class text CHECK IN ('Possible','Probable','Remote')` to gst_notices. Add two KPI tiles: 'Demand under dispute ₹' and 'Overdue demand ₹'; add a Demand column to the Notice Summary table; add Report > 'Demand Exposure by Client' (contingent-liability schedule, PDF/Excel via existing jspdf/xlsx helpers) and link DRC-03 payments from gst_drc03_filings to the case for net exposure.

missing_and_improvements.title: No charts, trends or ageing analytics although the recharts kit is already in the repo
missing_and_improvements.evidence: Imports (lines 15-37) contain no chart component; `grep -rln recharts src/pages src/components` returns only `src/components/ui/chart.tsx` and `src/components/reports/views/AnnualTrendView.tsx`. Benchmarks: GSTHero — "360° Bird's eye view on pending litigations across the organization and various analytics graphs" (https://gsthero.com/gst-litigation-management-tool/); IRIS LMS — "extensive reporting and an analytics dashboard" (https://irisgst.com/gst-litigation-management-system/, via search summary).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The screenshot has a large blank area under Company/Calendar and every number is a static count; a manager cannot see whether the backlog is growing, which categories drive it, or how old the overdue items are.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Fill the empty band with three `ChartContainer` cards from src/components/ui/chart.tsx: (1) 12-month issued vs closed bars; (2) overdue ageing buckets 0-7 / 8-30 / 31-90 / 90+ days (clickable to /notices-all with a new `age=` param); (3) open-by-category donut. Data is already in `rows`; compute with useMemo. Follow docs/UI-UX-REDESIGN.md tokens (chart.tsx is the one place raw palette is allowed).

missing_and_improvements.title: Assignment is free text — no named owner, no 'my queue', no SLA escalation
missing_and_improvements.evidence: `<Input id="assign-to" placeholder="Staff member" .../>` (line 1083) writes to `assign_to text` (20260824104900 line 14) with no FK to users; the dashboard has no assignee filter or per-staff widget and nothing escalates. Benchmarks: Turia — "Turn a detected notice into a task with an owner and a response deadline" (https://turia.in/notice-management-software/); Cygnet — "Notices should be auto-assigned based on logic, such as GSTIN, region, or issue category" (https://www.cygnet.one/blog/what-is-litigation-management-system/) and "maker-checker processes, clear task ownership, and approval hierarchies" (https://www.cygnet.one/blog/key-features-of-gst-litigation-management-software/); ClearTax — "System-driven escalation with overdue alerts and SLA dashboards" (https://cleartax.in/s/gst-notice-management-at-scale).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: With 1060 notices and 92 GSTINs, 'who is on this' is the operating question. Free text cannot be filtered, cannot drive a reminder email, and lets a notice sit unowned.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add `assigned_to_user_id uuid` (FK to the staff users table used by get_user_snapshot) plus `assigned_at`, `reviewed_by_user_id`; replace the Input with a SearchableSelect of staff; default new pulled notices to the client's default handler (add `clients.notice_handler_user_id`). Dashboard: a 'My queue' panel (assigned to me, sorted by due date) and a 'Workload by staff' mini table (open / due 7d / overdue per person). Escalation: queue-notice-alerts emails the gst_manager when an assigned notice is overdue > 3 days or unassigned > 2 days.

missing_and_improvements.title: No per-notice activity log / audit trail
missing_and_improvements.evidence: None of the notices migrations (20260817180000, 20260824100700, 20260824104900, 20260825120000, 20260828160000) create an event/history table (`grep -n -i 'audit|activity_log|history'` returns nothing). missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The reply, its annexures, the DRC-06 acknowledgement and the client's supporting invoices live in email and Drive today; the case folder page shows only what the portal returned.

Multi-file upload in the edit dialog and on AdditionalNoticeFolderPage as a 'Firm documents' section beside the portal sections; include doc links in client-notification emails.

missing_and_improvements.title: No reply templates or AI-assisted reply drafting
missing_and_improvements.evidence: The case folder page renders portal sections and PDFs only (Card at line 418 onward); there is no 'Draft reply' action, no template table, and no LLM/edge-function call anywhere in src/components/notices or the notices pages. Benchmarks: ClearTax — "Pre-structured templates pre-populated with notice-period data" (https://cleartax.in/s/gst-notice-management-at-scale); Cygnet — "notice parsing, grounds identification, finding court judgements and assisted response drafting" (https://www.cygnet.one/blog/what-is-litigation-management-system/); GST Notice AI — "Reads the notice, identifies legal issues, finds relevant CGST/IGST Act sections and CBIC circulars, and drafts a response letter" (https://gstnoticeai.com/); GSTHero lists "Reply templates" as upcoming (https://gsthero.com/gst-litigation-management-tool/).

missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add `notice_reply_templates (id, notice_form, title, body_md, merge_fields)` editable from Settings (mirror the editable_email_messages pattern). 'Draft reply' button on the case folder page renders the template with the notice's fields into a .docx (existing docx tooling) and saves it as a 'Reply draft' document. Phase 2: optional edge function `draft-notice-reply` calling Claude with the notice PDF text and the template, output always saved as draft, never auto-filed.

missing_and_improvements.title: Manual Add Notice requires hand-typing every field; no PDF/OCR extraction
missing_and_improvements.evidence: `handleSubmit` validates `form.clientId || !form.refId.trim() || !form.type || !form.issuedDate` (lines 46-49) — all keyed by hand; the attachment is stored but not parsed. missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Offline notices (post, email from officer, IT/TDS) are the ones most likely to be mis-keyed and therefore mis-dated.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: On file select in AddNoticeDialog, call an edge function `parse-notice-pdf` (pdf text extraction; regex for GSTIN, Ref No, DIN, dates, section, amount; fallback to Claude) and pre-fill the form for review. Low priority — portal-pulled rows already carry fields.

missing_and_improvements.title: Clients cannot see their notices and there is no one-click 'notify client'
missing_and_improvements.evidence: `if (!isStaffRole()) return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />;` (line 236; same guard in CompanyProfilePage, AllClientsNoticesPage, AdditionalNoticeFolderPage). `grep -rni notice src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx` returns nothing, so the client role has no notice surface at all, and no page has a 'send to client' action. Benchmarks: Turia — "Update clients over WhatsApp and email as responses progress" and "Every notice stays linked to its client" (https://turia.in/notice-management-software/); Suvit — "multi-client dashboards and automated communication tools, including WhatsApp reminders" (https://www.suvit.io/post/best-gst-software-2025, via search summary).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The client is the one who must produce documents and pay pre-deposits; today staff forward PDFs by hand and clients call to ask status.

Add a 'Notify client' button on the row/edit dialog that enqueues an email_outbox row (kind 'notice_client') using an editable template and the client's `email`; log it to gst_notice_events.

missing_and_improvements.title: Dashboard shows counts only — no 'needs attention today' list of actual notices
missing_and_improvements.evidence: '7 Days Due' and 'Over Due' are single numbers `{ label: '7 Days Due', value: dueSoon, ...}` (lines 285-286); the only row-level content on the page is the 5-row Company table (lines 451-468). Benchmarks: Turia — "Every open notice on one dashboard" showing what is "open, due soon or overdue" (https://turia.in/notice-management-software/); ClearTax — "time-critical cases" surfaced on the leadership dashboard (https://cleartax.in/s/gst-notice-management-at-scale); GST Notice AI — "Visual countdown for every notice" (https://gstnoticeai.com/).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A tile that says '7 Days Due: 0' or 'Over Due: 473' forces a click-through; a partner opening the page should see the ten most urgent matters with GSTIN, type, due date, assignee and amount without leaving the page.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Replace the blank band under Company/Calendar with an 'Attention today' card: top 10 open notices ordered by (hearing_date, extended_due_date ?? due_date) ascending, columns GSTIN/Trade name/Type/Due/Days left/Assignee/Amount, each row linking to the case folder, with High priority rows tinted `destructive/10`. Source is already loaded in `rows`; add `amount_of_demand`, `assign_to`, `reference_number` to the select on line 148.

missing_and_improvements.title: Notice sync is manual, per-client CAPTCHA-gated and has no freshness indicator
missing_and_improvements.evidence: `handleSyncAll` (lines 222-234) posts `__gstkPullSectionAllClients` to the extension and the success toast reads "Complete the CAPTCHA for each as it comes up." (line 208); agent/README.md lines 127-129: "`login.ts` calls `autoSolveCaptcha()` ... left unimplemented on purpose (returns null)". No 'last synced' timestamp is shown on the dashboard although client_sync_log exists (20260828100000). Benchmarks: Masters India — "auto-fetches notices and orders daily from GST, Income Tax, and Traces (TDS) portals" (https://www.mastersindia.co/notice-management-software/, via search summary); My Notice Track — "Automatic 24/7 tracking of GST and Income Tax portals" (https://mynoticetrack.com/); Cygnet — "pull notices as soon as they are issued, in real time" (https://www.cygnet.one/blog/what-is-litigation-management-system/).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: 'Last 24 Hours: 64' measures when someone last clicked Sync All, not when notices were issued; a client whose sync failed three weeks ago silently disappears from every KPI. GSTN's terms and the CAPTCHA make fully unattended fetch legally and technically constrained, so visibility of staleness is the realistic win.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: (a) Add a 'Sync freshness' strip on the dashboard: clients never synced / synced > 7 days ago / failed last attempt, computed from `client_sync_log` already fetched (lines 174-185), each linking to /notices-company-list pre-filtered; (b) show `Last synced` per row on Company List and Company Profile; (c) a daily digest email listing stale/failed clients (part of queue-notice-alerts); (d) longer term, run the Windows agent's notices job on a schedule with a human CAPTCHA queue (agent/README already documents the scheduler pattern).

missing_and_improvements.title: No structured tagging by section, issue type, state or FY — dashboard filter is only Registration / Other
missing_and_improvements.evidence: Type Of Notices select offers only `all`, `registration`, `other` (lines 340-342), and `financial_year` is a free-text Input (NoticeWorkflowListView line 1078); no `section`, `issue_tag` or `state` column exists in the migrations. Benchmark: Cygnet — "organizes them by GSTIN, state, financial year, and case status" and "Smart Issue Tagging ... classify disputes by department, statute, business unit, or issue type" (https://www.cygnet.one/blog/key-features-of-gst-litigation-management-software/).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A firm handling 92 GSTINs across states needs 'all s.73 ITC-mismatch notices for FY 2019-20 in Gujarat' as a two-click filter for bulk strategy and for the audit-trail of a common ground of appeal.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add `section_invoked text`, `issue_tags text[]`, `tax_period_from/to date` to gst_notices; derive `state` from GSTIN prefix (clients.gstin[0:2]) at query time. Replace the single select with a filter bar (FY, State, Section, Issue tag, Assignee, Priority) whose values propagate through `drillParams` so tiles, summary table and charts all honour it.

missing_and_improvements.title: MIS reports limited to two: Notice Summary and GSTIN-wise count
missing_and_improvements.evidence: Report dropdown contains exactly two entries `/notices-report` and `/notices-gstin-wise-count` (lines 42-53). Benchmarks: Cygnet — "generate standard and custom reports by notice issue type, GSTIN-wise, region, or legal status" and "Audit-ready reports provide complete, end-to-end visibility into notices, responses, approvals, and outcomes" (https://www.cygnet.one/blog/what-is-litigation-management-system/, https://www.cygnet.one/blog/key-features-of-gst-litigation-management-software/); GSTHero roadmap — "Reports and dashboards", "Litigation cost tracking" (https://gsthero.com/gst-litigation-management-tool/).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Partners need a monthly MIS (backlog, ageing, staff workload, demand exposure, outcomes) and clients need a per-GSTIN litigation status statement for their auditors; neither exists.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add to the Report dropdown: Ageing (buckets x category), Staff Workload, Demand Exposure by Client (contingent liability), Stage/Outcome report, Per-client Litigation Statement (PDF via noticeFormatPdfExport.ts pattern). Add a monthly cron that emails the MIS PDF to superadmin/gst_manager via email_outbox.

missing_and_improvements.title: Only one permission key governs the whole notices module — no approver/manager roles
missing_and_improvements.evidence: `return hasPermission('edit_notice_status');` (line 529) is the sole notice-specific gate; NoticeWorkflowListView uses it for status, priority and the full edit dialog alike, and every staff role can read every client's notices. Benchmarks: GST Notice AI — "Role-based access for partners, managers, and junior staff" (https://gstnoticeai.com/); GSTHero roadmap — "Access control for users" (https://gsthero.com/gst-litigation-management-tool/); Cygnet — "maker-checker processes ... approval hierarchies" (https://www.cygnet.one/blog/key-features-of-gst-litigation-management-software/).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A junior should be able to draft and log a reply but not mark a matter Closed or change the demand amount; a manager should have to approve a reply before it is filed.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add permission keys `assign_notices`, `close_notices`, `approve_notice_reply`, `send_client_notice_email` to user_permissions and matching `can*()` helpers; gate the stage transitions ('Reply Filed', 'Closed') and the demand/amount fields on them. Optional `clients.restricted_to_user_ids` to scope employee visibility.

missing_and_improvements.title: Portal outstanding-demand / liability ledger is not captured alongside notices
missing_and_improvements.evidence: The firm-wide fetch reads `gst_notices`, `gst_refund_applications`, `gst_drc03_filings` only (lines 118-131); there is no table or extension handler for the Electronic Liability Register / outstanding demand (DRC-07) balance. Benchmarks: Jamku — "Manage and monitor outstanding demands effortlessly" (https://portal.jamku.app/); ClearTax — "Integrated access to returns, ITC ledgers, and invoices linked to notice periods" (https://cleartax.in/s/gst-notice-management-at-scale).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A DRC-07 demand that has crystallised in the liability register is a recovery risk (s.79) that the Recovery row of the summary table (currently 1) does not reflect.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add an extension capture for the liability register Part-II (other than return) into `gst_demand_ledger (client_id, demand_id, order_no, period, tax, interest, penalty, status, pulled_at)` and surface an 'Outstanding demand ₹' tile plus a Recovery-risk list on the dashboard.

missing_and_improvements.title: No Income Tax / TDS notice coverage (all benchmark products span GST + IT + TDS)
missing_and_improvements.evidence: All data comes from `(q) => q.eq('source', 'notices')` on gst_notices (line 149); the extension and agent target only the GST portal. Benchmarks: Notice Alert — "Auto Fetching Notice from GST, Income tax & TDS Portal" (https://www.microvistatech.com/gst-incometax-tds-notice-alert); Turia — "Tracks GST, Income Tax, and TDS notices" (https://turia.in/notice-management-software/); Jamku — "syncs data directly from Income Tax, GST, TDS portals" (https://portal.jamku.app/).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The firm's litigation exposure is not GST-only; a single dashboard is the pitch of every competitor. Out of scope for a GST product today but should be a known gap in the roadmap.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Keep the GST-only scope for now; design the new lifecycle/assignment/alert tables with a `tax_type text` discriminator ('GST' default) so IT/TDS notices (entered manually via AddNoticeDialog or a future agent job) reuse the same workflow, alerts and reports without a second module.

missing_and_improvements.title: No mobile push / app presence for alerts
missing_and_improvements.evidence: The app is a responsive web shell (docs/UI-UX-REDESIGN.md Phase 4: sidebar becomes a Sheet drawer below md); there is no PWA manifest, service worker or push subscription in the repo. Benchmarks: Notice Alert ships Android and iOS apps (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.microvistatech.noticealert_final, https://apps.apple.com/us/app/-/id6702021191); My Notice Track — "Access your compliance dashboard and alerts on any device" (https://mynoticetrack.com/).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Partners check deadlines from the phone; a push on 'new DRC-01 for X, due in 30 days' is the cheapest alert channel after email.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add a PWA manifest + service worker (vite-plugin-pwa) and Web Push (VAPID keys in Supabase secrets; `push_subscriptions` table); have queue-notice-alerts fan out to push in addition to email. Lower priority than email/WhatsApp.

missing_and_improvements.title: No detail page/drawer for a plain notice — most rows have no click target beyond a 23-column grid row

Route /notices/:id for deep links from emails.

missing_and_improvements.title: staff_status is free text with only Open/Closed in the UI; no litigation lifecycle states
missing_and_improvements.evidence: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS staff_status text — no CHECK/enum; UI offers const STATUS_OPEN_CLOSED = ['Open', 'Closed'] (NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx:69) and isClosed compares lowercase 'closed' (noticeSummaryReport.ts:44). 'Replied' is synthesised from reply_date only (NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx:288-293).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A CA firm's litigation pipeline is New → Under Review → Reply Drafted → Reply Filed → Hearing Scheduled → Order Received → Appeal Filed / Closed / Dropped. With two states the firm cannot see where each matter sits, who is waiting on the client, or which orders need an appeal within the 3-month limitation.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Migration: CREATE TYPE notice_status AS ENUM ('new','under_review','awaiting_client','reply_drafted','reply_filed','hearing_scheduled','order_received','appeal_filed','closed','dropped'); ALTER gst_notices ADD COLUMN status_v2 notice_status DEFAULT 'new', backfill from staff_status, add closed_reason text and closed_at timestamptz; drive isClosed off the enum; keep 'Open' KPIs = not in (closed, dropped).

missing_and_improvements.title: Closing/reopening a notice needs no reason, no order reference, and leaves no trace
missing_and_improvements.evidence: const { error } = await supabase.from('gst_notices').update({ staff_status: newStatus }).eq('id', rowId); — one column written; bulk path applyBulkStatus (line 435) identical. No updated_by column exists (grep migrations for gst_notices trigger/updated_by/audit returns nothing) and updated_at has no trigger.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: A partner cannot tell who closed a notice, when, or why (order accepted? demand paid via DRC-03? appeal filed?). Closed can be flipped back to Open by anyone with edit_notice_status with no record. This fails basic audit expectations for a firm's litigation register.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add table gst_notice_events (id, notice_id FK, client_id, event_type text, from_value, to_value, note, actor_user_id, actor_name, created_at) written from a small src/lib/noticeEvents.ts helper on every status/priority/assign/field change and bulk action; require a Close dialog with reason (enum) + optional order_number/order_date/DRC-03 ARN; show the timeline in the drawer's Activity tab.

missing_and_improvements.title: Assign To is a free-text box, not a staff picker — no 'my notices' view, no assignee filter or column count
missing_and_improvements.evidence: <Input id="assign-to" placeholder="Staff member" value={editForm.assignTo} ... /> writing to gst_notices.assign_to text (supabase/migrations/20260824104900_gst_notices_extra_fields.sql:15). missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add assigned_to_user_id uuid REFERENCES profiles(id) (keep assign_to as display name), a SearchableSelect of profiles in the edit dialog, an 'Assignee' toolbar filter defaulting to 'Me' for employees, a 'Bulk Assign' toolbar button, and an Assignee/Unassigned breakdown on the dashboard.

missing_and_improvements.title: No email or notification of any kind for notices — the reminder pipeline never reads gst_notices
missing_and_improvements.evidence: The queue function reads only client_reminder_settings (214), filing_status (224), clients (238), client_scheme_history (243), email_templates (267), return_reminder_schedules (273) and writes email_outbox; grep for 'notice' across supabase/functions/, supabase/migrations/20260725120000_gst_reminders.sql, 20260828110000_staff_task_reminders.sql, src/lib/gstReminders.ts, src/lib/taskReminders.ts and src/pages/RemindersPage.tsx returns no matches.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The principal's explicit ask is 'emailing everything to GST team for every important matter'. Today a new SCN with a 7-day reply window can sit unseen unless someone opens the dashboard; there is no new-notice alert, no due-in-3-days alert, no overdue escalation, no daily digest, and no client-facing intimation.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add gst_notice_alert_settings (team_emails text[], digest_time, days_before_due int[] default {7,3,1}, escalate_overdue bool) and a queue-notice-alerts edge function on the existing pg_cron (20260726130000_gst_email_cron.sql) that inserts into email_outbox: (a) 'New notices found' per sync using first_seen_at, (b) due-soon per notice with deep link /notices/:id, (c) overdue escalation to gst_manager, (d) a 08:00 daily digest grouped by assignee; plus a per-notice 'Email client' action using the corporate template from 20260726140000_corporate_email_templates.sql, logged to gst_notice_events.

missing_and_improvements.title: No ageing / days-to-due columns and no colour-coding of overdue rows in the list
missing_and_improvements.evidence: headers: ['GSTIN','Trade Name','Reference No.','Case ID','Type','Description','Issue Date','Due Date','Extended Due Date','Status','Priority', ... 'Assign To','PDF'] — no Ageing or Days-to-due column; NoticeWorkflowListView renders Due Date as a plain cell via formatCell (line 890-901) with no destructive/warning styling.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Staff must mentally compute days left for every row; the table cannot be sorted by urgency and a 2-days-left notice looks identical to one due next quarter.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Append computed columns 'Age (days)' = today − issue_date and 'Days to due' = effectiveDueDate − today (negative = overdue) with Badge variant destructive (<0), warning (0-7), default; make these the default sort when filter=due7/overdue; add a row-level left border colour by urgency.

missing_and_improvements.title: No column sorting — list is hard-wired to newest issue date first
missing_and_improvements.evidence: if (dateColIdx !== -1) { list = [...list].sort((a, b) => { ... return db - da; // newest first }); } — no sort state, TableHead has no onClick (lines 733-744).
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Partners want 'largest demand first' or 'earliest due first'; staff want 'by client' to batch replies. None of these are possible without exporting to Excel.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add sortKey/sortDir state, clickable TableHead with ArrowUpDown icon, numeric sort for Amount of Demand and date sort for date columns via parseDateLoose; persist per-view sort in the URL (?sort=due&dir=asc).

missing_and_improvements.title: Bulk toolbar covers only Status and Priority — no bulk assign, extended due date, export-selected, or email
missing_and_improvements.evidence: Two buttons only: 'Update Status' (line 686-693) and 'Priority' (line 695-703); 'Export to Excel' (line 714) exports the whole table, ignoring selectedIdx.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: With 1060 rows, triage is done in batches (assign 20 ASMT-10s to one employee, push an extended due date after an adjournment, email a set to the team). Each is a 20-click job today.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Extend the selection toolbar with Assign, Set Extended Due Date, Add Remark, Email GST team (opens compose with selected refs), Export selected (Excel/PDF); keep the 'x selected' pill and add 'Select all N matching' across pages.

missing_and_improvements.title: Logging a reply and closing the notice are two separate interactions; the Edit dialog cannot change status
missing_and_improvements.evidence: saveEdit writes priority, reply_ref_number, reply_date, order_number, order_date, submission_arn, submission_date, extended_due_date, amount_of_demand, remarks, financial_year, assign_to — staff_status is absent; status only via the per-row Select (line 825) or bulk dialog.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The most common flow ('reply filed today, mark it done') requires opening the dialog, saving, then finding the row again and changing the Select — the reason Replied stays empty is that the two-step flow is skipped.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Replace the single 12-field dialog with intent actions in the drawer: 'Log reply' (ref, date, attachment, auto-status reply_filed), 'Log order' (no, date, demand, attachment, auto-status order_received + prompt 'file appeal by <date+3 months>'), 'Log hearing', 'Close' (reason). Each writes gst_notice_events.

missing_and_improvements.title: 'Submission' nav link works but only for manually keyed submission fields; case-folder REPLIES are never counted
missing_and_improvements.evidence: if (filter === 'submitted') list = list.filter((r) => !!r.submission_date || !!r.submission_arn); — implemented, but the fields come only from the Edit dialog (NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx:502-503); replies captured from the portal live in gst_case_folder_items with folder_section 'REPLY' (AdditionalNoticeFolderPage.tsx:61) and are never joined.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The portal already knows a reply was filed (RFD-09/DRC-06 in the REPLIES folder) yet 'Submission' and the Replied column stay empty unless staff retype the ARN — the 0 in Replied on the live dashboard is a symptom.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: After replaceCaseFolderItems, have the extension patch the parent gst_notices row (reply_ref_number, reply_date, order_number, order_date from REPLIES/ORDRS items when null); alternatively compute 'replied' in computeNoticeSummary via a case_id join to gst_case_folder_items.

missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Partners review litigation on paper/PDF in client meetings and clients ask 'where do my matters stand'; today someone reformats an Excel dump by hand.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add src/utils/noticeStatusPdfExport.ts using jsPDF + autoTable + drawFirmLogo: per-client register (ref, type, section, issue, due, status, assignee, reply/order, demand, next action) with an open/closed summary header; buttons on CompanyProfilePage and the drawer ('Print status report'); a firm-wide variant grouped by client for the partner pack.

missing_and_improvements.title: Company Profile KPI tiles are not clickable and lists are capped at 5 with no filters
missing_and_improvements.evidence: const kpiCards = [ { label: 'Total Notices', value: totalNotices, icon: ... } ... ] — no `to` field, unlike NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:280; lists use filteredNotices.slice(0, 5) (line 369) and submissions.slice(0, 5) (line 393).

missing_and_improvements.title: Only one coarse permission key governs all notice editing; no separate keys for assign, close, delete, or bulk
missing_and_improvements.evidence: const canEditNoticeStatus = useCallback((): boolean => { ... return hasPermission('edit_notice_status'); }) — the single key gates the inline Select, bulk Status/Priority, the 12-field Edit dialog (NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx:179-180) and Add Notice (AllClientsNoticesPage.tsx:298). missing_and_improvements.title: No 'what needs my attention today' view; dashboard has no realtime refresh or new-notice marker
missing_and_improvements.evidence: Data loads once in useEffect (lines 142-198) with no supabase.channel()/postgres_changes subscription (grep returns nothing) and no per-user scoping; the main DashboardPage.tsx has no notices widget (grep -i notice returns nothing).

missing_and_improvements.title: CONFIRMED: 'Last 24 Hours' counts rows re-inserted by yesterday's sync, not new notices
missing_and_improvements.evidence: `const last24Hours = displayRows.filter((r) => daysAgo(r.pulled_at) <= 1).length;` Live: all 64 counted rows have pulled_at 2026-09-12T12:01 and belong to 6 clients (ACCU-PANELS 23, ACCURATE PMS 21, ABHIPUSHP 10, ABHIJEET SATANI 4, AHMEDABAD PROCON 3, AMADIUS INFRA 3); the newest issue_date among them is 2026-07-17. Only 3 rows in the whole table were issued in the last 15 days. Because background.js L102-104 `replaceNotices` deletes and re-inserts every row for a client, pulled_at is reset on every sync.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The partner reads '64 new notices since yesterday' when zero new notices arrived; the tile is a sync-activity counter mislabelled as a notice counter.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Either relabel the tile 'Rows re-synced in last 24h' or compute 'new' properly: keep created_at stable via an upsert keyed on (client_id, reference_number) (0 duplicate pairs exist live, so a UNIQUE index can be created today) and count rows whose first_seen_at is within 24h; drill-down AllClientsNoticesPage.tsx L171 uses the same pulled_at filter and must change with it.

Consider `externally_connectable` with runtime.sendMessage instead of window.postMessage.

missing_and_improvements.title: Accepted design: with RLS open to public, any logged-in client user (or anyone holding the anon key) can read and write the whole litigation dataset — quantified blast radius
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: This is the documented CLAUDE.md position ("RLS open to public ... let login, staff-only routing and the permission keys be the gate"), so it is not a bug to patch with auth.uid(). But it means the security of every client's SCNs, orders, refund files, DRC-03 payments and portal passwords rests entirely on client-side code: any client user with DevTools can `supabase.from('clients').select('gst_password')`, `delete()` all 1060 notices, or rewrite a notice's status/reply fields. Before e-mail alerts go to clients, the firm should decide explicitly that this residual risk is acceptable, and at minimum must not extend it to storage (see the bucket findings).
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Keep the open-RLS design if the firm accepts it, but (1) move gst_password out of the anon-readable row: store it encrypted (pgsodium / pgp_sym_encrypt with a key in Vault) and expose it only through a SECURITY DEFINER RPC `get_client_portal_credentials(client_id, session_token)` that checks a server-side session table and logs access; the extension/agent call that RPC instead of `select gst_password`; (2) issue a signed app session token at login (RPC returns it, client sends it as a header) so later policies can use `current_setting('request.headers')` without a Supabase Auth migration; (3) record this decision and the counts above in docs/ as an accepted-risk register entry.

missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: The Sync All job copies 121 plaintext portal passwords into the extension's chrome.storage.local (readable from chrome://extensions > service worker devtools and from disk on the staff PC) every time it runs, on top of the plaintext column.
