missing_and_improvements.title: No retention policy or legal-hold concept for GST notices and orders (s.36 CGST)
missing_and_improvements.evidence: gst_notices carries financial_year (20260824104900:14) and staff_status (20260824100700:8) but no retention_until, legal_hold or disposal columns; nothing in src/ or migrations mentions retention (grep -ri 'retention|legal hold|s\.36|section 36' src supabase docs returns nothing). Deletion paths (CompanyListPage.tsx:193, ClientsPage.tsx:141, background.js:103) have no check against pending status.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: Section 36 CGST requires books and records to be retained until the expiry of 72 months from the due date of the annual return for the year, and a taxpayer who is a party to an appeal, revision or any proceeding must retain them for one year after final disposal or the 72 months, whichever is later. Every destructive path in this app is rated 'irreversible, unlogged, no hold check' against that standard.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Add `retention_until date` (generated: annual-return due date for financial_year + 72 months) and `legal_hold boolean default false` to gst_notices/gst_refund_applications/gst_drc03_filings; set legal_hold automatically when staff_status is Open/Replied or an order/appeal field is filled; make the archive trigger reject hard deletes (RAISE EXCEPTION) while legal_hold or now() < retention_until; expose a 'Records on hold' count on the dashboard and a disposal register listing rows past retention that a superadmin may archive.

missing_and_improvements.title: Any holder of the anon key can delete litigation rows and PDFs without logging in
missing_and_improvements.evidence: 20260817180000:71-73 `CREATE POLICY "gst_notices_all" ON public.gst_notices FOR ALL TO public USING (true) WITH CHECK (true)` (same for gst_refund_applications, gst_drc03_filings); 20260828160000:31-32 same for gst_case_folder_items; storage DELETE open at 20260321093054:25-27. The anon key is shipped in the SPA bundle (src/integrations/supabase/client.ts from .env) and in the extension (background.js:244 `apikey: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`). CLAUDE.md documents this as the deliberate convention ('let login, staff-only routing and the permission keys be the gate'), so the only gate on DELETE is client-side JavaScript.
missing_and_improvements.why_it_matters: For returns and reconciliations the convention is a trade-off; for litigation evidence it means a former employee, a leaked extension zip, or a curl one-liner can erase a client's order history with no login, no permission check and no log. The RESTRICT/legal-hold trigger from the other findings is the only server-side defence available under this architecture.
missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix: Without changing the app's auth model: split DELETE out of the FOR ALL policies on the four litigation tables and grant DELETE to nobody (all app deletes go through SECURITY DEFINER RPCs that require a valid `portal_sessions`-style staff token or an `app.user_id` header validated against users), and drop the public DELETE policy on the return-pdfs bucket. Longer term, move destructive litigation operations behind the Windows agent's service-role path (agent/src) so the anon key is read/insert-only for these tables.

missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix:
Add this section to CLAUDE.md after the 2B section:

## Notices Dashboard → Refunds / DRC-03 → Additional Notice Folder (litigation module)

A firm-wide litigation tracker modelled on Notice Alert (noticealert.microvistatech.com): `gst_notices` (Notices & Orders + Additional-Notices case summaries), `gst_refund_applications`, `gst_drc03_filings`, `gst_case_folder_items` and `client_sync_log`, all populated by the Chrome extension's `notices_bundle` Sync All (`extension/content.js` handleNotices → handleRefunds → handleDrc03; one portal login and one CAPTCHA per client, delete-all-then-insert per client) and read by `src/pages/Notices*.tsx`, `AllClients{Notices,Refunds,Drc03}Page.tsx`, `AdditionalNoticeFolderPage.tsx`, `CompanyListPage.tsx` and the Reports Hub. Classification is shared through `src/utils/noticeCategoryClassifier.ts` and counted through `src/utils/noticeSummaryReport.ts`.

**Read `docs/NOTICES_LITIGATION_FLOW.md` before changing anything here.** Several behaviours are elected positions, not obvious defaults, and most were confirmed live against the portal on a stated date rather than derived from documentation: the portal's own `status` is always null, so Open/Closed is `staff_status` only; 'Refunds' and 'Voluntary Payment' case rows are deliberately excluded from the category loop and deduped against the refund/DRC-03 tables by ARN; the category regexes and `CASE_NOTICE_TYPE_MAP` re-bucket the portal's raw types into Notice Alert's fixed taxonomy and row order; 'Last 24 Hours' counts `pulled_at`, not issue date; 'Over Due' does not exclude Closed; Sync All is open to every staff member regardless of `add_edit_clients`; a failed pull writes a `PULL FAILED:` sentinel row after replacing the client's rows; and the extension deliberately does not auto-solve the CAPTCHA. missing_and_improvements.proposed_fix:
Add a 'Staff SOP' section to docs/NOTICES_LITIGATION_FLOW.md (and a short pointer in extension/README.md).

SOP — Sync All (10 lines):
1. Use Chrome with the GST Keeper Portal Sync extension loaded (chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked → extension/); confirm the dashboard no longer shows 'Extension not detected'.
2. Open Notices Dashboard → Company card → Sync All (any staff login works; no client-edit permission needed).
3. A portal tab opens on services.gst.gov.in/services/login; keep that tab open and in the foreground until the banner reads 'All N client(s) done'.
4. For each client the extension fills user id + password; you type the CAPTCHA into the portal's own box within 60 seconds; a wrong CAPTCHA reloads automatically up to 3 times.
5. Watch the blue banner: Notices & Orders → Refund applications → DRC-03 filings, then logout and the next client; do not browse the portal in that tab.
6. Budget ~1–2 minutes per client; the whole job expires 20 minutes after it started, so run Sync All in batches from the Company List (tick rows → Sync) rather than all 92 at once.
7. When the banner says done, open Company List: Status ✓ = the notices step saved; Status ✗ with a Status Message = the pull failed for that client.
8. Any client with Status ✗ has had its previous notices replaced by a single 'PULL FAILED: …' row — re-sync that client the same day.
9. Refund and DRC-03 steps are not reflected in Status; check the Refund / DRC-03 — All Clients pages for a 'PULL FAILED' status row per client.
10. Note the run (date, batch, failures) in the Sync Log dialog before closing; escalate portal-wide failures (every client failing the same way) to the principal.

Runbook — Failed client login / failed pull (10 lines):
1. Company List → Status filter = Failed → read the Status Message.
2. 'Session kept dropping (bounced to login/error page 3x)': the portal rejected the login — first check the client's GST user id / password in Edit Client (portal password changed or expired is the usual cause) and re-sync that one client.
3. 'Could not read the portal API: HTTP …': the portal was down or rate-limiting — retry after 15 minutes; if every client fails the same way, stop and report.
4. 'Read N rows but the save failed': Supabase write error — retry once; if it repeats, report with the message text (it names the table).
5. If the Status Message is blank and Last Download Date is old: the job expired (20 min) or the tab was closed — re-run that client from the Company List.
6. After a successful re-sync, confirm the client's 'PULL FAILED' sentinel row has disappeared from Notices — All Clients (category 'Uncategorised').
7. A client whose Status keeps failing after a credential check should be marked Inactive in Company List so it stops inflating Failed Logins, and flagged to the client for a portal password reset.
8. Never type a client's CAPTCHA into any other site or use an auto-solver; the firm's position is human CAPTCHA entry only (agent/README.md:127-134).
9. Refund-document harvest issues show as action 'refund_docs_debug' rows in the Sync Log, not in Status — read them there.
10. Record recurring portal-side changes (new banner, changed page) in docs/NOTICES_LITIGATION_FLOW.md 'Known limitations' so the next session knows the selector/API moved.

roadmap_drafts.angle: Fix-first & trust. The live dashboard reproduces its own formulas exactly (1060 / 3 / 64 / 92 / 1060 / 0 / 473 / 0) yet every headline number is semantically wrong for one root cause: extension/background.js:102-105 `replaceNotices` deletes every gst_notices row for a client and re-inserts only portal columns on every Sync All, so staff_status, priority, assign_to, reply/order dates and manually added notices are wiped, pulled_at resets ("Last 24 Hours = 64"), and on failure a fake 'PULL FAILED' row replaces the client's history. Nothing built on top of that — alerts, assignment, a litigation module — can be trusted until the write path is an upsert, the KPI definitions live in one tested helper, and the five security holes that would turn a notice e-mail into a public link (manifest host, appbridge origin, localStorage role restore, ungated /clients, public return-pdfs bucket) are closed. Phase 0 therefore spends two weeks making the numbers and the plumbing trustworthy and writing the positions document; Phase 1 wires notices into the existing email_outbox / send-gst-email / pg_cron pipeline so the GST team is e-mailed on every important matter; Phase 2 rebuilds the dashboard around a "what needs attention today" queue and a notice drawer; Phase 3 adds the litigation ERP (matters, stages, statutory deadlines, hearings, demand ledger, documents, MIS); Phase 4 covers retention, credential hardening, the client-facing view and unattended sync. Every phase is additive (new migrations, existing routes untouched) and gated by `npm run build` plus the vitest fixture introduced in Phase 0.
guiding_principles: Trust before features: no new tile, e-mail or module ships until Phase 0's upsert sync and shared KPI helper are live and the vitest fixture asserts the new definitions (finding: 'No test harness; KPI and category definitions are unpinned').

Portal owns portal columns, staff own staff columns: the extension may only ever write reference_number, notice_type, description, issue_date, due_date, status, issued_by, case_id, pdf_url, last_seen_at; it never deletes and never touches staff_*/assign/priority/remarks or origin='manual' rows (finding: 'Every Sync All wipes staff workflow data and manually added notices').

One canonical definition of a notice, a due date and 'closed', computed once (SQL view + src/utils/noticeDates.ts / noticeSummaryReport.ts) and consumed by every tile, table, drill-down, e-mail and report so numbers reconcile across pages (findings: 'three different totals on one screen', 'Overdue/due-soon filters duplicated in four places').
Never write diagnostics into data tables: failures go to client_sync_log (one row per step, with run_id and level) and nowhere else (finding: 'PULL FAILED diagnostic rows are stored in gst_notices').

E-mail is the system of record for alerts and reuses the existing pipeline (email_outbox → send-gst-email via Microsoft Graph from gst@vjdesai.com, pg_cron); every alert row carries a deterministic dedupe_key so the team never receives the same alert twice; client-facing mails are always staff-vetted, never automatic.

No public links to litigation documents, ever: return-pdfs becomes private, the app and e-mails redeem short-lived signed URLs through an app route, and 'anyone can delete/update' storage policies are dropped before the first notice e-mail goes out (finding: 'Prerequisites before notice e-mails carry PDF links').

Additive migrations only, applied by hand to project gcquafqxbykxkbexcdpy with the file added under supabase/migrations/ in the same commit; RLS stays FOR ALL TO public per CLAUDE.md, and destructive or sensitive operations move behind SECURITY DEFINER RPCs rather than auth.uid() policies.

Design-system parity with docs/UI-UX-REDESIGN.md: body text-sm, captions text-xs, values text-3xl tabular-nums, 8px rhythm, semantic tokens only, aria-label on every icon button, every clickable cell a real <Link>, skeleton/error/empty states on every card.

Model matters, count matters: the litigation unit is the matter (dispute), not the portal document row; documents, folder items, refunds and DRC-03 payments hang off a matter, and dashboards offer 'Count: Matters | Documents'.

Write the elected positions down before rewriting them: docs/NOTICES_LITIGATION_FLOW.md with KEEP / CONFIRM-WITH-FIRM / REPLACE tags, a CLAUDE.md section in the Builder/2B style, a staff SOP and a failure runbook (finding: 'No positions document for the notices/refunds/DRC-03 module').

Human CAPTCHA only until the firm records a written decision on automated portal access; the fastcaptcha.org host permission is removed or explicitly approved (finding: 'Two documented CAPTCHA positions conflict').
roadmap_drafts.target_dashboard_layout:
12-column CSS grid (gap-6, page root space-y-6, no max-width cap), light-only semantic tokens from src/index.css, body text-sm / captions text-xs / KPI values text-3xl tabular-nums, section titles text-lg — parity with StaffDashboard's metric-card. All data comes from one react-query hook `useNoticeDashboard(filters)` (staleTime 60 s) calling the Postgres RPC `notice_dashboard_stats(p_fy, p_client_id, p_owner, p_category)` which returns tiles, category rows, ageing buckets, monthly issued/closed, workload by owner, the top-N action queue, clients needing attention, the 7-day agenda and sync health — replacing the four ad-hoc effects that download the whole gst_notices table.

ABOVE THE FOLD (1920×1080 and 1366×768 with sidebar open):

Section 0 — PageHeader + filter bar. Title "Notices & Litigation"; subtitle built from client_sync_status: "Portal data as of 13 Sep 10:42 · 92 GSTINs with notices / 121 onboarded · 13 never synced · 2 stale >7d" (each figure a Link to /notices-company-list?status=…). Section 1 — Sync-health strip (slim, full width, only rendered when something needs attention): "Syncing 12/92 · 2 failed · started 10:12 by Priya" (realtime from sync_runs / client_sync_log) or "Last run: 92 clients, 3 failed, 7 new notices — Retry failed"; failed-login/sync-failure count lives here, not in a KPI tile. Extension-missing state renders as an Alert with the install link instead of an 11px caption.

Section 2 — Six KPI tiles in one row (col-span-2 each; 3 per row at lg, 2 at sm): Needs action (actionable & effective due today or later, or no due date), Overdue (destructive; actionable & effective due < today, honours extended_due_date, local-date compare), Due in 7 days (warning; today ≤ due ≤ today+7), Unassigned open (info), High priority open, Demand under dispute ₹ (sum amount_of_demand over open, lakh/crore formatting). Secondary counters (Total notices, New since last sync with the sync time in the caption, Limitation expiring ≤30 d, Hearings this week, Refunds pending ₹, DRC-03 paid this FY) sit in a second compact row of small tiles that collapses behind "More" on laptops.

Section 3 — Action queue (col-span-8) + By category (col-span-4). Action queue: tabs Overdue / Due in 7 days / Hearings this week / Limitation ≤30 d / Unassigned / High priority / New since last sync / Awaiting my approval; columns Client (GSTIN + trade name), Category chip, Description (truncate, title tooltip), Due (date + "x days" Badge: destructive <0, warning 0-7), Owner (inline staff select, gated by assign_notice), Amount ₹, Priority chip, Stage, row actions (open drawer, mark replied, assign, open case folder). Max 10 rows, "View all N" footer Link to /notices-all with identical filters; High-priority rows tinted destructive/10; "Mine | Team" toggle. Clicking a row opens the NoticeDrawer (Phase 2) without leaving the page. By category: Notice Summary sorted by Open desc; placeholder categories (Penalty, TDRC 03, Ewaybill, AAR, TRAN 1, Anti evasion…) collapsed behind "Show uncaptured categories (N)" with a 'not captured' Badge; columns Total / Open / Awaiting reply / Overdue / Demand ₹ with an inline open-vs-total bar per row; clicking a category label adds a filter chip and filters the queue in place (no navigation); per-cell numbers remain <Link>s to the drill-down. Card grows to content height (no fixed 380×620).

BELOW THE FOLD:

Section 4 — Three chart cards (col-span-4 each, stacking at <1024 px; recharts through src/components/ui/chart.tsx, dataviz palette rules, tabular-nums axes): (a) Ageing of open notices — stacked bars 0-7 / 8-30 / 31-90 / 90+ days by category, bars clickable to /notices-all?age=…; (b) Issued vs closed, trailing 12 months — bars + backlog line; (c) Workload by owner — horizontal bars open / overdue per staff member with an 'Unassigned' bar first.

Section 5 — Clients needing attention (col-span-8) + This week (col-span-4). Clients needing attention: top 8 clients ranked by overdue then open (columns GSTIN, trade name, Open, Overdue, Demand ₹, Owner, Last successful sync with a red clock icon when >7 d or never), each row Link to /notices-company/:id; replaces the 'five most recently created clients' Company card — Add Company / Import / Download Template move to /notices-company-list. This week: 7-row agenda (date, N due, N hearings, N issued, first two client names, Link) computed from actionable notices only; a "Month" toggle restores the grid with 4 px dot markers (info = issued, warning = due, destructive = overdue, purple = hearing) under a text-foreground digit — never white on pastel — count badges, aria-label per day ("13 September 2026, 2 notices due") and a Popover listing the day's open notices; markers respect the on-screen filters.

Section 6 — Activity since last visit (full width, collapsible): feed from gst_notice_events (new notice, due date extended, order received, status/assignment changes, e-mails sent) with actor and time, "mark all read" tied to staff_notifications.

Responsive: tiles 6→3→2, queue and category stack at <1280 px, charts stack at <1024 px, summary rendered as a stacked list below md (category, open/total bar, overdue chip), queue collapses to card rows, every remaining table inside its own overflow-x-auto; body never scrolls horizontally. States: Skeleton tiles/rows while loading; Alert variant=destructive with Retry when any query errors (fetchAllRows now returns {rows, error}); TableEmptyState with icon for genuinely empty queues. Accessibility: aria-labels on all icon buttons (Previous month, Next month, Edit {client}), keyboard-reachable Links instead of onClick on <td>, contrast ≥ 4.5:1 on every tint.

Simulate a portal read failure for one client: its gst_notices rows are untouched, client_sync_log has one row with action='notices', status='failed', run_id set, and no row anywhere contains 'PULL FAILED'.

schema_changes: ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD CONSTRAINT gst_notices_source_check CHECK (source IN ('notices','additional_notices','manual')); UPDATE gst_notices SET source='additional_notices' WHERE case_id IS NOT NULL AND notice_type IN ('Determination Of Tax','Letter Of Undertaking','Scrutiny Of Returns','Enforcement Case','Rectification Of Orders','Pre-Gst Recovery','Waiver Scheme U/S 128a','Refunds','Voluntary Payment');

ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN portal_closed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN hearing_date date, ADD COLUMN hearing_time text, ADD COLUMN hearing_mode text CHECK (hearing_mode IN ('physical','video'));

CREATE VIEW v_notice_cases AS SELECT client_id, coalesce(case_id, reference_number) AS case_key, min(first_seen_at) first_seen_at, max(coalesce(extended_due_date, due_date)) effective_due, bool_or(portal_closed) portal_closed, max(staff_status) staff_status, ... FROM gst_notices WHERE portal_missing_at IS NULL GROUP BY client_id, coalesce(case_id, reference_number);

CREATE VIEW gst_notice_counts_by_client AS SELECT client_id, count(*) total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(coalesce(staff_status,'')) <> 'closed' AND NOT portal_closed) open, count(*) FILTER (WHERE reply_date IS NOT NULL) replied FROM gst_notices WHERE portal_missing_at IS NULL GROUP BY client_id;

ALTER TABLE gst_refund_applications ADD COLUMN case_state text, ADD COLUMN period_from date, ADD COLUMN period_to date, ADD COLUMN application_status text, ADD COLUMN rfd04_provisional boolean, ADD COLUMN reason_code text, ADD COLUMN order_date date, ADD COLUMN rejected_amount numeric;

ALTER TABLE gst_drc03_filings ADD COLUMN cause_code text, ADD COLUMN cause_text text, ADD COLUMN scn_reference text, ADD COLUMN scn_date date, ADD COLUMN payment_ref text, ADD COLUMN period_from date, ADD COLUMN period_to date, ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_source_status ON gst_notices (source, staff_status); CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_due ON gst_notices (due_date) WHERE staff_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Closed'; CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_case ON gst_notices (client_id, case_id) WHERE case_id IS NOT NULL; CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_issue ON gst_notices (issue_date DESC); CREATE INDEX idx_gst_refund_status ON gst_refund_applications (client_id, status); CREATE INDEX idx_gst_drc03_fy ON gst_drc03_filings (client_id, financial_year);

phases.name: Phase 1 — Alert the GST team on every important matter
phases.goal: Every new notice, approaching or missed due date, assignment, sync failure and refund/DRC-03 event reaches the GST team by e-mail (and the in-app bell) through the existing outbox and Microsoft Graph sender, with deterministic dedupe, editable recipients and templates, and a daily digest / weekly partner summary — plus a staff-vetted 'Notify client' action.

epics.name: E1.1 Outbox, template and event schema
items: Migration 20260928100000_email_outbox_notice_alerts.sql: widen email_outbox (nullable client_id, new kinds, cc/bcc arrays, attachments jsonb, dedupe_key with partial unique index, notice_id, matter_id placeholder, audience, not_before, channel, to_phone) and email_templates (same kinds, audience, variables text[]); seed templates notice_new, notice_due_t7, notice_due_t3, notice_due_t1, notice_due_today, notice_overdue, notice_hearing, notice_assigned, sync_failed, notice_digest_daily, partner_weekly_summary, client_notice_intimation, refund_deadline, drc03_ack — fixes 'email_outbox schema physically blocks team alerts', 'Email pipeline cannot carry a notice', 'No idempotency key for alerts'.

gst_notice_events table with dedupe_key UNIQUE, written by upsert_portal_notices (new rows → 'notice.new', due-date change → 'notice.due_date_changed', folder ORDRS → 'notice.order_received', refund/DRC-03 status change) and by app writes (status, assignment, reply/order logged) through src/lib/noticeEvents.ts — fixes 'No new-notice-landed event or email', 'No new-vs-updated detection or change log for notices'.

firm_alert_settings single-row table (team_emails default {gst@vjdesai.com}, partner_emails, ladder_days {7,3,1,0}, overdue_repeat_days 3, overdue_max 5, first_response_hours 48, digest_enabled, weekly_enabled, quiet_start/quiet_end) and staff_notification_prefs — fixes 'Single recipient only — no cc/bcc, no team distribution list', 'No per-recipient preferences, quiet hours or opt-out'.

staff_notifications table for the in-app bell; trigger trg_client_sync_log_failed → gst_notice_events 'sync.failed' (dedupe per client per day) — fixes 'Failed portal logins are recorded but nobody is told'.

schema_changes: ALTER TABLE email_outbox ALTER COLUMN client_id DROP NOT NULL, DROP CONSTRAINT email_outbox_kind_check, ADD CONSTRAINT email_outbox_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('reminder','confirmation','builder_setup','builder_fsi','builder_cancellation','builder_agreement_confirm','notice_alert','notice_due','notice_hearing','notice_assigned','notice_digest','partner_weekly','sync_failed','client_notice','refund_alert','drc03_alert','notice_limitation','order_received','client_matter_statement')), ADD COLUMN cc_emails text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', ADD COLUMN bcc_emails text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', ADD COLUMN attachments jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', ADD COLUMN dedupe_key text, ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid, ADD COLUMN audience text CHECK (audience IN ('client','gst_team','assignee','partner')), ADD COLUMN not_before timestamptz, ADD COLUMN channel text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'email' CHECK (channel IN ('email','whatsapp','sms')), ADD COLUMN to_phone text;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_email_outbox_dedupe ON email_outbox (dedupe_key) WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE email_templates DROP CONSTRAINT email_templates_kind_check, ADD CONSTRAINT email_templates_kind_check CHECK (kind IN (…same list…)), ADD COLUMN audience text CHECK (audience IN ('client','team','partner')), ADD COLUMN variables text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', ADD COLUMN channel text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'email';

CREATE TABLE gst_notice_events (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, client_id uuid, event_kind text NOT NULL CHECK (event_kind IN ('notice.new','notice.due_date_changed','notice.status_changed','notice.assigned','notice.order_received','notice.reply_logged','hearing.upcoming','refund.status_changed','drc03.new','sync.failed','email.sent')), old_value jsonb, new_value jsonb, actor_user_id uuid, actor_source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'app' CHECK (actor_source IN ('app','extension','agent','system')), sync_run_id uuid, dedupe_key text UNIQUE, occurred_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), processed_at timestamptz, notified_at timestamptz); CREATE INDEX ON gst_notice_events (processed_at) WHERE processed_at IS NULL; CREATE INDEX ON gst_notice_events (notice_id, occurred_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE firm_alert_settings (id int PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 1 CHECK (id = 1), team_emails text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{gst@vjdesai.com}', partner_emails text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', ladder_days int[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{7,3,1,0}', overdue_repeat_days int NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, overdue_max int NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, first_response_hours int NOT NULL DEFAULT 48, digest_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, weekly_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, quiet_start time, quiet_end time, updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), updated_by uuid); INSERT INTO firm_alert_settings DEFAULT VALUES;

CREATE TABLE staff_notification_prefs (user_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, email_new_notice boolean DEFAULT true, email_due boolean DEFAULT true, email_digest boolean DEFAULT true, in_app boolean DEFAULT true, quiet_start time, quiet_end time);

CREATE TABLE staff_notifications (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid, kind text NOT NULL, title text NOT NULL, body text, link text, notice_id uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), read_by uuid[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'); CREATE INDEX ON staff_notifications (created_at DESC);

CREATE FUNCTION trg_client_sync_log_failed_fn() RETURNS trigger …; CREATE TRIGGER trg_client_sync_log_failed AFTER INSERT ON client_sync_log FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.status='failed' AND NEW.level='outcome') EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_client_sync_log_failed_fn();
(all new tables) ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY … FOR ALL TO public USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

items: supabase/functions/notify-notice-events/index.ts: every 15 min (pg_cron, same vault anon-key http_post pattern as 20260726130000_gst_email_cron.sql) reads unprocessed gst_notice_events, groups by client, renders notice_new / sync_failed / order_received / refund_deadline / drc03_ack, inserts email_outbox rows with dedupe_key (Prefer: resolution=ignore-duplicates) plus a staff_notifications row, marks processed_at, then invokes send-gst-email immediately (the pattern at src/lib/gstReminders.ts:106); optional post-sync callback from content.js after upsert so mails leave within seconds.

supabase/functions/queue-notice-reminders/index.ts: daily 03:30 UTC (09:00 IST) over v_notice_cases where actionable and effective_due not null; days_left in IST; steps T-7/T-3/T-1/T0 then every overdue_repeat_days while overdue (max overdue_max); hearing_date at T-3/T-1/T0; to assignee (fallback team), cc gst_managers from T-1, cc partners once overdue; dedupe_key notice.due:{id}:{step} — fixes 'No due-date escalation ladder for notices'.

acceptance_criteria: Sync a client with one genuinely new notice: within 15 min gst@vjdesai.com receives 'New notice' with the PDF attached (or a link note if > 3 MB), the outbox row shows kind notice_alert and dedupe_key notice.new:<id>, and RemindersPage lists it under 'Regarding: <client> · <ref>'.

notice.due T-7 / T-3 / T-1 / T0 (actionable, effective due = extended_due_date ?? due_date, incl. RFD-08 folder due dates) → assignee (fallback team list); cc gst_manager users from T-1 → notice_due_t7 / notice_due_t3 / notice_due_t1 / notice_due_today → queue-notice-reminders daily 09:00 IST, dedupe notice.due:{id}:{step}

notice.overdue (actionable and past effective due, every overdue_repeat_days, max overdue_max sends) → assignee + team list, cc partner_emails → notice_overdue → queue-notice-reminders daily 09:00 IST, dedupe notice.due:{id}:overdue:{n}
hearing.upcoming T-3 / T-1 / T0 (gst_notices.hearing_date; later gst_hearings) → assignee + partners → notice_hearing → queue-notice-reminders daily 09:00 IST

notice.order_received (ORDRS folder item or Order-type row appears for an open case) → assignee + team list + partners → order_received (with 'appeal by <order_date + 3 months>' line) → notify-notice-events within 15 min

refund.status_changed to deficiency memo (RFD-03) / SCN (RFD-08) / rejection (RFD-06 reject) / PMT-03 → assignee + team list → refund_deadline → notify-notice-events within 15 min; other refund/DRC-03 status changes fold into the daily digest
drc03.new (new DRC-03 ARN captured) → team list → drc03_ack (folded into digest unless linked to an open SCN) → daily digest

sync.failed (client_sync_log level='outcome' status='failed', incl. action='login') → team list → sync_failed (client, step, message, 'Fix credentials' link) → notify-notice-events within 15 min, dedupe sync.failed:{client}:{date}

digest.daily → team_emails + every superadmin/gst_manager profile e-mail → notice_digest_daily (New 24 h, Due 7 d, Overdue by amount, Unassigned, Hearings this week, Sync failures, Stale >7 d, Refund/DRC-03 events) → notice-daily-digest 08:30 IST Mon–Sat, dedupe digest:daily:{date}

schema_changes: ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN assigned_to_user_id uuid REFERENCES profiles(user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN assigned_by uuid, ADD COLUMN assigned_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN reviewer_id uuid, ADD COLUMN status_changed_by uuid, ADD COLUMN status_changed_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN first_viewed_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN first_viewed_by uuid, ADD COLUMN client_notified_at timestamptz;

Deleting a manual notice removes it from every count without touching portal rows.

CREATE TABLE app_sessions (token text PRIMARY KEY, user_id uuid NOT NULL, role app_role NOT NULL, expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL); ALTER TABLE app_sessions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; (no policies — reached only by SECURITY DEFINER RPCs)

CREATE FUNCTION update_notice_status(p_ids uuid[], p_status text, p_stage text, p_reason text, p_token text) RETURNS int LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER; CREATE FUNCTION assign_notice(p_ids uuid[], p_user uuid, p_token text) …; CREATE FUNCTION delete_notice(p_id uuid, p_token text) …; CREATE FUNCTION grant_permission(p_user uuid, p_key text, p_granted boolean, p_token text) …;

epics.name: E2.5 Refund and DRC-03 as first-class, typed, rupee-bearing data

schema_changes: ALTER TABLE gst_refund_applications ADD COLUMN staff_status text, ADD COLUMN priority text, ADD COLUMN assigned_to_user_id uuid, ADD COLUMN remarks text, ADD COLUMN reply_date date, ADD COLUMN next_action_date date, ADD COLUMN deficiency_memo_on date, ADD COLUMN refile_limitation_on date; (same six workflow columns on gst_drc03_filings)

CREATE VIEW v_refund_drc03_kpis AS SELECT sum(claimed_amount) FILTER (WHERE case_state IN ('open','replied')) refunds_pending, sum(sanctioned_amount) FILTER (WHERE case_state='sanctioned') sanctioned_not_disbursed, … FROM gst_refund_applications …;

phases.name: Phase 3 — Litigation ERP core: matters, stages, deadlines, hearings, demand ledger, documents, MIS
phases.goal: Turn the document inbox into a litigation system: one Matter per dispute grouping SCN → reply → hearing → order → appeal, a statutory deadline engine, a hearing calendar, a demand-vs-paid ledger linked to DRC-03, a private per-matter document repository with notes, communications and an audit trail, an Action Centre / matter workspace / MIS, and approvals — with alerts extended to hearings, limitation expiry and orders.

epics.name: E3.1 Matter entity, stage machine and grouping
items: Migration 20261020100000_gst_matters.sql: gst_matters (matter_no, matter_type, forum, stage, financial_years text[], section_of_law text[], authority fields, portal_case_id, assigned_to/partner, counsel_id, outcome, exposure_amount, tags, SLA fields, tax_type default 'GST'), gst_matter_stage_history + trigger, matter_id on gst_notices / gst_refund_applications / gst_drc03_filings / gst_case_folder_items (+ notice_id FK on folder items), backfill one matter per (client_id, case_id) and one per orphan notice; auto-grouping job by (client, section, FY, issuing officer) heuristics with a manual 'Link to matter' action — fixes 'No matter/case entity', 'No stage/status state machine', 'Documents of one dispute are not chained', 'gst_case_folder_items has no FK to the notice', 'Section of law and financial year are free text', 'No tags or SLA fields'.

src/lib/matters.ts data access + src/utils/matterStages.ts (allowed transitions, outcome enum dropped / confirmed_full / confirmed_part / set_aside / remanded / withdrawn / appealed / paid_settled / amnesty_128a / time_barred); Notice Summary gains a Stage pivot and Dropped/Confirmed/Appealed columns; dashboard 'Count: Matters | Documents' toggle — fixes 'Outcome tracking: status vocabulary is only Open/Closed', 'REFUTED duplicates claim; the real duplication is tasks-per-case'.
Dedicated 'Amnesty (s.128A)' category with SPL stages and an eligible_for_128a computed flag — fixes 's.128A amnesty matters lose their identity'.
acceptance_criteria: Every gst_notices row has a matter_id after backfill; the Notice Summary in 'Matters' mode shows e.g. 4 appeal matters instead of 17 appeal task rows.
A stage change from reply_filed to hearing_scheduled writes a stage_history row; an invalid transition is rejected by the app and the CHECK.
Linking a stray notice to an existing matter moves it in the Timeline immediately.
schema_changes: CREATE TABLE gst_matters (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, matter_no text UNIQUE, title text NOT NULL, tax_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GST', matter_type text NOT NULL CHECK (matter_type IN ('scrutiny_asmt10','audit_adt','adjudication_s73','adjudication_s74','adjudication_s74a','appeal_apl01','gstat_apl05','high_court','supreme_court','recovery','refund','registration','ewaybill','amnesty_128a','summons_s70','itc_mismatch_drc01b','non_filer','rectification','other')), forum text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proper_officer' CHECK (forum IN ('proper_officer','appellate_authority','gstat','high_court','supreme_court')), stage text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new' CHECK (stage IN ('new','under_review','awaiting_client_docs','reply_drafted','reply_filed','ph_scheduled','order_awaited','order_received','rectification_filed','appeal_filed','gstat_filed','recovery','closed_dropped','closed_paid','closed_favourable','closed_partly','closed_time_barred')), outcome text, section_of_law text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', financial_years text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', period_from date, period_to date, jurisdiction text CHECK (jurisdiction IN ('centre','state')), authority_id uuid, authority_designation text, portal_case_id text, assigned_to uuid, partner_user_id uuid, counsel_id uuid, exposure_amount numeric, tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', first_response_due timestamptz, first_responded_at timestamptz, escalation_level smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, internal_target_date date, eligible_for_128a boolean, opened_at date NOT NULL DEFAULT current_date, closed_at date, closure_reason text, created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matters (client_id, stage); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matters USING gin (tags);

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_stage_history (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, from_stage text, to_stage text NOT NULL, outcome text, changed_by uuid, changed_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), note text); CREATE TRIGGER trg_gst_matters_stage AFTER UPDATE OF stage ON gst_matters FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.stage IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.stage) EXECUTE FUNCTION gst_matter_stage_history_fn();

ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN section_invoked text, ADD COLUMN issue_tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', ADD COLUMN tax_period_from date, ADD COLUMN tax_period_to date; CREATE INDEX ON gst_notices (matter_id);

ALTER TABLE gst_refund_applications ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; ALTER TABLE gst_drc03_filings ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN payment_purpose text CHECK (payment_purpose IN ('voluntary_s73_5','voluntary_s74_5','against_scn','against_order','pre_deposit_s107','pre_deposit_s112','annual_return','audit','other')), ADD COLUMN linked_by uuid, ADD COLUMN linked_at timestamptz;

ALTER TABLE gst_case_folder_items ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN item_type text, ADD COLUMN issue_date date, ADD COLUMN due_date date, ADD COLUMN section_ref text, ADD COLUMN portal_item_id text;

INSERT INTO gst_matters (client_id, title, matter_type, portal_case_id, …) SELECT DISTINCT ON (client_id, case_id) … FROM gst_notices WHERE case_id IS NOT NULL; UPDATE gst_notices n SET matter_id = m.id FROM gst_matters m WHERE m.client_id=n.client_id AND m.portal_case_id=n.case_id; (then one matter per orphan notice)

epics.name: E3.2 Statutory deadline engine and hearings
items: gst_matter_deadlines + SQL function gst_seed_statutory_deadlines(matter_id) and src/utils/litigationLimitation.ts rules keyed on matter_type + stage + base date: reply_due (notice + 30 d / ASMT-11 30 d / RFD-08 15 d / REG-17 7 d / DRC-22A 7 d), appeal_limitation (order communication + 3 months, s.107) and condonable +1 month, gstat_limitation (+3 months, s.112), rectification_s161 (+6 months), revocation REG-21 (90 d), pre_deposit_due, SPL payment cut-offs, internal_target; is_statutory/is_met/met_on — fixes 'No statutory limitation dates', 'No stage-based due-date or statutory limitation engine'.

gst_hearings (scheduled_on, mode, venue, officer, attended_by, counsel, outcome held/adjourned_by_dept/adjourned_by_us/ex_parte/cancelled, adjourned_to, notes) replacing the single hearing_date column; .ics export and a subscribable per-staff feed edge function notices-ical (token in URL) — fixes 'No hearings/adjournments table', 'No hearing calendar'.

Dashboard: tiles 'Limitation expiring ≤ 30 d' and 'Hearings this week'; calendar/agenda gains hearing (purple) and limitation (destructive outline) markers; Overdue / Due in 7 days read gst_matter_deadlines where NOT is_met in addition to notice due dates.

queue-notice-reminders extended: hearing T-3/T-1/T0 from gst_hearings; appeal/GSTAT limitation at T-15/T-7/T-1 while no submission_arn; rectification and revocation windows; recovery objection windows.
acceptance_criteria: Logging an order dated 2026-09-01 creates appeal_limitation 2026-12-01 and condonable 2027-01-01 rows; the matter appears in 'Limitation expiring ≤ 30 d' on 2026-11-02.
A hearing scheduled for tomorrow generates one notice_hearing mail to the assignee and partners today and appears in the week agenda.
Marking a deadline met removes it from every tile and stops its ladder.
email_events: deadline.limitation T-15 / T-7 / T-1 (gst_matter_deadlines kind appeal_limitation / appeal_condonable_limit / gstat_limitation / rectification_s161 / revocation, NOT is_met) → assignee + partners + team list → notice_limitation → queue-notice-reminders daily 09:00 IST, dedupe deadline:{id}:{step}

hearing.upcoming T-3 / T-1 / T0 (gst_hearings outcome='scheduled') → assignee + partners (+ counsel e-mail if set) → notice_hearing (venue, mode, officer, matter summary, documents checklist) → queue-notice-reminders daily 09:00 IST
hearing.adjourned (outcome set to adjourned_* with adjourned_to) → assignee + team list → notice_hearing variant 'Adjourned to' → notify-notice-events within 15 min
schema_changes: CREATE TABLE gst_matter_deadlines (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('reply_due','ph_date','appeal_limitation','appeal_condonable_limit','gstat_limitation','rectification_s161','revocation_reg21','pre_deposit_due','recovery_objection','spl_payment','refile_s54','internal_target','other')), basis_section text, computed_from date, due_on date NOT NULL, is_statutory boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, is_met boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, met_on date, notes text, created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matter_deadlines (due_on) WHERE NOT is_met;
CREATE FUNCTION gst_seed_statutory_deadlines(p_matter_id uuid) RETURNS int LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TABLE gst_hearings (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, scheduled_on timestamptz NOT NULL, venue text, officer text, mode text CHECK (mode IN ('physical','video','written')), attended_by uuid, counsel_id uuid, outcome text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled' CHECK (outcome IN ('scheduled','held','adjourned_by_dept','adjourned_by_us','ex_parte','cancelled')), adjourned_to timestamptz, adjournment_reason text, notes text, created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_hearings (scheduled_on) WHERE outcome='scheduled';

epics.name: E3.3 Demand ledger, payments, pre-deposit, recovery
items: gst_demand_lines (per matter × document_stage × FY × act × head: demanded / admitted / disputed generated / paid, status proposed/confirmed/dropped/set_aside/remanded) parsed from dmddtls/pymtdtls in folder JSON at sync and editable in the workspace; gst_notices.amount_of_demand maintained as a denormalised total by trigger — fixes 'Demand is a single number…', 'Demand vs paid ledger per matter is impossible'.

matter_payments linking gst_drc03_filings to matters with kind (pre_deposit_apl01/apl05, voluntary_s73_5/s74_5, against_scn, against_order, recovery, refund_recredit), cash/credit split, auto-suggest by cause_code/section/period; 'Pre-deposit paid ✓' badge on the appeal stage; s.107(7) deemed-stay status — fixes 'Pre-deposit … and DRC-03-against-SCN payments are not linked to any notice', 'DRC-03 payments are not linkable to the notice/matter'.

matter_recovery_actions (DRC-07A/13/16/22/22A/23, addressed_to, amount, objection_due, stay_status, released_on) with a red 'Attachment active' badge — fixes 'Recovery and attachment proceedings have no structured tracking'.

Dashboard/MIS: 'Demand under dispute ₹' now from gst_demand_lines; 'Overdue demand ₹'; risk_class (Possible/Probable/Remote) per matter; Report > 'Demand Exposure by Client' (contingent-liability schedule, PDF/Excel) — fixes 'No demand-at-risk / amount-exposure view'.
acceptance_criteria: For a matter with a DRC-07 of tax 10 L / interest 2 L / penalty 1 L across CGST+SGST the ledger shows 26 L demanded, and linking a DRC-03 of 2.6 L as pre_deposit_s107 shows 'Pre-deposit 10% ✓'.
The contingent-liability report totals equal the dashboard 'Demand under dispute' tile for the same filter.
A DRC-13 with objection_due tomorrow appears in Overdue/Due tiles and the digest.
email_events: recovery.action_received (new DRC-13/16/22 folder item or manual entry) → assignee + partners + team list → order_received variant 'Recovery action' → notify-notice-events within 15 min
schema_changes: CREATE TABLE gst_demand_lines (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, document_stage text NOT NULL CHECK (document_stage IN ('drc01a','drc01','drc07','apl04','gstat_order','hc_order','other')), financial_year text, act text NOT NULL CHECK (act IN ('CGST','SGST','IGST','CESS')), head text NOT NULL CHECK (head IN ('tax','interest','penalty','late_fee','other')), demanded numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, admitted numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, disputed numeric GENERATED ALWAYS AS (demanded - admitted) STORED, paid numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed' CHECK (status IN ('proposed','confirmed','dropped','set_aside','remanded')), UNIQUE (matter_id, document_stage, financial_year, act, head));

CREATE TABLE matter_payments (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, drc03_id uuid REFERENCES gst_drc03_filings(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('pre_deposit_apl01','pre_deposit_apl05','voluntary_s73_5','voluntary_s74_5','against_scn','against_order','recovery','refund_recredit')), paid_on date, igst numeric DEFAULT 0, cgst numeric DEFAULT 0, sgst numeric DEFAULT 0, cess numeric DEFAULT 0, interest numeric DEFAULT 0, penalty numeric DEFAULT 0, cash_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, credit_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE matter_recovery_actions (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, form text NOT NULL CHECK (form IN ('DRC-07A','DRC-13','DRC-16','DRC-22','DRC-22A','DRC-23')), issued_on date, addressed_to text, amount numeric, objection_due date, stay_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (stay_status IN ('none','deemed_s107_7','court_stay')), stay_reference text, released_on date, notes text);

ALTER TABLE gst_matters ADD COLUMN risk_class text CHECK (risk_class IN ('Possible','Probable','Remote')); ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN tax_amount numeric, ADD COLUMN interest_amount numeric, ADD COLUMN penalty_amount numeric, ADD COLUMN pre_deposit_paid numeric;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_demand_lines_total AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON gst_demand_lines FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION gst_recompute_matter_exposure();

epics.name: E3.4 Private document repository, notes, communications log, audit trail
items: Private bucket litigation-docs + gst_documents (doc_type notice/intimation/reply/annexure/order/apl01/apl02/apl04/hearing_notes/drc03/refund_doc/client_communication/other, storage_path, sha256, portal_doc_id, folder_section, source portal/manual); migrate pdf_url / documents jsonb / attachments jsonb rows into it and move objects; served via the signed-URL helper; 'Firm documents' upload in the drawer and folder page; 'Download paper book (zip)' edge function — fixes 'No document repository', 'No staff-side document store on a notice', 'Documents are scattered across five storage prefixes…', 'Scanned notice/order PDFs are never deleted, leaving orphaned evidence…'.
gst_matter_notes (threaded, pinned, author) migrating existing remarks into one note each; remarks kept as headline — fixes 'No notes/comments thread'.

gst_matter_communications (email/phone/whatsapp/meeting/portal/letter, direction, counterparty, email_outbox_id, follow_up_on) with a trigger creating a row when an outbox mail with matter_id is sent — fixes 'No communications log tying emails/calls/WhatsApp to a notice'.

gst_matter_activity fed by log_gst_row_change() triggers on gst_notices, gst_matters, gst_drc03_filings, gst_matter_deadlines, gst_hearings, gst_demand_lines (jsonb diff, actor from set_config('app.user_id') set by a tiny RPC before writes, actor_source app/extension/agent/system); History tab and audit_log writes for bulk actions — fixes 'No audit trail of who changed what on a notice', 'No per-notice activity log / audit trail', 'audit_log is the only append-only table and is not used…'.
acceptance_criteria: Every existing PDF reference resolves through gst_documents and opens via a signed URL; the orphan report lists 0 objects without a row.
Uploading a reply draft and its annexures attaches them to the matter; the paper-book zip contains every document in folder order.
Changing amount_of_demand on a notice produces an activity row with old/new values and the staff user's id; the extension's upsert produces rows with actor_source='extension'.
schema_changes: INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public) VALUES ('litigation-docs','litigation-docs', false) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

CREATE TABLE gst_documents (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, drc03_id uuid REFERENCES gst_drc03_filings(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, refund_id uuid REFERENCES gst_refund_applications(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, doc_type text NOT NULL CHECK (doc_type IN ('notice','intimation','reply_draft','reply_filed','annexure','order','apl01','apl02','apl04','hearing_notes','drc03','refund_doc','working','precedent','client_communication','other')), title text NOT NULL, version int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, storage_bucket text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'litigation-docs', storage_path text NOT NULL, mime_type text, size_bytes bigint, sha256 text, portal_doc_id text, folder_section text, filed_on_portal boolean, portal_ref text, client_visible boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, uploaded_by uuid, source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'portal' CHECK (source IN ('portal','manual')), created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (storage_bucket, storage_path)); CREATE INDEX ON gst_documents (matter_id); CREATE INDEX ON gst_documents (notice_id);

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_notes (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, body text NOT NULL, is_pinned boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, author_id uuid NOT NULL, author_name text, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), edited_at timestamptz); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matter_notes (matter_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_communications (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, channel text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('email','phone','whatsapp','meeting','portal','letter')), direction text NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('outbound','inbound')), counterparty text NOT NULL CHECK (counterparty IN ('client','department','counsel','internal')), email_outbox_id uuid REFERENCES email_outbox(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, subject text, summary text, occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), logged_by uuid, follow_up_on date); CREATE TRIGGER trg_outbox_sent_comm AFTER UPDATE OF status ON email_outbox FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.status='sent' AND NEW.matter_id IS NOT NULL) EXECUTE FUNCTION gst_log_outbox_communication();

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_activity (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, matter_id uuid, notice_id uuid, table_name text NOT NULL, row_id uuid NOT NULL, action text NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('insert','update','delete','sync')), changed_fields jsonb, old_values jsonb, new_values jsonb, actor_id uuid, actor_name text, actor_source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'app' CHECK (actor_source IN ('app','extension','agent','system')), created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matter_activity (matter_id, created_at DESC); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matter_activity (notice_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE FUNCTION log_gst_row_change() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER; CREATE TRIGGER trg_gst_notices_audit AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON gst_notices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION log_gst_row_change(); (same on gst_matters, gst_drc03_filings, gst_refund_applications, gst_matter_deadlines, gst_hearings, gst_demand_lines)
CREATE FUNCTION set_app_user(p_user_id uuid, p_name text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT set_config('app.user_id', p_user_id::text, false), set_config('app.user_name', p_name, false) $$;

epics.name: E3.5 Litigation workspace pages, MIS, masters, approvals and tasks
items: Routes in src/App.tsx (all under MainLayout, staff-gated): /litigation (Action Centre — Due today / Due 7 d / Hearings this week / Limitation ≤ 30 d / Awaiting my approval / Unassigned / New since last sync, Mine | Team), /litigation/matters (list: stage, forum, exposure, owner, ageing, tags; filters FY/State from GSTIN prefix/Section/Issue tag/Authority), /litigation/matters/:id (tabs Timeline | Documents | Demand & Payments | Hearings | Deadlines | Tasks & Approvals | Correspondence | Notes | History), /litigation/calendar, /litigation/mis, /litigation/masters — fixes 'No what needs my attention today work queue', 'No structured tagging by section, issue type, state or FY'.

MIS: view v_litigation_mis over matters + demand lines + deadlines + stage history: ageing since issue and since last action, exposure heat-map client × FY, by section and by authority, stage funnel, outcome statistics (dropped %, confirmed %), average days to reply, upcoming limitation list; Excel via renderReportToExcel; Report menu adds Ageing, Staff Workload, Demand Exposure, Stage/Outcome, Per-client Litigation Statement; monthly MIS PDF e-mailed to partners — fixes 'MIS absent…', 'MIS reports limited to two'.

Masters: tax_authorities (administration CGST/SGST/DGGI/Appellate/GSTAT/HC, designation, office, commissionerate/division/range, state, e-mail) auto-suggested from issued_by and gst_taxpayer_profile jurisdiction (clients gain gst_range/division/commissionerate); gst_counsels + matter_counsels (role, brief_sent_on, fee_agreed/paid); gst_matter_fees + fee summary view and 'Unbilled litigation work' report — fixes 'Authority is a free-text issued_by', 'No counsel/advocate, authority or forum details', 'No fees/billing hook per matter'.

Approvals and tasks: matter_approvals (reply_draft, appeal_grounds, close_matter, settle_amnesty) with review_litigation / approve_litigation_filing keys, closing a matter or marking 'filed' requires an approved record; staff_task_reminders gains client_id/notice_id/matter_id/allocated_to/visibility/remind_at/notify_email and matter_tasks per stage; '/litigation/my-queue' — fixes 'No partner review / approval workflow', 'Reminders/tasks cannot reference a notice', 'Assignment is a free-text name; no per-stage tasks, no my matters queue'.
acceptance_criteria: A partner opening /litigation sees their approvals queue and the week's hearings and limitation expiries; an article sees only matters assigned to them or their clients.
The matter workspace shows the full chronology from intimation to order for a backfilled case, with documents, demand ledger and deadlines on separate tabs.
MIS ageing buckets and exposure totals reconcile to the dashboard tiles; the monthly MIS PDF e-mail is sent on the 1st.
Marking a reply 'filed' without an approved reply_draft record is refused with a clear message.
email_events: approval.requested (matter_approvals row inserted) → the named approver (partner/gst_manager) → notice_assigned variant 'Approval requested' → notify-notice-events within 15 min
approval.decided (decision recorded) → requester → notice_assigned variant 'Approval decision' → notify-notice-events within 15 min
task.reminder (staff_task_reminders remind_at <= now AND notify_email) → allocated_to user → task_reminder → queue-notice-reminders every run (daily) plus the 15-min poller for same-day items

mis.monthly (1st of month 09:00 IST) → partner_emails + gst_managers → partner_weekly_summary shell with the MIS PDF attached → pg_cron 'gst-litigation-mis-monthly' (30 3 1 * *), dedupe mis:monthly:{yyyy-mm}
schema_changes: CREATE TABLE tax_authorities (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), administration text NOT NULL CHECK (administration IN ('CGST','SGST','DGGI','Appellate','GSTAT','HC','SC')), designation text, office_name text, commissionerate text, division text, range text, state text, email text, address text, is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true); ALTER TABLE gst_matters ADD CONSTRAINT gst_matters_authority_fk FOREIGN KEY (authority_id) REFERENCES tax_authorities(id);
ALTER TABLE clients ADD COLUMN gst_range text, ADD COLUMN gst_division text, ADD COLUMN gst_commissionerate text;

CREATE TABLE gst_counsels (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name text NOT NULL, firm text, email text, phone text, bar_enrolment_no text, forum_expertise text[], default_fee numeric, is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true); CREATE TABLE matter_counsels (matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, counsel_id uuid REFERENCES gst_counsels(id), role text, brief_sent_on date, fee_agreed numeric, fee_paid numeric, notes text, PRIMARY KEY (matter_id, counsel_id));

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_fees (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, fee_type text NOT NULL CHECK (fee_type IN ('professional','counsel','pre_deposit_funding','court_fee','disbursement','other')), stage text, description text, quoted numeric, billed numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, collected numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, billed_on date, invoice_ref text, counsel_id uuid REFERENCES gst_counsels(id), created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE VIEW gst_matter_fee_summary AS SELECT matter_id, sum(quoted) quoted, sum(billed) billed, sum(collected) collected FROM gst_matter_fees GROUP BY matter_id;

CREATE TABLE matter_approvals (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, subject text NOT NULL CHECK (subject IN ('reply_draft','appeal_grounds','close_matter','settle_amnesty','change_demand')), document_id uuid REFERENCES gst_documents(id), requested_by uuid NOT NULL, approver uuid NOT NULL, requested_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), decided_at timestamptz, decision text CHECK (decision IN ('approved','rejected','changes_requested')), comments text);

CREATE TABLE matter_tasks (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, stage text, title text NOT NULL, due_date date, assignee uuid, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open','done','cancelled')), created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), done_at timestamptz);

ALTER TABLE staff_task_reminders ADD COLUMN client_id uuid REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN allocated_to_user_id uuid, ADD COLUMN visibility text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private' CHECK (visibility IN ('private','team')), ADD COLUMN remind_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN notify_email boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

CREATE VIEW v_litigation_mis AS SELECT m.id, m.client_id, m.matter_type, m.forum, m.stage, m.outcome, m.authority_id, m.financial_years, m.section_of_law, current_date - m.opened_at AS age_days, … sum(d.disputed) exposure, … FROM gst_matters m LEFT JOIN gst_demand_lines d ON d.matter_id=m.id … GROUP BY m.id;

epics.name: E3.6 Typed manual entry and capture roadmap for the missing lifecycle forms
items: Replace the generic AddNoticeDialog with typed forms per matter_type: Appeal (order appealed, pre-deposit, grounds), Recovery (DRC-13/16/22 fields), E-way bill MOV, Summons (appearance date), Amnesty SPL-01/02, Registration REG-17/21, GSTAT/HC manual matters with document upload; tax_type discriminator so IT/TDS notices can reuse the workflow later — fixes 'Lifecycle capture gaps…', 'No Income Tax / TDS notice coverage' (designed-for, not built).
Optional parse-notice-pdf edge function (text extraction + regex for GSTIN/ref/DIN/dates/section/amount) pre-filling the form for review — fixes 'Manual Add Notice requires hand-typing every field'.

Extension roadmap item: enumerate case/search caseTypeCd values beyond RFUND/ADJVP (APL, ADT, recovery, registration) and pull them through upsert_portal_notices into matters; documented in docs/NOTICES_LITIGATION_FLOW.md §Known limitations until done.
acceptance_criteria: An APL-01 appeal entered manually creates a matter at forum appellate_authority with its pre-deposit line, limitation rows and a linked order document.
A summons entered with an appearance date appears in the week agenda and generates the hearing ladder mails.
schema_changes: ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN tax_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GST' CHECK (tax_type IN ('GST','IT','TDS'));

phases.name: Phase 4 — Retention & recovery, credential hardening, client-facing view, reply workspace, unattended sync
phases.goal: Make litigation records durable and defensible (soft delete, RESTRICT, history/restore, legal hold, backups), take portal passwords out of the anon-readable row, give clients a read-only view and a monthly statement, add reply templates/precedents, and — subject to a written firm decision — schedule an unattended agent sync with a human CAPTCHA inbox; then WhatsApp/push as adapters on the same outbox.

epics.name: E4.1 Retention, history, restore and backup
items: Migration: clients.deleted_at/deleted_by/delete_reason; client delete handlers in CompanyListPage/ClientsPage become soft delete with impact counts ('42 notices, 17 open, 6 DRC-03, 3 refunds, 51 PDFs'), GSTIN typed to confirm, 'Mark inactive at hand' as the primary action, BEFORE DELETE trigger writing audit_log; FKs on the litigation tables flipped to ON DELETE RESTRICT — fixes 'Client delete cascades through all litigation tables…', 'Delete confirm dialogs give no counts…'.

gst_litigation_history (no client FK, append-only) fed by BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE triggers on gst_notices, gst_refund_applications, gst_drc03_filings, gst_case_folder_items, gst_matters; 'History' drawer + superadmin/gst_manager 'Restore' mirroring the 2B version list — fixes 'No history/snapshot or restore for notice, refund, DRC-03 and case-folder rows'.

retention_until (annual-return due date + 72 months) and legal_hold (auto while open/replied/under appeal) on the litigation tables; trigger refuses hard deletes while on hold; 'Records on hold' count and a disposal register — fixes 'No retention policy or legal-hold concept (s.36 CGST)'.
Split DELETE out of the FOR ALL policies on the litigation tables (deletes only via SECURITY DEFINER RPCs with a staff token) — fixes 'Any holder of the anon key can delete litigation rows and PDFs'.

docs/BACKUP_AND_RECOVERY.md: enable PITR (≥ 7 days) on gcquafqxbykxkbexcdpy, nightly pg_dump of litigation tables + bucket mirror to the firm's Drive via a cron edge function, quarterly restore drill log, 'Last backup' indicator on Settings — fixes 'No backup, PITR or recovery procedure is documented'.
acceptance_criteria: Deleting a client with notices is refused unless soft-deleted; the confirm shows live counts; audit_log has the deletion row with actor and counts.
Overwriting a reply date then restoring from History brings back the previous value and logs the restore.
A hard DELETE on gst_notices with the anon key is rejected; a legal-hold row cannot be deleted even via RPC.
A restore drill from PITR to a scratch project is documented with timings.
email_events: backup.failed (nightly dump edge function error) → partner_emails + team list → sync_failed shell variant 'Backup failed' → immediate, dedupe backup:{date}
schema_changes: ALTER TABLE clients ADD COLUMN deleted_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN deleted_by uuid, ADD COLUMN delete_reason text;

ALTER TABLE gst_notices DROP CONSTRAINT gst_notices_client_id_fkey, ADD CONSTRAINT gst_notices_client_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; (same on gst_case_folder_items, gst_refund_applications, gst_drc03_filings, client_sync_log, gstr1_upload_versions, gstr3b_push_versions)

CREATE TABLE gst_litigation_history (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, table_name text NOT NULL, row_id uuid NOT NULL, client_id uuid, op text NOT NULL CHECK (op IN ('UPDATE','DELETE','SYNC_DELETE')), old_row jsonb NOT NULL, actor text, reason text, changed_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); ALTER TABLE gst_litigation_history ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY glh_select ON gst_litigation_history FOR SELECT TO public USING (true); CREATE POLICY glh_insert ON gst_litigation_history FOR INSERT TO public WITH CHECK (true);

CREATE FUNCTION gst_archive_row() RETURNS trigger …; CREATE TRIGGER trg_gst_notices_archive BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON gst_notices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION gst_archive_row(); (same on the other four tables)
ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN retention_until date, ADD COLUMN legal_hold boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false; (same on gst_refund_applications, gst_drc03_filings, gst_matters)
CREATE TRIGGER trg_clients_before_delete BEFORE DELETE ON clients FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION log_client_deletion();

DROP POLICY gst_notices_all ON gst_notices; CREATE POLICY gst_notices_rw ON gst_notices FOR SELECT TO public USING (true); CREATE POLICY gst_notices_ins ON gst_notices FOR INSERT TO public WITH CHECK (true); CREATE POLICY gst_notices_upd ON gst_notices FOR UPDATE TO public USING (true) WITH CHECK (true); (no DELETE policy; same split on the other litigation tables)

epics.name: E4.2 Credential and agent-queue hardening
items: client_portal_credentials (RLS on, no policies, like portal_sessions) with pgp_sym_encrypt using a Vault secret; SECURITY DEFINER RPC get_portal_credentials(client_id, extension_token) that logs to credential_access_log; extension/agent call the RPC just-in-time; getClients returns has_credentials only; then ALTER TABLE clients DROP COLUMN gst_password — fixes 'clients.gst_password stored in plaintext and readable with the public anon key', 'Client GST portal passwords are stored and transmitted in plaintext to three consumers'.

portal_jobs enqueue only via RPC enqueue_portal_job(…, staff_token); portal_sessions.expires_at with nightly purge; service-role key rotation runbook in agent/README.md — fixes 'portal_jobs is writable by the anon key…'.
Accepted-risk register entry in docs/ recording the open-RLS decision with the blast-radius counts — fixes 'Accepted design: with RLS open to public…'.
acceptance_criteria: SELECT gst_password FROM clients with the anon key errors (column gone); a Sync still logs in via the RPC and one credential_access_log row per login exists.
INSERT INTO portal_jobs with the anon key is rejected; the app's queue button still works via the RPC.
