risks: Phase 0's upsert rewrite must be applied to the live project gcquafqxbykxkbexcdpy by hand (no migration ledger) and to every staff PC's side-loaded extension; a PC still running the delete-then-insert build after the migration will keep wiping staff columns — mitigate with MIN_EXTENSION_VERSION gating Sync All and extension_version in client_sync_log.

Partial unique indexes on (client_id, source, reference_number) assume the live 0-duplicate finding holds at migration time; the migration must run the duplicate check and abort if any pair exists (case rows dedupe by t.arn first).

Redefining Open / Overdue / Due-soon / closure will visibly change partner-facing numbers (DRC 03 Open 167 → ~36, Overdue 473 → far fewer); the CONFIRM-WITH-FIRM positions must be signed off by the principal before Phase 0 ships, and the vitest fixture asserts the new values so later drift is caught.

Case-folder due dates and demand figures are parsed from portal JSON shapes that were reverse-engineered (duedt / sdtls.*.duedt / vp.pysum); the portal can change them silently — log unknown shapes to client_sync_log level='debug' and keep the SOP's 'record portal changes' step.

The e-mail pipeline depends on Microsoft Graph client-credentials for gst@vjdesai.com and the pg_cron → edge-function chain; a mis-set dedupe_key or a template variable mismatch could either spam the team or silently drop alerts — start with the daily digest to a test list, then enable per-event mails.

Making return-pdfs private breaks every stored public URL at once; the prefix-strip migration and the signed-URL helper must ship in the same deploy, and old URLs in exported Excels/e-mails stop working by design.

RLS stays open to public per CLAUDE.md, so any client login with devtools can still read/write litigation rows until the SECURITY DEFINER RPC layer (Phase 2 E2.4, Phase 4 E4.1/E4.2) is complete; the accepted-risk register must state this and client-facing features should not launch before Phase 4.

Sync remains CAPTCHA-gated and human-driven; freshness depends on staff running batches per the SOP. Unattended sync (Phase 4 E4.5) is legally constrained (GSTN terms, IT Act) and must not start without a written firm decision; the fastcaptcha.org host permission must be removed until then.

Backfilling matters by (client_id, case_id) covers only ~40% of rows; orphan-notice matters and heuristic grouping will need staff review time ('Link to matter'), which competes with billable work — schedule it per client with the GST team.

No test runner existed; the new vitest fixture covers pure functions only — page-level regressions still rely on npm run build and manual checks against the live dashboard figures recorded in the positions doc.

Effort estimates assume one developer working with Claude Code; Phase 3 (6 weeks) is the largest and should be split into two releases (matters + deadlines/hearings first, demand/documents/MIS second) if the team cannot sustain it.
Encrypting gst_password (Phase 4) changes the extension, the agent and ClientsPage at once; a staged rollout (write both columns for one release, then drop) avoids locking staff out of portal logins.
kpis_to_track: Data integrity: count of gst_notices rows with non-null staff_status / assigned_to_user_id / reply_date before vs after every Sync All (must never decrease); count of 'PULL FAILED%' rows (must be 0); count of origin='manual' rows lost (must be 0).
Reconciliation: tile Total = Notice Summary grand total = GSTIN-wise grand total for the same filters (difference must be 0 every day); Overdue tile = drill-down row count.
Overdue actionable notices (count and ₹ demand) — target trending down week over week; median days overdue.
Due in 7 days coverage: share of notices with a known effective due date (case rows with due_date lifted from folder JSON) — target > 90% of open case rows.
Alert delivery: e-mails sent per kind per day, send failures, median minutes from notice.new event to 'sent' (target < 20 min), duplicate alerts (target 0 via dedupe_key).
Time to first response: hours from first_seen_at to first_viewed_at / assignment (target < 48 h, firm_alert_settings.first_response_hours); share of open notices unassigned (target < 5%).
Reply timeliness: share of notices with reply_date ≤ effective due date; count of ex-parte orders received.
Limitation safety: number of statutory deadlines (appeal/GSTAT/rectification) missed (target 0); number expiring in ≤ 30 d with no assignee.
Sync health: clients never synced, clients stale > 7 d, failed logins per run, runs aborted, median minutes per client, extension version spread across staff PCs.
Demand exposure: total disputed demand ₹ by client/FY/forum, pre-deposit paid vs required, DRC-03 paid this FY, refunds pending ₹ and sanctioned-not-disbursed ₹.
Outcome MIS: matters closed per month by outcome (dropped / confirmed / partly / set aside), average days from SCN to reply and to order.

Product quality: dashboard RPC latency (target < 1 s p95), Lighthouse accessibility ≥ 95, vitest suite green, npm run build green on every commit, number of CONFIRM-WITH-FIRM positions still unsigned (target 0 by end of Phase 0).

roadmap_drafts.angle: User-first, daily-workflow: design from the GST team member's 08:30 inbox and the partner's Monday review. Every phase ships something a person receives (an email, a bell, a queue row) or acts on (a drawer action, a filter chip), and the litigation entity model (matters, deadlines, hearings, demand lines, documents) is introduced underneath the existing gst_notices rows incrementally, never as a big-bang rewrite. Order of work is forced by two facts from the audit: (1) nothing can be trusted or emailed until Sync All stops wiping staff data (extension/background.js:102-105 delete-then-insert) and sentinel 'PULL FAILED' rows stop being counted; (2) no email may carry a PDF link until the return-pdfs bucket is private and the app bridge / role restore / credentials gate are fixed. So Phase 0 is stabilisation + security prerequisites, Phase 1 is the inbox, Phase 2 is the screen, Phases 3-5 are the ERP.
guiding_principles: Start from the morning, not the schema: the first thing built is what lands in gst@vjdesai.com at 08:30 IST and what a staff member does with it in under a minute (open the deep link, see the notice and PDF, assign or log a reply).

Fix the write path before the read path: upsert on (client_id, source, reference_number) with portal-only columns, first_seen_at/last_seen_at, portal_missing_at soft-delete, origin='manual' protected - every KPI, alert and audit trail depends on it (finding 'Every Sync All wipes staff workflow data and manually added notices').

One canonical definition, used everywhere: a single src/utils/noticeDates.ts (effectiveDueDate, daysToDue, isActionable, isOverdue, isDueSoon) and a single case-set builder feed the tiles, Notice Summary, GSTIN-wise count, drill-downs, calendar and emails, locked by a vitest fixture so numbers only change deliberately.

Never email a public URL: emails link to /notices/:id (login required) which redeems a 5-minute signed URL; return-pdfs goes private first (finding 'Prerequisites before notice e-mails carry PDF links').

Reuse the existing pipeline: email_outbox + send-gst-email (Microsoft Graph from gst@vjdesai.com) + pg_cron + RemindersPage are extended with new kinds, cc/bcc, attachments and a dedupe_key - no second queue, no second sender.
Idempotent by construction: every alert row carries a deterministic dedupe_key with a partial unique index, so re-syncs, overlapping crons and manual 'send now' can never double-mail the team.

Additive migrations only, applied to gcquafqxbykxkbexcdpy with RLS FOR ALL TO public; keep routes /notices-dashboard, /notices-all, /notices-company-list, /notices-company/:id, /notices-report, /notices-gstin-wise-count, /refunds-all, /drc03-all working throughout; matters wrap existing rows via gst_notices.matter_id rather than replacing them.
Human before client: staff-vetted preview for every client-facing email; automatic emails go only to the team, assignee and partners.

Write positions down before rewriting them: docs/NOTICES_LITIGATION_FLOW.md with a KEEP / CONFIRM-WITH-FIRM / REPLACE register and a CLAUDE.md paragraph land in Phase 0 so the firm's elected positions (ARN dedupe, taxonomy, no auto-CAPTCHA) survive the redesign.

Design-system parity: 12-column grid, gap-6, text-sm body / text-xs captions / text-3xl tabular-nums numbers, semantic tokens only, aria-labels on every icon button, focus-visible rings, TableEmptyState and Alert for empty/error states (docs/UI-UX-REDESIGN.md).
roadmap_drafts.target_dashboard_layout:
Page root: 12-column CSS grid, max-w none, gap-6, space-y-6 (replaces the current space-y-2.5 and fixed 380x620 right card). Body text-sm, captions text-xs, section titles text-lg, numbers text-3xl tabular-nums. Light-only semantic tokens. All tables inside overflow-x-auto only; tiles 6→3→2 columns at lg/md/sm; queue and category stack under 1280px; charts stack under 1024px.

ROW 0 - PageHeader (full-size, not embedded): title 'Notices & Litigation'; subtitle 'Portal data as of 13 Sep 10:42 · 92 GSTINs with notices / 121 onboarded / 13 never synced · 3 sync failures' computed from client_sync_log via the shared src/lib/syncLog.ts helper (finding 'Last successful sync time per client / data freshness is not shown'). Actions right: [Sync All] primary with a three-state extension chip (not Chrome → hidden with caption; Chrome, no reply in 1.5 s → 'Extension not detected' + Install link; ready → version shown), [Add Notice], [Export] (gated by canExportData). Below: an underline Tabs row derived from useLocation (Overview | Notices | Submissions | Refunds | DRC-03 | Companies | Reports) replacing NoticesTopNav's static pills (finding 'NoticesTopNav shows Dashboard as active on every page'). Sticky filter bar: Financial Year, Client (searchable), Owner (staff picker), Category, Status/Stage, Date range, Registration/Other toggle; every filter propagates through drillParams so tiles, queue, summary and charts agree. Active category from the summary table appears here as a removable chip.

ROW 0b - Sync-health strip (slim, full width, only when non-empty): 'Run in progress 12/92 · 2 failed · started 10:12 by Priya' from sync_runs (Realtime), 'N clients stale >7 days', 'N failed last attempt (login / read / save)', each a link to /notices-company-list?status=... ; extension-missing state rendered as an Alert with the install link rather than 11px muted text.

ROW 1 (above the fold) - six KPI tiles, col-span-2 each, each a focusable <Link> with focus-visible ring, label text-xs muted, value text-3xl, 7-day delta caption and 30-day sparkline: Needs action (effective-open, actionable, not replied); Overdue (destructive; actionable and effectiveDue < today, local-date compare); Due in 7 days (warning; today <= effectiveDue <= today+7, includes case-folder and RFD-08 due dates once lifted); Unassigned (info; assigned_to IS NULL among open); High priority open; Demand under dispute ₹ (sum amount_of_demand over open, lakh/crore formatting). Total notices, Total GSTIN and Failed Logins leave the tile row (header subtitle and sync strip). Tooltip on Needs action shows the reconciliation ('1060 rows = 863 notices + 197 case tasks in 180 cases').

ROW 2 (above the fold on 1080p) - LEFT col-span-8 'Action queue' card: tabs Overdue / Due in 7 days / Hearings this week / Unassigned / High priority / New since last sync / Mine; a real table of notices (top 10, sorted by effective due asc, amount desc within tab): Client (GSTIN + trade name), Category chip, Description (truncate, title on hover), Due (date + 'x days' Badge: destructive <0, warning 0-7), Owner (inline staff Select), Amount ₹, Priority chip, row actions (Open drawer, Mark replied, Assign, Open case folder). Row click opens the NoticeDrawer. Footer 'View all N' → /notices-all with the same filter. Backed by RPC notice_action_queue(tab, filters, limit) so it is one query, not a 1060-row client-side scan. RIGHT col-span-4 'By category' card (auto height, min-h-0): Notice Summary with real rows sorted by Open desc, inline Open/Total bar per row, columns Total | Open | Awaiting reply | Demand ₹, placeholder categories collapsed behind 'Show uncaptured categories (14)' with a 'not captured' Badge; clicking a category applies a filter chip in place (no navigation); the per-cell counts are <Link>s to the drill-down.

ROW 3 - three chart cards, col-span-4 each, using src/components/ui/chart.tsx (recharts) and the dataviz palette: (a) Ageing of open notices, buckets 0-7 / 8-30 / 31-90 / 90+ days stacked by category, bars clickable → /notices-all?age=...; (b) Issued vs closed per month, trailing 12 months (bars + line); (c) Workload by owner (horizontal bars: open, overdue per staff, 'Unassigned' as the first row). All three from one aggregate RPC notice_dashboard_stats(filters) cached by react-query (staleTime 60 s).

ROW 4 - LEFT col-span-8 'Clients needing attention': top 8 clients ranked by overdue then open (columns GSTIN, Trade name, Open, Overdue, Demand ₹, Last successful sync with a red clock when >7 days or failed, Owner), each row → /notices-company/:id. Replaces the '5 most recently created clients' Company card; Add Company / Import / Download Template move to /notices-company-list. RIGHT col-span-4 'This week' agenda: seven rows (date, N due, N hearings, N issued, first two client names, link), with a 'Month' toggle that shows the grid with 4px dot markers (destructive = due, info = issued, warning = hearing) and text-foreground digits, computed over open rows and honouring the on-screen filters (fixes the white-on-amber 'Both' days and the unfiltered-marker/filtered-drill mismatch).

ROW 5 (below the fold, collapsible) - 'Activity since last visit' feed from gst_notice_events (new notices, due date extended, order received, status changed, emails sent) with 'mark all read'; and a 'Records on hold / retention' mini-count once Phase 5 lands.

States: skeleton tiles and skeleton rows during load; an Alert variant=destructive with Retry when any query errors (fetchAllRows returns {rows,error}); TableEmptyState with icon for genuinely empty queues. Mobile (<md): tiles drop the icon circle and go 2-up; queue renders as card rows (client, ref, due badge, owner, one-tap open); summary renders as a stacked list with open/total bar; drawer is full-screen. Deep link: /notices/:id opens the drawer over the dashboard so every email lands on the exact notice.

phases.name: Phase 0 - Stabilise: stop the data loss, make the numbers mean something, close the pre-email security gaps, write the positions down
phases.goal: Within two weeks: a Sync All that preserves staff work and manual notices, tiles whose definitions are written down and locked by a test, a private PDF bucket, a working extension on gst.vjdesai.com, and a positions document so nothing elected is lost in the redesign.

epics.name: E0.1 Idempotent portal sync (upsert, no sentinels, no wholesale delete)
items: Migration supabase/migrations/2026091xxxxxxx_gst_notices_sync_identity.sql: origin/first_seen_at/last_seen_at/portal_missing_at columns; partial unique indexes on gst_notices (client_id, source, reference_number) and (client_id, source, case_id) for portal rows; UNIQUE (client_id, arn) on gst_refund_applications and gst_drc03_filings after a one-off duplicate cleanup keeping min(created_at); unique key on gst_case_folder_items (client_id, case_id, folder_section, coalesce(portal_item_id, reference_number)). Findings: 'Every Sync All wipes staff workflow data and manually added notices', 'No natural/unique key on gst_notices, gst_refund_applications, gst_drc03_filings'.

SECURITY DEFINER RPC upsert_portal_notices(p_client_id uuid, p_rows jsonb, p_run_id uuid) that INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE only portal-owned columns (reference_number, notice_type, description, issue_date, due_date, status, issued_by, case_id, pdf_url, last_seen_at, pulled_at), never staff_* columns, sets portal_missing_at on rows absent from this pull, never touches origin='manual', refuses to mark-missing when the incoming set is empty but existing count > 0 unless p_portal_empty = true; same RPCs upsert_portal_refunds (preserves documents jsonb) and upsert_portal_drc03 (preserves pdf_url) and upsert_case_folder_items (unions attachments by url). Findings: 'Refund documents jsonb is wiped by every re-sync', 'Partial case-folder or refund-document capture overwrites a previously complete one'.

extension/background.js: replaceNotices / replaceRefundApplications / replaceDrc03Filings / replaceCaseFolderItems call the RPCs; wrap sel/post/patch/del in a retry helper (3 attempts, 500 ms / 2 s / 5 s on network error, 429, 5xx). Finding: 'No retry/backoff for Supabase writes'.

extension/content.js: delete the six 'PULL FAILED' replaceNotices/replaceRefund/replaceDrc03 writes (lines ~195, 2471, 2744, 2894, 3160 and the DRC-03 mirror); failures go only to client_sync_log via logSyncAttempt/logClientSync with one row per step (action in 'login','notices','refunds','refund_docs','drc03'); log 'login' failed after 3 CAPTCHA bounces or on the portal's invalid-credentials banner, then advance(job); dedupe task rows by t.arn not refId; make the 20-minute guard a last-activity timeout (job.lastProgressAt). Findings: 'A failed pull deletes all of the client's notices and leaves a fake PULL FAILED notice row', 'Failed Logins tile never counts failed logins', 'Any job older than 20 minutes is silently discarded'.

One-off cleanup SQL in the same migration: DELETE sentinel rows (description LIKE 'PULL FAILED%' / status LIKE 'PULL FAILED%'), then CHECK constraints gst_notices_has_identity and arn NOT NULL on refunds/DRC-03.

src/components/notices/AddNoticeDialog.tsx writes origin='manual' and created_by = user.id; add a soft Delete action for origin='manual' rows behind a delete_notice key (Phase 3 keys) - until then superadmin/gst_manager only.
acceptance_criteria: Set staff_status='Closed', priority='High', assign_to and reply_date on 5 notices of a client, run Sync All for that client twice: all five values survive both runs and updated_at is untouched by the sync (verify with the anon key from .env).
Add a manual notice, run Sync All: it is still present; a portal row that disappears from the portal gets portal_missing_at set and is excluded from tiles, not deleted.

Kill the portal tab mid-pull for a client: gst_notices row count for that client is unchanged; client_sync_log has a 'failed' row with action='notices'; no row with description starting 'PULL FAILED' exists anywhere.
SELECT count(*) FROM gst_notices GROUP BY client_id, source, reference_number HAVING count(*) > 1 returns zero rows; the same for (client_id, arn) on both dedicated tables.
npm run build green; a regression SQL in docs (count of non-null staff_status before/after a sync) shows equality.
schema_changes: ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN origin text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'portal' CHECK (origin IN ('portal','manual')), ADD COLUMN first_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), ADD COLUMN last_seen_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN portal_missing_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN created_by uuid, ADD COLUMN updated_by uuid;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_gst_notices_portal_ref ON gst_notices (client_id, source, reference_number) WHERE origin='portal' AND reference_number IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_gst_notices_portal_case ON gst_notices (client_id, source, case_id) WHERE origin='portal' AND reference_number IS NULL AND case_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_gst_refund_arn ON gst_refund_applications (client_id, arn) WHERE arn IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_gst_drc03_arn ON gst_drc03_filings (client_id, arn) WHERE arn IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_case_folder_item ON gst_case_folder_items (client_id, case_id, folder_section, coalesce(portal_item_id, reference_number));

ALTER TABLE gst_case_folder_items ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ADD COLUMN portal_item_id text, ADD COLUMN issue_date date, ADD COLUMN due_date date, ADD COLUMN item_type text;
ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD CONSTRAINT gst_notices_has_identity CHECK (reference_number IS NOT NULL OR case_id IS NOT NULL OR origin='manual');
CREATE TRIGGER trg_gst_notices_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON gst_notices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();

CREATE FUNCTION upsert_portal_notices(p_client_id uuid, p_rows jsonb, p_run_id uuid, p_portal_empty boolean DEFAULT false) RETURNS jsonb SECURITY DEFINER; (plus upsert_portal_refunds, upsert_portal_drc03, upsert_case_folder_items)

epics.name: E0.2 One truth for the tiles: shared date/state helpers, canonical case set, vitest fixture
items: Create src/utils/noticeDates.ts: todayIso (local Y-M-D), effectiveDueDate(row) = extended_due_date ?? due_date, daysToDue (date-only compare), isActionable = !isClosed(staff_status) && !reply_date && !submission_date && !portal_missing_at, isOverdue, isDueSoon(0..7 inclusive). Replace the four private helpers in NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:249-258, AllClientsNoticesPage.tsx:157-173, CompanyProfilePage.tsx:218-234, NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx:345-348. Findings: 'Over Due (473) includes closed and replied notices...', 'A notice is Over Due from 05:30 IST on its own due date', 'Overdue/due-soon filters duplicated in four places'.

Extract computeNoticeKpis(rows, syncLogs, now) into src/utils/noticeDashboardKpis.ts; add select of extended_due_date, amount_of_demand, assign_to, reference_number, first_seen_at, origin, portal_missing_at to the dashboard query; 'Last 24 Hours' becomes 'New since last sync' = first_seen_at > previous successful run; 'Last 15 days' stays issue_date. Finding: 'Last 24 Hours counts rows rewritten by the last sync'.

Extract a shared buildNoticeCaseSet(noticeRows, refundRows, drc03Rows) into src/utils/noticeSummaryReport.ts (excludes sentinel/missing rows, collapses by (client_id, coalesce(case_id, reference_number)), unions dedicated refund/DRC-03 rows by ARN) and use it in NoticesDashboardPage, GstinWiseNoticeCountPage (switch to fetchAllRows), CompanyProfilePage combined list and the AllClientsNoticesPage Merged tab. Findings: 'GSTIN Wise Notice Count is capped at 1000 rows and double-counts', 'Company Dashboard lists and counts each refund/DRC-03 case twice', 'three different totals on one screen'.

Closure vocabulary: replace the refund/DRC-03 regexes with an explicit status → state lookup (open / sanctioned / disbursed / rejected / withdrawn / deficiency; DRC-03 acknowledged = closed) and treat case-only DRC-03 rows whose description matches 'acknowledgement of acceptance' as closed. Findings: 'DRC 03 Open 167 counts 131 acknowledged payments as open', 'Refund Open 41 includes 22 cases already closed', 'Closure regexes miss live portal statuses'.

src/lib/fetchAllRows.ts: append .order('id') before .range and return {rows, error}; dashboard keeps loadError state and renders an Alert with Retry. Findings: 'fetchAllRows pages without ORDER BY and swallows errors', 'No error state anywhere'.

Minimal vitest: devDependency vitest ^2.1.9, script test: vitest run, vite.config.ts test block; specs src/utils/noticeCategoryClassifier.test.ts, noticeSummaryReport.test.ts, noticeDashboardKpis.test.ts with the anonymised 1060-row fixture asserting the current 1060/3/64/92/1060/0/473/0 and Refund 60/41/19, DRC 03 183/167/16 as the baseline, then the new definitions as a second, deliberate expectation. Finding: 'No test harness; KPI and category definitions are unpinned'.

Lift case-folder due dates: SQL function gst_extract_folder_dates() fills gst_case_folder_items.issue_date/due_date from raw_json (duedt / sdtls.*.duedt / dueDate / dtOfIssue) and a one-off UPDATE sets gst_notices.due_date for case rows from the latest NOTCE/INTIM/NOTAC item without a later REPLY; content.js task loop writes the same at sync time. Findings: 'Case-folder notices never get a due date', 'RFD-08 reply due dates are captured but dropped'.
acceptance_criteria: npm test passes with the baseline fixture and the new-definition fixture; the tile values for the fixture at now=2026-09-13T08:15Z are documented in the test file.

A notice with staff_status='Closed' and due_date yesterday is not counted in Overdue; a notice due today is counted in 'Due in 7 days' at 09:00 IST, not in Overdue; a notice with extended_due_date next week and due_date last week is 'Due in 7 days'.
GSTIN-wise grand total equals the Notice Summary grand total equals the dashboard tooltip reconciliation, on live data.
After the folder-date lift, '7 Days Due' is non-zero when any DRC-01/ASMT-10/RFD-08 case has a reply due within the window (verify with one known case).
Simulating a page-2 fetch error shows the Alert with Retry instead of empty tiles.
schema_changes: CREATE FUNCTION gst_extract_folder_dates() RETURNS void; -- fills gst_case_folder_items.issue_date/due_date from raw_json
UPDATE gst_notices n SET due_date = f.due_date FROM (latest open NOTCE/INTIM/NOTAC per case_id) f WHERE n.case_id = f.case_id AND n.due_date IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_due ON gst_notices (due_date) WHERE staff_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Closed' AND portal_missing_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_case ON gst_notices (client_id, case_id) WHERE case_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_source_status ON gst_notices (source, staff_status);

epics.name: E0.3 Security prerequisites before any email carries a link
items: Storage: UPDATE storage.buckets SET public=false WHERE id='return-pdfs'; DROP the 'Anyone can delete / update return PDFs' policies; one-off migration strips '/storage/v1/object/public/return-pdfs/' from gst_notices.pdf_url, gst_case_folder_items.attachments[].url, gst_refund_applications.documents, gst_drc03_filings.pdf_url leaving object paths; add src/lib/signedPdf.ts (createSignedUrl(path, 300)) and use it at CompanyProfilePage.tsx:381, AdditionalNoticeFolderPage.tsx:516/557, NoticeWorkflowListView.tsx:781/873, AllClientsRefundsPage, AllClientsDrc03Page; the export omits the PDF column. Findings: 'return-pdfs bucket is public with permanent URLs and guessable paths', 'Anyone can delete / update / upload return PDFs'.

extension/manifest.json: add https://gst.vjdesai.com/* to the appbridge content_scripts matches, drop https://*.vercel.app/*, keep the one named preview host, bump version; extension/appbridge.js rejects unless e.source === window && e.origin === location.origin; background.js checks sender.url origin against an allow-list and whitelists msg.fn to start* functions for page senders; announce message includes version and the app shows 'Update the extension (have x, need y)'. Findings: 'Extension bridge only injects on *.vercel.app', 'Extension app bridge accepts postMessage from any origin/frame', 'Extension version is never checked by the app'.

src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx: on bootstrap use roleData.role from user_roles, drop the session if it differs from the stored blob; src/App.tsx adds a <StaffRoute> wrapper and applies it to /clients, /add-client, /edit-client/:id and every notices/refunds/drc03 route; EditClientPage/AddClientPage guard on canAddEditClients(). Findings: 'Session role is restored from the localStorage blob', '/clients has no staff gate', '/add-client and /edit-client/:id have no permission guard'.

New permission key view_portal_credentials (AuthContext UserPermissions + DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS + canViewPortalCredentials() + UserControlPage AVAILABLE_PERMISSIONS): gates the Credentials tab, GSTPortalLink reveal/copy (masked by default, delete the sessionStorage block), the credentials export and the per-row portal-open icons; write credential_access_log(actor, client_id, action, at) on reveal/copy/export. Findings: 'GSTPortalLink shows/copies gst_password with no permission gate', 'Every staff role can read every client's GST portal password'.

background.js job object carries only clientIds; handleLogin fetches one client's credentials just-in-time and clears them after login; job cleared on tab close. Finding: 'Plaintext GST portal passwords are copied into chrome.storage.local for every queued client'.
ManageEmployeesPage: only superadmin may create/promote gst_manager. Finding: 'manage_employees lets an employee create GST Manager accounts'.
acceptance_criteria: An unauthenticated GET of a previously known notice PDF URL returns 400/403; the same PDF opens from the app via a signed URL that expires in 5 minutes.
DELETE on storage.objects with the anon key is refused (test with curl using VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY).

On https://gst.vjdesai.com the dashboard shows the extension chip 'Ready · v0.3.0' and Sync All starts a job; a postMessage from a foreign iframe or a *.vercel.app page is ignored (console shows the rejection).
Editing vjdesai_user.role to 'superadmin' in a client login and reloading lands on /dashboard as a client, not the staff shell; /clients redirects a client to /dashboard.
An employee without view_portal_credentials sees no Credentials tab and no reveal button; a reveal by a manager writes a credential_access_log row.

DROP POLICY "Anyone can delete return PDFs" ON storage.objects; DROP POLICY "Anyone can update return PDFs" ON storage.objects;

epics.name: E0.4 Positions document, SOP, runbook, quick UI defects
items: Write docs/NOTICES_LITIGATION_FLOW.md in the docs/2B_RECONCILIATION_FLOW.md style: preamble, flow diagram, §Category taxonomy table (category → source), §Tile definitions (old and new formulas side by side), §Status vocabularies, §Sync procedure with the operational constants, §Staff SOP (Sync All, 10 lines), §Runbook (failed login / failed pull, 10 lines), §Known limitations, §Legal/risk incl. the CAPTCHA decision (remove the fastcaptcha.org host permission or record approval), §Positions register tagged KEEP / CONFIRM-WITH-FIRM / REPLACE, §Where to find things; transcribe every dated 'confirmed live' comment before any refactor. acceptance_criteria: docs/NOTICES_LITIGATION_FLOW.md exists with every position from the audit's register tagged; CLAUDE.md links to it; extension/README.md mentions gst.vjdesai.com, notices_bundle and the SOP.
npm run lint reports zero react-hooks/rules-of-hooks errors in the three pages; grep -c aria-label src/pages/NoticesDashboardPage.tsx >= 6.
Navigating to /notices-all highlights 'Notices' in the top tabs and 'Notices Dashboard' in the sidebar.
The Failed-syncs count in the header strip equals the number of clients shown by /notices-company-list?status=failed.

phases.name: Phase 1 - The morning inbox: every important matter reaches the GST team by email
phases.goal: By the end of week 5 the team receives, without opening the app: a new-notice email within 15 minutes of a sync (PDF attached, deep link), a due-date ladder addressed to the owner, an 08:30 daily digest, a sync-failure alert, and an in-app bell - all idempotent, all configurable by the principal on RemindersPage without a deploy.

epics.name: E1.1 Outbox and template plumbing for notice kinds
items: Migration 2026xxxx_email_outbox_notice_alerts.sql widening email_outbox and email_templates as per finding 'email_outbox schema physically blocks team alerts': nullable client_id, new kinds, cc/bcc arrays, attachments jsonb, dedupe_key with partial unique index, notice_id/matter_id, not_before, channel, audience; seed template rows notice_new, notice_due_t7, notice_due_t3, notice_due_t1, notice_due_today, notice_overdue, notice_assigned, notice_hearing, sync_failed, notice_digest_daily, partner_weekly_summary, client_notice_intimation with variables text[]. Findings: 'Email pipeline cannot carry a notice', 'No idempotency key for alerts', 'Single recipient only - no cc/bcc'.

Single-row firm_alert_settings (team_emails default '{gst@vjdesai.com}', partner_emails, ladder_days '{7,3,1,0}', overdue_repeat_days 3, overdue_max 5, digest_enabled, weekly_enabled, first_response_hours 48, quiet_start/quiet_end) edited by a new 'Notice alert recipients' card in src/components/reminders/NoticeAlertSettingsCard.tsx on RemindersPage. Finding: 'No per-recipient preferences, quiet hours'.

supabase/functions/send-gst-email/index.ts: select cc_emails/bcc_emails/attachments/not_before; map to ccRecipients/bccRecipients; download each attachment from the private bucket with the service key, base64, append as #microsoft.graph.fileAttachment under 3 MB else note '(PDF too large - open in app)'; query adds .or('not_before.is.null,not_before.lte.now()'); backstop cron to */10 * * * *. Finding: 'Sender cannot attach the notice PDF'.

supabase/functions/_shared/email.ts and src/lib/emailTemplate.ts: shell entries per kind (notice_new navy 'New notice', notice_due_* amber→red, notice_overdue red, notice_hearing purple, sync_failed grey, digest table-per-section, client intimation gold) with detail rows driven by vars.detail_rows; RemindersPage outbox gets KIND_META, a 'Regarding' column (client + reference or 'Firm digest'), Kind filter tabs and a Recipients column; EmailTemplatesEditor reads email_templates.variables for the preview. Finding: 'Outbox UI and email shell are hard-wired to return/period semantics'.
acceptance_criteria: INSERT INTO email_outbox (kind='notice_new', client_id NULL, dedupe_key='x') succeeds; inserting the same dedupe_key a second time is ignored with Prefer: resolution=ignore-duplicates.
A test row with cc_emails and one 200 KB PDF attachment arrives in the team inbox with the PDF attached and the cc visible.
Changing team_emails on RemindersPage changes the recipient of the next queued alert without a deploy.
RemindersPage outbox lists the notice rows with a readable 'Regarding' cell and the right pill colour.
email_events: (plumbing only - no events fire yet; the send path is verified with a manual test row)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_email_outbox_dedupe ON email_outbox (dedupe_key) WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE email_templates DROP CONSTRAINT email_templates_kind_check, ADD CONSTRAINT email_templates_kind_check CHECK (kind IN (...same list...)), ADD COLUMN audience text CHECK (audience IN ('client','team','partner')), ADD COLUMN variables text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}';

CREATE TABLE firm_alert_settings (id int PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 1 CHECK (id=1), team_emails text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{gst@vjdesai.com}', partner_emails text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', ladder_days int[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{7,3,1,0}', overdue_repeat_days int NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, overdue_max int NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, digest_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, weekly_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, first_response_hours int NOT NULL DEFAULT 48, quiet_start time, quiet_end time, updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), updated_by uuid);

epics.name: E1.2 Event layer: gst_notice_events fed by triggers, processed by notify-notice-events
items: Table gst_notice_events with dedupe_key unique; triggers: trg_gst_notices_new_event AFTER INSERT (WHEN origin='portal' OR origin='manual', reference_number/case_id not null) → 'notice.new'; AFTER UPDATE OF due_date/extended_due_date → 'notice.due_date_changed'; AFTER UPDATE OF staff_status → 'notice.status_changed'; AFTER UPDATE OF assigned_to (Phase 2 column; trigger created now, fires later) → 'notice.assigned'; trg_client_sync_log_failed AFTER INSERT WHEN status='failed' AND level='outcome' → 'sync.failed' (dedupe per client per day); AFTER INSERT on gst_refund_applications/gst_drc03_filings → 'refund.new'/'drc03.new'; upsert_portal_notices emits 'notice.order_received' when an ORDRS folder item appears for a case. Findings: 'No new notice landed event or email', 'No new-vs-updated detection or change log', 'Failed portal logins are recorded but nobody is told'.

Edge function supabase/functions/notify-notice-events/index.ts on pg_cron */15 * * * * (same vault-anon-key http_post pattern as 20260726130000_gst_email_cron.sql): reads unprocessed events, groups notice.new by client into one email per client per run, renders notice_new with vars {client_name, gstin, notice_type, category, reference_number, issue_date, due_date, amount_of_demand, issued_by, app_url=/notices/:id}, attachments=[pdf path], to = team_emails + assignee email, inserts email_outbox with dedupe_key 'notice.new:{notice_id}', inserts staff_notifications, marks processed_at, then invokes send-gst-email immediately for kinds notice_new and sync_failed. Optional: extension POSTs {clientId, runId} to the function after the notices step so the mail goes out within seconds.

staff_notifications table + NotificationBell component in MainLayout header (supabase.channel postgres_changes, unread badge, dropdown linking to /notices/:id, mark all read appends user id to read_by). Finding: 'No in-app notification bell'.
Dashboard 'Activity since last visit' feed (ROW 5) reading gst_notice_events.
acceptance_criteria: Run Sync All for a client with one genuinely new notice: within 15 minutes gst@vjdesai.com receives one 'New notice' email with the PDF attached and a link that opens /notices/:id after login; a second sync of the same client sends nothing.
A 'failed' client_sync_log row produces exactly one sync_failed email per client per day, naming the step (login / notices / refunds / drc03) and the message.
The bell shows the unread count within 5 s of the event without reloading; 'mark all read' clears it for that user only.
Manual Add Notice triggers notice.new the same way as a portal row.
email_events: notice.new (first_seen row, portal or manual) → team_emails + assignee (if set); cc none → template notice_new, PDF attached, deep link /notices/:id → every 15 min, sent immediately after enqueue; dedupe notice.new:{notice_id}

notice.order_received (ORDRS folder item appears on a case) → team_emails + assignee + partner_emails → template order_received (includes 'appeal window closes on order_date + 3 months') → within 15 min; dedupe notice.order:{notice_id}:{order_ref}

sync.failed (client_sync_log status='failed', level='outcome') → team_emails → template sync_failed (step, message, 'Fix credentials' link) → within 15 min, once per client per day; dedupe sync.failed:{client_id}:{yyyy-mm-dd}

refund.status_changed to rejected/deficiency (RFD-03/RFD-06 rejection) and drc03.new → team_emails → folded into notice_digest_daily, immediate only for rejection/deficiency; dedupe refund.status:{arn}:{status}
schema_changes: CREATE TABLE gst_notice_events (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, client_id uuid, event_kind text NOT NULL CHECK (event_kind IN ('notice.new','notice.due','notice.overdue','notice.due_date_changed','notice.assigned','notice.status_changed','notice.order_received','hearing.upcoming','refund.new','refund.status_changed','drc03.new','sync.failed','email.sent')), payload jsonb, actor_user_id uuid, actor_source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system' CHECK (actor_source IN ('app','extension','agent','system')), occurred_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), processed_at timestamptz, dedupe_key text UNIQUE);
CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notice_events_unprocessed ON gst_notice_events (occurred_at) WHERE processed_at IS NULL;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_gst_notices_new_event AFTER INSERT ON gst_notices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION gst_notice_emit_new(); (plus trg_gst_notices_changed AFTER UPDATE OF due_date, extended_due_date, staff_status, assigned_to; trg_client_sync_log_failed AFTER INSERT ON client_sync_log; trg_refund_new, trg_drc03_new)

CREATE TABLE staff_notifications (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid, kind text, title text NOT NULL, body text, link text, notice_id uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), read_by uuid[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}');
SELECT cron.schedule('gst-notify-notice-events', '*/15 * * * *', $$ ...http_post to notify-notice-events... $$);

epics.name: E1.3 Due-date ladder, daily digest, deep-link route
items: Edge function queue-notice-reminders, pg_cron 30 3 * * * (09:00 IST): over actionable rows (shared SQL view v_notice_actionable mirroring noticeDates.ts) compute days_left in IST against coalesce(extended_due_date, due_date); steps from firm_alert_settings.ladder_days → notice_due_t7/t3/t1/today; overdue every overdue_repeat_days up to overdue_max → notice_overdue; to = assignee email (Phase 2 FK; until then team_emails), cc gst_manager profiles from T-1, cc partner_emails once overdue; vars {client_name, gstin, notice_type, reference_number, issue_date, due_date, days_left, amount_of_demand, priority, assignee, app_url}. Finding: 'No due-date escalation ladder for notices'.

Edge function notice-daily-digest, pg_cron 0 3 * * 1-6 (08:30 IST Mon-Sat): sections New since yesterday, Due in 7 days, Overdue (by amount desc), Unassigned open, Hearings this week (from Phase 3, empty until then), Sync failures, Not synced in 7+ days / never synced, Refund deficiency/rejection, DRC-03 filed in last 24 h; skip when all sections empty; to team_emails, cc every superadmin/gst_manager profile email; dedupe digest:daily:{date}. Finding: 'No daily digest to the GST team'.

Route /notices/:id in src/App.tsx rendering the Notices Dashboard with the NoticeDrawer open (drawer itself is Phase 2 - in Phase 1 the route lands on /notices-all?ref=<reference_number> pre-filtered and highlighted) so every email link works from day one.

Stale-sync section source: view client_sync_status (client_id, last_success_at, last_attempt_at, last_status, last_message, last_run_id) used by the digest, the header subtitle and Company List. Finding: 'Last successful sync time per client / data freshness is not shown'.
acceptance_criteria: Seed three notices due in 7, 3 and 1 days and one 5 days overdue: the 09:00 IST run creates exactly four outbox rows with dedupe keys notice.due:{id}:7 / :3 / :1 / :overdue:1; running the function again the same day creates none.
The daily digest arrives at 08:30 IST Mon-Sat, is skipped on a day with nothing to report, and each section's 'View all' link opens /notices-all with the matching filter.
A client whose last success is 8 days old appears under 'Not synced in 7+ days' with a link to /notices-company-list?status=stale.
Clicking any email link while logged out lands on /login and then returns to the notice.
email_events: notice.due T-7 / T-3 / T-1 / T0 (actionable rows, effective due) → assignee (fallback team_emails); cc gst_manager from T-1 → templates notice_due_t7 / notice_due_t3 / notice_due_t1 / notice_due_today → daily 09:00 IST; dedupe notice.due:{notice_id}:{step}

notice.overdue (actionable, effective due < today, every 3 days, max 5) → assignee + team_emails; cc partner_emails → template notice_overdue → daily 09:00 IST; dedupe notice.due:{notice_id}:overdue:{n}

digest.daily → team_emails; cc all superadmin/gst_manager → template notice_digest_daily (sections: new, due 7d, overdue, unassigned, hearings, sync failures, stale syncs, refund deficiency/rejection, DRC-03 last 24 h) → 08:30 IST Mon-Sat, skipped when empty; dedupe digest:daily:{yyyy-mm-dd}
schema_changes: CREATE VIEW v_notice_actionable AS SELECT n.*, coalesce(n.extended_due_date, n.due_date) AS effective_due FROM gst_notices n WHERE n.portal_missing_at IS NULL AND lower(coalesce(n.staff_status,'')) NOT IN ('closed','dropped') AND n.reply_date IS NULL AND n.submission_date IS NULL AND n.description NOT LIKE 'PULL FAILED%';

CREATE VIEW client_sync_status AS SELECT c.id AS client_id, max(l.created_at) FILTER (WHERE l.status='success' AND l.action='notices' AND l.level='outcome') AS last_success_at, max(l.created_at) FILTER (WHERE l.action='notices' AND l.level='outcome') AS last_attempt_at, ... FROM clients c LEFT JOIN client_sync_log l ON l.client_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id;
SELECT cron.schedule('gst-queue-notice-reminders-daily', '30 3 * * *', ...); SELECT cron.schedule('gst-notice-daily-digest', '0 3 * * 1-6', ...);

phases.name: Phase 2 - The screen: redesigned dashboard, action queue, notice drawer, named owners
phases.goal: By week 9 the dashboard answers 'what do I reply to today, for whom, by when' on one screen at 1366px and 1920px, every row opens a drawer with the PDF and one-click actions, and every notice has a named owner so the ladder emails reach a person.

epics.name: E2.1 Named assignee and permission keys
items: Migration: gst_notices.assigned_to uuid REFERENCES profiles(user_id), assigned_by, assigned_at, status_changed_by/at, first_viewed_at/by, closed_reason, closed_at; backfill assigned_to from lower(trim(assign_to)) = lower(profiles.first_name); clients.notice_handler_user_id as the default owner for new pulled notices (set by upsert_portal_notices); client_assignments(client_id, user_id, role). Findings: 'assign_to is free text, not a user FK', 'No per-employee data scoping exists anywhere'.

Staff picker component src/components/notices/StaffSelect.tsx (profiles joined to user_roles in staff roles, the query UserControlPage already uses); used in NoticeWorkflowListView edit dialog, bulk toolbar 'Assign', queue rows and the drawer; assignment fires notice.assigned → email + bell.

New permission keys in AuthContext/UserControlPage grouped under 'Notices & Litigation': sync_notices, assign_notice, close_notice, delete_notice, export_notices, notify_client (view_portal_credentials from Phase 0); gate Sync All / Company List Sync / Reports Pull on sync_notices, the 'Closed' option (inline + bulk) on close_notice with a Close dialog requiring reason + optional order ref/DRC-03 ARN and useConfirm() with the count for bulk, Export buttons and 'Download all visible PDFs' on export_notices; UserControlPage renders grouped cards with the 'GST Manager already has every permission' banner. Findings: 'Permission matrix for the notices/litigation surface', 'One key covers add, edit, assign, priority and mass-close', 'export_data permission exists but is never enforced', 'User Control shows 22 flat checkboxes'.

Write gst_notice_events rows (actor_source='app', actor_user_id from AppUser) from every save path: handleStatusChange, applyBulkStatus, applyBulkPriority, saveEdit, AddNoticeDialog, Close dialog; also audit_log rows for bulk close. Findings: 'Closing/reopening a notice needs no reason ... leaves no trace', 'No audit trail of who changed status'.
acceptance_criteria: Assigning a notice to 'Harsh' via the picker sends notice_assigned to Harsh's profiles.email within 15 minutes and the next T-3 reminder for that notice goes to Harsh, cc gst@vjdesai.com.

An employee without close_notice cannot see 'Closed' in the inline or bulk status Select; a manager closing 20 rows sees a confirm with '20 notices' and must pick a reason; gst_notice_events shows 20 rows with the actor.
An employee without sync_notices does not see Sync All; without export_notices the Export button is hidden.
The 'Mine' tab on the queue shows only notices where assigned_to = me OR client in my client_assignments.
email_events: notice.assigned (assigned_to changes to a non-null user) → the assignee's profiles.email; cc team_emails → template notice_assigned (client, ref, due, amount, deep link) → within 15 min via notify-notice-events; dedupe notice.assigned:{notice_id}:{assigned_to}:{assigned_at}

escalation.unassigned (open notice with due within 7 days and assigned_to NULL for > first_response_hours) → gst_manager profiles + team_emails → template notice_digest_daily section 'Unassigned & due soon' (no separate mail) → daily 08:30 IST
schema_changes: ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN assigned_to uuid REFERENCES profiles(user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN assigned_by uuid, ADD COLUMN assigned_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN status_changed_by uuid, ADD COLUMN status_changed_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN closed_reason text, ADD COLUMN closed_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN first_viewed_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN first_viewed_by uuid, ADD COLUMN deleted_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN deleted_by uuid;
UPDATE gst_notices n SET assigned_to = p.user_id FROM profiles p WHERE n.assigned_to IS NULL AND lower(trim(n.assign_to)) = lower(p.first_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_assigned ON gst_notices (assigned_to) WHERE staff_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Closed' AND portal_missing_at IS NULL;
ALTER TABLE clients ADD COLUMN notice_handler_user_id uuid REFERENCES profiles(user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

CREATE TABLE client_assignments (client_id uuid REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id uuid NOT NULL, role text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lead' CHECK (role IN ('lead','support')), PRIMARY KEY (client_id, user_id));
ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD CONSTRAINT gst_notices_staff_status_check CHECK (staff_status IS NULL OR staff_status IN ('Open','Closed','Replied','On Hold','Dropped'));

epics.name: E2.2 Notice drawer and /notices/:id
items: src/components/notices/NoticeDrawer.tsx (shadcn Sheet, right, 560px, full-screen below md): header (client + GSTIN, reference, type/category chip, section, issue / due / extended due with days-to-due badge, demand ₹, priority chip, owner StaffSelect, status); tabs Details | Case folder (reuse AdditionalNoticeFolderPage section tables by case_id) | Documents (inline <iframe> of the signed URL for pdf_url and folder attachments, plus 'Firm documents' upload list from Phase 3) | Activity (gst_notice_events timeline + 'Add note') | Emails (email_outbox rows with notice_id); footer intent actions: Log reply (ref, date, attachment → status Replied), Log order (no, date, demand → prompt 'file appeal by <order_date + 3 months>'), Log hearing (Phase 3 table), Assign, Close (reason), Email GST team (compose with prefilled refs), Notify client (Phase 4), Print status PDF (Phase 4), Add to calendar (.ics blob with due/extended/hearing dates). Findings: 'No detail page/drawer for a plain notice', 'Logging a reply and closing the notice are two separate interactions', 'No Google/Outlook calendar export'.
Route /notices/:id in App.tsx opens the drawer over the dashboard; every email deep link and bell item targets it; set first_viewed_at/by on first open.

AdditionalNoticeFolderPage: same action bar as the drawer, breadcrumb back to /notices-company/:clientId, inline PDF panel; derive displayStatus from a portal_closed boolean maintained by upsert_case_folder_items (ORDRS/CLOSURE present) so folder and dashboard agree. Finding: 'Case folder page has no actions, no PDF viewer, and its Status disagrees with the dashboard'.
acceptance_criteria: From the daily digest, clicking a notice opens the drawer with the PDF rendered inline within 2 s; 'Log reply' with a date sets staff_status='Replied', writes reply_date and an Activity row, and the row disappears from Overdue on the dashboard without a reload.
The Activity tab shows the sync that created the notice, every status/assignment change with actor, and every email sent about it.
The drawer is usable at 400px width (no horizontal scroll, footer actions wrap).
Case folder page status equals the dashboard's open/closed state for the same case on 10 spot-checked cases.
email_events: notice.email_team (manual 'Email GST team' from the drawer or bulk toolbar) → team_emails; cc chosen staff → template notice_new variant 'notice_forward' with staff note → immediate; dedupe none (each send is a distinct user action, logged as event email.sent)
schema_changes: CREATE TABLE gst_notice_notes (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), notice_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, matter_id uuid, body text NOT NULL, is_pinned boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, author_id uuid NOT NULL, author_name text, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), edited_at timestamptz);
ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN portal_closed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN portal_closed_reason text;

ALTER TABLE staff_task_reminders ADD COLUMN client_id uuid REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid, ADD COLUMN remind_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN notify_email boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

epics.name: E2.3 Dashboard rebuild (target layout) with server-side aggregates
items: Rewrite src/pages/NoticesDashboardPage.tsx to the target layout: PageHeader + tabs + sticky filter bar; sync-health strip from sync_runs/client_sync_status (Realtime subscription, re-query tiles when finished_at is set, 'N new' toast); six KPI tiles with delta + sparkline; Action queue (col-span-8) with tabs and inline owner select; By category (col-span-4) with collapsed placeholders, inline bars, 'Awaiting reply' and Demand ₹ columns, chip-filter behaviour; three chart cards on src/components/ui/chart.tsx; Clients needing attention; This week agenda with Month toggle; Activity feed. Findings: 'No needs attention today queue', 'KPI tile set is partly vanity', 'Company onboarding card does not belong', 'Calendar widget conveys almost nothing', 'Notice Summary table: 14 placeholder dash rows', 'Two category-row click behaviours look identical', 'Layout wastes width at 1920px', 'No ageing, trend or category charts', 'Amount at stake is captured but never shown', 'Priority tiers exist but the Priority tile was removed', 'No owner / assignee dimension'.

RPCs notice_dashboard_stats(p_fy, p_client, p_owner, p_category, p_from, p_to) returning tile counts + 7-day deltas + 30-day sparklines + category rows + ageing buckets + monthly issued/closed + per-owner load, and notice_action_queue(p_tab, filters, p_limit) returning rows; one useQuery each with staleTime 60 s; fetchAllRows kept only for exports. Finding: 'Four ad-hoc effects fetch the whole gst_notices table client-side'.

Views gst_notice_counts_by_client and gst_notice_category_counts so GstinWiseNoticeCountPage and NoticeSummaryReportPage read server-side counts. Finding: 'GSTIN-wise Notice Count silently truncates at 1000 rows'.

AllClientsNoticesPage / NoticeWorkflowListView: Age and Days-to-due columns with Badge colours and left-border urgency, sortable headers with ?sort=&dir=, saved views (My open, Due in 7 days, Overdue & unreplied, Unassigned, New since last sync), bulk toolbar Assign / Set extended due date / Add remark / Email GST team / Export selected, useMemo on table and onRowPatched so edits do not revert, card list below md. Findings: 'No ageing / days-to-due columns', 'No column sorting', 'Bulk toolbar covers only Status and Priority', 'Inline status/priority edits revert on screen', 'Mobile: 23-column nowrap table'.
Company Profile: tiles clickable, full NoticeWorkflowListView scoped to the client, client Activity feed. Finding: 'Company Profile KPI tiles are not clickable'.
acceptance_criteria: At 1920px the page fills the width with no dead band; at 1366px the tiles, queue and category card are all above the fold; at 400px nothing scrolls horizontally.
Tile numbers equal the count of rows in the drill-down they link to, for all six tiles, on live data.
Dashboard first paint with warm cache < 300 ms and cold load issues two RPC calls, not four full-table downloads (check the Network tab).
Lighthouse accessibility >= 95 on the dashboard; every icon button has an aria-label; keyboard Tab reaches every tile, queue row and chart legend.
Starting Sync All shows 'Syncing 1/N' in the strip on a second machine within 5 s and the tiles refresh when the run finishes.
schema_changes: CREATE FUNCTION notice_dashboard_stats(p_fy text, p_client uuid, p_owner uuid, p_category text, p_from date, p_to date) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql STABLE;
CREATE FUNCTION notice_action_queue(p_tab text, p_owner uuid, p_client uuid, p_category text, p_limit int DEFAULT 10) RETURNS SETOF gst_notices STABLE;

CREATE VIEW gst_notice_counts_by_client AS SELECT client_id, count(*) total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ...open...) open, count(*) FILTER (WHERE reply_date IS NOT NULL) replied, sum(amount_of_demand) FILTER (WHERE ...open...) demand FROM gst_notices WHERE portal_missing_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY client_id;
CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_issue ON gst_notices (issue_date DESC); CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_type ON gst_notices (notice_type);

phases.name: Phase 3 - Litigation core: matters, stages, statutory deadlines, hearings, demand, documents, approvals
phases.goal: By week 13 every dispute is one matter with a stage, its own hearing and limitation dates on the calendar and in the ladder emails, a demand/paid ledger, an immutable document set in a private bucket, an audit trail and a partner sign-off step - built underneath the existing notice rows via matter_id.

epics.name: E3.1 Matter entity, stage machine, auto-grouping
items: Migration creating gst_matters (matter_type, forum, stage CHECK ladder, financial_years text[], section_of_law text[], authority_designation, jurisdiction, portal_case_id, assigned_to, reviewer_id, counsel_id, exposure_amount, outcome, tags, sla fields, opened_at/closed_at/closure_reason), gst_matter_stage_history with AFTER UPDATE OF stage trigger, gst_notices.matter_id, gst_drc03_filings/gst_refund_applications.matter_id, gst_case_folder_items.matter_id. Findings: 'No matter/case entity', 'No stage/status state machine', 'Section of law and financial year are free text'.

Backfill RPC gst_group_matters(): one matter per (client_id, case_id) for case rows (type from CASE_NOTICE_TYPE_MAP), one per refund ARN, one per DRC-03 ARN not linked to an SCN, one per orphan notice; upsert_portal_notices assigns matter_id on insert by the same rules; 'Link to matter' / 'Merge matters' actions in the drawer for the heuristic cases. Finding: 'Documents of one dispute are not chained'.

Pages: /litigation/matters (list: client, title, type, forum, stage, next deadline, exposure, owner, ageing since last action) and /litigation/matters/:id workspace with tabs Timeline (litigation events from notices, folder items, refunds, DRC-03, emails, notes) | Documents | Demand & Payments | Hearings | Deadlines | Tasks & Approvals | Correspondence | Notes; sidebar entry 'Litigation'; drawer header shows the matter and stage; Stage + Outcome control replaces the Open/Closed Select for matter-linked notices (staff_status kept in sync by trigger for old readers). Findings: 'Outcome tracking: status vocabulary is only Open/Closed', 'No reply-drafting workspace' (drafts only, templates in Phase 4).
Dashboard toggle 'Count: Matters | Documents' and Notice Summary Stage pivot; Amnesty (s.128A) category with eligibility flag. Finding: 's.128A amnesty matters lose their identity'.
acceptance_criteria: gst_group_matters() on live data creates matters such that every gst_notices row has a matter_id, count(distinct matter_id) for 'Appeal' rows equals the number of appeal cases (4 expected per the audit), and no matter spans two clients.
Changing a matter's stage writes gst_matter_stage_history with actor and updates the linked notices' staff_status consistently (Closed for closed_* stages).
The workspace Timeline shows intimation → SCN → reply → order in date order for a known DRC-01 case with its folder attachments.
Notice Summary 'Count: Matters' shows the deduped case counts and 'Documents' reproduces the Phase 0 baseline.
email_events: matter.stage_changed to order_received / appeal_filed / closed_* → assignee + partner_emails → template order_received / matter_digest → within 15 min; dedupe matter.stage:{matter_id}:{to_stage}:{changed_at}
schema_changes: CREATE TABLE gst_matters (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, matter_no text UNIQUE, title text NOT NULL, matter_type text NOT NULL CHECK (matter_type IN ('scrutiny_asmt10','audit_adt','adjudication_s73','adjudication_s74','adjudication_s74a','appeal_apl01','gstat_apl05','high_court','supreme_court','recovery','refund','registration','eway_bill','amnesty_128a','summons_s70','itc_mismatch_drc01b','non_filer','rectification','other')), forum text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proper_officer' CHECK (forum IN ('proper_officer','appellate_authority','gstat','high_court','supreme_court')), stage text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new' CHECK (stage IN ('new','under_review','awaiting_client_docs','reply_drafted','reply_filed','ph_scheduled','order_awaited','order_received','rectification_filed','appeal_filed','gstat_filed','recovery','closed_dropped','closed_paid','closed_favourable','closed_partly','closed_time_barred')), outcome text CHECK (outcome IN ('dropped','confirmed_full','confirmed_part','set_aside','remanded','withdrawn','appealed','paid_settled','amnesty_128a','time_barred')), financial_years text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', section_of_law text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', jurisdiction text CHECK (jurisdiction IN ('centre','state')), authority_designation text, authority_office text, portal_case_id text, assigned_to uuid, reviewer_id uuid, counsel_id uuid, exposure_amount numeric, tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', first_response_due timestamptz, first_responded_at timestamptz, escalation_level smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, internal_target_date date, opened_at date NOT NULL DEFAULT current_date, closed_at date, closure_reason text, created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), updated_by uuid);
CREATE INDEX ON gst_matters (client_id, stage); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matters USING gin (tags);

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_stage_history (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, from_stage text, to_stage text NOT NULL, changed_by uuid, changed_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), note text);

ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN section_invoked text, ADD COLUMN issue_tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', ADD COLUMN tax_period_from date, ADD COLUMN tax_period_to date, ADD COLUMN tax_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GST'; CREATE INDEX ON gst_notices (matter_id);

ALTER TABLE gst_refund_applications ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; ALTER TABLE gst_drc03_filings ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN payment_purpose text CHECK (payment_purpose IN ('voluntary_s73_5','voluntary_s74_5','against_scn','against_order','pre_deposit_s107','pre_deposit_s112','annual_return','audit','recovery','other')), ADD COLUMN linked_by uuid, ADD COLUMN linked_at timestamptz; ALTER TABLE gst_case_folder_items ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
CREATE FUNCTION gst_group_matters() RETURNS int SECURITY DEFINER; -- backfill

epics.name: E3.2 Deadlines engine, hearings, calendar and reminders
items: gst_matter_deadlines with kinds reply_due / ph_date / appeal_limitation / appeal_condonable_limit / rectification_s161 / gstat_limitation / revocation_reg21 / pre_deposit_due / rfd08_reply / spl02_payment / internal_target / other; SQL function gst_seed_statutory_deadlines(matter_id) and src/utils/litigationLimitation.ts rules keyed on matter_type + stage + order/notice date (reply_due = issue + 30 or portal duedt; APL-01 = order + 3 months, condonable + 1 month; APL-05 = 3 months; s.161 = 6 months; REG-21 = 90 days; RFD-08 = 15 days; DRC-22A objection = 7 days); auto-seeded on order_received / stage changes; is_met on Log reply / Log appeal. Findings: 'No statutory limitation dates', 'No stage-based due-date or statutory limitation engine'.

gst_hearings (scheduled_on, mode, venue, officer, attended_by, counsel_id, outcome, adjourned_to, notes) with 'Log hearing' in the drawer and workspace; hearing marker colour on the dashboard agenda/month grid; 'Hearings this week' queue tab and digest section; .ics export includes hearings. Findings: 'No hearings/adjournments table', 'No hearing calendar'.

Tiles/queue read gst_matter_deadlines for Overdue / Due in 7 days (union with notice effective due), plus a 'Limitation expiring ≤30 days' tile on /litigation and a dashboard chip; /litigation/calendar month view over reply due + hearings + limitation.

queue-notice-reminders second pass: hearing T-3/T-1/T0 → notice_hearing; appeal_limitation T-15/T-7/T-1 while stage in (order_received) and no appeal logged → limitation_warning; pre_deposit_due T-3. Finding: 'No hearing-date, appeal-limitation or order-received reminders'.

Recovery actions table (DRC-07A/13/16/22/22A/23, objection_due, stay_status deemed_s107_7 / court_stay) with 'Attachment active' badge and DRC-22A objection deadline seeded. Finding: 'Recovery and attachment proceedings have no structured tracking'.
acceptance_criteria: Logging an order dated 2026-09-01 on a s.73 matter creates deadlines appeal_limitation 2026-12-01 and appeal_condonable_limit 2027-01-01 and rectification_s161 2027-03-01; logging an appeal marks appeal_limitation met.

A hearing logged for tomorrow appears in the agenda with the hearing marker, in the queue's 'Hearings this week' tab, and produces notice_hearing T-1 at the next 09:00 IST run to the assignee and partners.
Limitation warnings fire at T-15/T-7/T-1 exactly once each (dedupe keys) and stop once the appeal is logged.
A DRC-22 logged today creates a 7-day objection deadline that shows in Overdue after day 7 if unmet.
email_events: hearing.upcoming T-3 / T-1 / T0 → assignee + partner_emails; cc team_emails → template notice_hearing (matter, officer, venue/mode, documents to carry, deep link) → daily 09:00 IST; dedupe hearing:{hearing_id}:{step}

limitation.warning (appeal_limitation / gstat_limitation / rectification_s161 / rfd08_reply / revocation_reg21 at T-15 / T-7 / T-1, unmet) → assignee + partner_emails + team_emails → template limitation_warning (statutory basis, date, condonable date) → daily 09:00 IST; dedupe limitation:{deadline_id}:{step}
pre_deposit.due T-3 (appeal_filed stage, pre-deposit line unpaid) → assignee + client (only after staff vet, Phase 4) → template notice_due_t3 variant → daily; dedupe predeposit:{matter_id}:{step}
schema_changes: CREATE TABLE gst_matter_deadlines (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('reply_due','ph_date','appeal_limitation','appeal_condonable_limit','rectification_s161','gstat_limitation','revocation_reg21','rfd08_reply','drc22a_objection','pre_deposit_due','spl02_payment','internal_target','other')), basis_section text, computed_from date, due_on date NOT NULL, is_statutory boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, is_met boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, met_on date, notes text, created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matter_deadlines (due_on) WHERE NOT is_met;
CREATE FUNCTION gst_seed_statutory_deadlines(p_matter_id uuid) RETURNS int;

CREATE TABLE gst_hearings (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, scheduled_on timestamptz NOT NULL, venue text, officer text, mode text CHECK (mode IN ('physical','video','written')), attended_by uuid, counsel_id uuid, outcome text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled' CHECK (outcome IN ('scheduled','held','adjourned_by_dept','adjourned_by_us','ex_parte','cancelled')), adjourned_to timestamptz, adjournment_count int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, notes text, created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_hearings (scheduled_on) WHERE outcome = 'scheduled';

CREATE TABLE gst_recovery_actions (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, form text NOT NULL CHECK (form IN ('DRC-07A','DRC-13','DRC-16','DRC-22','DRC-22A','DRC-23')), issued_on date, addressed_to text, amount numeric, objection_due date, stay_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (stay_status IN ('none','deemed_s107_7','court_stay')), stay_reference text, released_on date, notes text);

epics.name: E3.3 Demand ledger, DRC-03 linkage, documents in a private bucket, audit trail, approvals
items: gst_demand_lines per matter × document_stage × FY × act × head with demanded/admitted/disputed (generated)/paid; trigger maintains gst_notices.amount_of_demand and gst_matters.exposure_amount; parse dmddtls/pymtdtls from gst_case_folder_items.raw_json at sync (extension + a DB-side backfill) so DRC-01/DRC-07 amounts populate without typing; 'Pre-deposit paid' badge computed from linked DRC-03s with payment_purpose pre_deposit_*; auto-suggest DRC-03 → matter links by scn_reference / period. Findings: 'Demand is a single number', 'DRC-03 payments are not linkable', 'Pre-deposit ... not linked to any notice'.

Documents: private bucket litigation-docs, gst_documents table (doc_type, storage_path, sha256, source portal/manual, uploaded_by, portal_doc_id, folder_section), migration of existing pdf_url / attachments / documents jsonb rows into it (objects moved from return-pdfs on a background job, never re-uploaded via x-upsert - re-captures write a new versioned path), multi-file upload in the drawer Documents tab ('Firm documents': reply draft, reply filed, annexure, order, appeal memo, hearing notes, client communication), 'Download paper book (zip)' edge function, orphans report on Settings. Findings: 'No document repository', 'No staff-side document store', 'Scanned notice/order PDFs are never deleted, leaving orphaned evidence', 'Documents are scattered across five storage prefixes'.

Audit trail: gst_matter_activity (table_name, row_id, action, changed_fields, old/new jsonb, actor_id, actor_source) fed by log_gst_row_change() triggers on gst_notices, gst_matters, gst_drc03_filings, gst_refund_applications, gst_matter_deadlines, gst_hearings, gst_demand_lines; actor from current_setting('app.user_id', true) set by a tiny RPC set_app_user(user_id, name) the app calls after login and the extension passes via run context; History drawer with Restore (superadmin/gst_manager) mirroring the 2B versions flow. Findings: 'No audit trail of who changed what on a notice', 'No history/snapshot or restore', 'No actor is recorded on any sync write'.

Approvals: gst_matter_approvals (subject reply_draft / appeal_grounds / close_matter / settle_amnesty, requested_by, approver, decision, comments); permission keys review_litigation and approve_litigation_filing; closing a matter or marking 'Reply filed' on an appeal-forum matter requires an approved record; 'Awaiting my approval' queue tab and digest section. Finding: 'No partner review / approval workflow'.

Masters: gst_counsels and tax_authorities with clients.gst_range/division/commissionerate copied from gst_taxpayer_profile on sync; counsel and authority shown on the matter header and hearing record. Findings: 'No counsel/advocate, authority or forum details', 'Authority is a free-text issued_by'.
acceptance_criteria: For a known DRC-01 case the Demand & Payments tab shows proposed → confirmed → paid → balance per FY and head, with the DRC-03 ARN linked; the 'Demand under dispute ₹' tile changes when a line is edited.

A PDF uploaded as 'Reply filed' is stored under litigation-docs/<client>/<matter>/<uuid>.pdf, opens through a 5-minute signed URL, and appears in the paper book zip; the old return-pdfs object for a migrated notice is no longer referenced by any row.
Editing amount_of_demand writes a gst_matter_activity row with old/new values and the actor's name; Restore brings back the previous value and writes its own row.
An employee with review_litigation but not approve_litigation_filing can request but not grant approval; closing a matter without an approved close_matter record is refused with a clear message.
email_events: approval.requested (gst_matter_approvals inserted) → approver's profiles.email; cc team_emails → template notice_assigned variant 'approval_requested' → within 15 min; dedupe approval:{approval_id}:requested
approval.decided → requester's email → template 'approval_decided' → within 15 min; dedupe approval:{approval_id}:decided
schema_changes: CREATE TABLE gst_demand_lines (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, document_stage text NOT NULL CHECK (document_stage IN ('drc01a','drc01','drc07','apl04','gstat_order','hc_order','other')), financial_year text, act text NOT NULL CHECK (act IN ('CGST','SGST','IGST','CESS')), head text NOT NULL CHECK (head IN ('tax','interest','penalty','late_fee','other')), demanded numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, admitted numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, disputed numeric GENERATED ALWAYS AS (demanded - admitted) STORED, paid numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed' CHECK (status IN ('proposed','confirmed','dropped','set_aside','remanded')), UNIQUE (matter_id, document_stage, financial_year, act, head));
INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public) VALUES ('litigation-docs','litigation-docs', false) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

CREATE TABLE gst_documents (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, drc03_id uuid REFERENCES gst_drc03_filings(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, refund_id uuid REFERENCES gst_refund_applications(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, doc_type text NOT NULL CHECK (doc_type IN ('notice','intimation','reply_draft','reply_filed','annexure','order','apl01','apl02','apl04','hearing_notes','drc03','refund_doc','client_communication','working','precedent','other')), title text NOT NULL, storage_bucket text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'litigation-docs', storage_path text NOT NULL, mime_type text, size_bytes bigint, sha256 text, portal_doc_id text, folder_section text, version int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, client_visible boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, filed_on_portal boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, portal_ref text, source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'portal' CHECK (source IN ('portal','manual')), uploaded_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (storage_bucket, storage_path)); CREATE INDEX ON gst_documents (matter_id);

CREATE FUNCTION set_app_user(p_user_id uuid, p_name text) RETURNS void; CREATE FUNCTION log_gst_row_change() RETURNS trigger; CREATE TRIGGER trg_gst_notices_audit AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON gst_notices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION log_gst_row_change(); (same on gst_matters, gst_drc03_filings, gst_refund_applications, gst_matter_deadlines, gst_hearings, gst_demand_lines)
