phases.name: Phase 4 - Refunds & DRC-03 done properly, partner MIS, client-facing communication, reply templates
phases.goal: By week 17 refunds and DRC-03 are first-class matters with rupee KPIs and deadlines, partners get a Monday summary and a /litigation/mis page, clients receive vetted intimations and a monthly statement and can see their own matters, and staff draft replies from templates inside the ERP.

epics.name: E4.1 Canonical refund / DRC-03 case model with amounts, stages and workflow
items: Promote captured folder JSON into typed columns: gst_drc03_filings gains cause_code, cause_text, scn_reference, scn_date, payment_ref, period_from/to, cash/credit split per head, and a backfill from gst_case_folder_items.raw_json.vp.pysum for the 126 VP cases with no dedicated row; gst_refund_applications gains sanctioned_amount / rejected_amount / order_date from RFD-05/06 items, period_from/to, application_status, rfd04_provisional, bank_account_masked, reason_code + shared label map (EXPWP/EXPWOP/ITC → labels; ITC vs Cash mapping fixed), claimed_amount NULL when absent. Findings: 'sanctioned_amount is hard-coded null', 'DRC-03 drill-down shows Rs 0 for 130 of 183 rows', 'DRC-03 cause-of-payment code, period and SCN linkage are discarded', 'Refund claim period ... have no columns', 'Refund Claimed From Cash Ledger report can never return rows', 'claimed_amount is 0 for 10 of 37 rows'.

Derived case_state (open / replied / sanctioned / disbursed / rejected / withdrawn / deficiency / acknowledged) computed in a Postgres view v_refund_drc03_cases from the latest folder event per case, with staff_status as override; every page (Notice Summary, AllClientsRefundsPage, AllClientsDrc03Page, CompanyProfilePage, AdditionalNoticeFolderPage) reads it; refund stages added to the matter stage machine (filed, acknowledged_rfd02, deficiency_rfd03, scn_rfd08, reply_rfd09, order_rfd06, payment_rfd05, recredit_pmt03, withdrawn) fed at sync; RFD-08 due and s.54(1) two-year re-file limitation seeded into gst_matter_deadlines. Findings: 'Three different definitions of closed for the same refund case', 'Refund lifecycle stages ... are not modelled', 'Case-stub merge mislabels columns'.

Staff workflow columns (staff_status, priority, assigned_to, remarks, reply_date, next_action_date) on both dedicated tables; replied derived from REPLY folder items. Finding: 'No staff workflow fields on refund or DRC-03 rows'.

Rupee KPIs on the dashboard and /litigation/mis: Refunds pending ₹, Sanctioned not disbursed ₹, DRC-03 paid this FY (cash/credit), Interest & penalty paid; documents popover per row and ARN link to the case folder; skip re-download of existing PDFs in the extension. Findings: 'No rupee KPIs', 'Only the first captured document is reachable', 'Every DRC-03 sync re-downloads and re-uploads all PDFs'.

Run a one-off firm-wide notices_bundle sync in Company List batches per the SOP so the dedicated tables are populated for all credentialed clients; per-step client_sync_log rows make refunds/DRC-03 failures visible. Finding: 'Sync All bundle has never populated Refund/DRC-03 tables firm-wide'.
acceptance_criteria: Notice Summary DRC 03 row shows Open = count of case_state in (open, replied) only (expected ~36 on the audit data), Refund Open excludes sanctioned/disbursed/rejected cases; totals reconcile across the three pages.
AllClientsDrc03Page TOTAL row is within 1% of the Rs 6.46 Cr the folder JSON holds; the refund report shows Rs 7.72 Cr sanctioned instead of 0.
An RFD-08 with a 15-day window appears in 'Due in 7 days' on day 8 and in the ladder emails; a deficiency memo creates a 'fresh application by <s.54 limit>' deadline.
The refund-type report returns rows for EXPWOP as ITC and EXPWP as Cash.
email_events: refund.deficiency / refund.rejected / refund.sanctioned (case_state transition) → assignee + team_emails → template order_received variant 'refund_event' → within 15 min; dedupe refund.state:{arn}:{state}
drc03.acknowledged (DRC-04) → assignee → folded into daily digest; dedupe drc03.ack:{arn}
schema_changes: ALTER TABLE gst_drc03_filings ADD COLUMN cause_code text, ADD COLUMN cause_text text, ADD COLUMN scn_reference text, ADD COLUMN scn_date date, ADD COLUMN payment_ref text, ADD COLUMN period_from date, ADD COLUMN period_to date, ADD COLUMN igst_cash numeric, ADD COLUMN igst_credit numeric, ADD COLUMN cgst_cash numeric, ADD COLUMN cgst_credit numeric, ADD COLUMN sgst_cash numeric, ADD COLUMN sgst_credit numeric, ADD COLUMN cess_cash numeric, ADD COLUMN cess_credit numeric, ADD COLUMN staff_status text, ADD COLUMN priority text, ADD COLUMN assigned_to uuid, ADD COLUMN remarks text, ADD COLUMN reply_date date, ADD COLUMN next_action_date date, ADD COLUMN case_state text;

ALTER TABLE gst_refund_applications ADD COLUMN sanctioned_amount_computed numeric, ADD COLUMN rejected_amount numeric, ADD COLUMN order_date date, ADD COLUMN order_form text, ADD COLUMN period_from date, ADD COLUMN period_to date, ADD COLUMN application_status text, ADD COLUMN rfd04_provisional boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN bank_account_masked text, ADD COLUMN reason_code text, ADD COLUMN staff_status text, ADD COLUMN priority text, ADD COLUMN assigned_to uuid, ADD COLUMN remarks text, ADD COLUMN reply_date date, ADD COLUMN next_action_date date, ADD COLUMN case_state text; ALTER TABLE gst_refund_applications ALTER COLUMN claimed_amount DROP NOT NULL;
CREATE VIEW v_refund_drc03_cases AS ... latest folder event per (client_id, case_id) with derived case_state ...;

CREATE TABLE refund_reason_labels (code text PRIMARY KEY, label text NOT NULL, ledger text NOT NULL CHECK (ledger IN ('ITC','Cash'))); INSERT ... ('EXPWOP','Export without payment of tax','ITC'), ('EXPWP','Export with payment of tax','Cash'), ...;
CREATE INDEX idx_gst_refund_status ON gst_refund_applications (client_id, status); CREATE INDEX idx_gst_drc03_fy ON gst_drc03_filings (client_id, financial_year);

epics.name: E4.2 Partner MIS, weekly summary, status reports
items: /litigation/mis page over view v_litigation_mis (gst_matters + gst_demand_lines + gst_matter_deadlines + gst_hearings): ageing since issue and since last action (0-30/31-90/91-180/180+), exposure heat-map client × FY, by section and by authority, stage funnel SCN → reply → order → appeal, outcome statistics, average days to reply, upcoming limitation list, staff workload; Excel via renderReportToExcel; Report dropdown gains Ageing, Staff Workload, Demand Exposure by Client (contingent-liability schedule), Stage/Outcome, Per-client Litigation Statement. Findings: 'MIS absent', 'MIS reports limited to two', 'No demand-at-risk / amount-exposure view'.

Edge function partner-weekly-summary, pg_cron 30 3 * * 1 (Monday 09:00 IST): computeNoticeSummary ported to supabase/functions/_shared/noticeSummary.ts, ageing buckets, exposure, per-staff open counts, week-over-week deltas, limitation list for the next 30 days; template partner_weekly_summary; monthly variant attaches the MIS PDF. Finding: 'No daily digest to the GST team and no weekly portfolio summary to partners'.

src/utils/noticeStatusPdfExport.ts (jsPDF + autoTable + drawFirmLogo): per-client litigation register (ref, type, section, issue, due, stage, owner, reply/order, demand, next action) with open/closed header; 'Print status report' on CompanyProfilePage and in the drawer; firm-wide partner pack grouped by client. Finding: 'No per-client Notice Status Report PDF'.
acceptance_criteria: Monday 09:00 IST the partners receive one email whose numbers match /litigation/mis for the same instant; a second run the same week is deduped.
Demand Exposure by Client sums to the 'Demand under dispute' tile and lists DRC-03 pre-deposits per matter.
The per-client status PDF renders on the firm letterhead with page numbers and matches the client's Company Profile counts.
email_events: digest.weekly → partner_emails → template partner_weekly_summary (category counts, ageing, exposure, staff workload, limitation next 30 days, WoW deltas) → Monday 09:00 IST; dedupe digest:weekly:{iso-week}
mis.monthly → partner_emails; cc gst_manager → template partner_weekly_summary variant with MIS PDF attached → 1st of month 09:00 IST; dedupe digest:monthly:{yyyy-mm}
schema_changes: CREATE VIEW v_litigation_mis AS SELECT m.*, (current_date - m.opened_at) AS age_days, ... sum(d.disputed) ... next deadline ... FROM gst_matters m LEFT JOIN gst_demand_lines d ... GROUP BY m.id;
CREATE VIEW gst_matter_fee_summary AS SELECT matter_id, sum(quoted) quoted, sum(billed) billed, sum(collected) collected FROM gst_matter_fees GROUP BY matter_id;
SELECT cron.schedule('gst-partner-weekly-summary', '30 3 * * 1', ...); SELECT cron.schedule('gst-mis-monthly', '30 3 1 * *', ...);

epics.name: E4.3 Client communication and client portal view; fees and counsel
items: 'Notify client' action in the drawer/list: preview dialog with an editable per-category document checklist (from noticeCategoryClassifier), inserts email_outbox {kind client_notice, to clients.email, cc team_emails, attachments [notice PDF], notice_id, dedupe client_notice:{notice_id}:{n}}, sets client_notified_at, writes gst_matter_communications; gated by notify_client; never automatic. Findings: 'No client-facing notice received email', 'Clients cannot see their notices and there is no one-click notify client'.

gst_matter_communications (channel, direction, counterparty, email_outbox_id, subject, summary, occurred_at, follow_up_on) with auto-insert trigger when an outbox row with matter_id/notice_id is sent; 'Log call / WhatsApp' from the Correspondence tab; 'awaiting client docs for N days' in the digest. Finding: 'No communications log tying emails/calls/WhatsApp to a notice'.

Client route /my-notices (CLIENT_NAV_ITEMS + ClientDashboard tile): read-only NoticeWorkflowListView for the session's client_id (type, ref, issue/due, stage, our reply date, hearing date, client_visible documents via signed URL; amount_of_demand/remarks/assign hidden), 'upload requested document' into gst_documents with doc_type client_communication. Finding: 'Client role has no notice visibility at all'.

Monthly client_matter_statement email (template + PDF via noticeStatusPdfExport) for clients with open matters, opt-in per client (clients.notice_statement_enabled), sent from the same cron as the MIS. Finding: 'No client-facing status report or portal view of their matters'.

gst_matter_fees (fee_type professional / counsel / court_fee / disbursement, quoted, billed, collected, invoice_ref) and optional gst_matter_time_entries; Fees tab; 'Unbilled litigation work' report; gst_matter_counsels link with brief_sent_on. Findings: 'No fees/billing hook per matter', 'Counsel / external advocate management does not exist'.
acceptance_criteria: A staff member with notify_client sends an intimation: the client receives the email with the PDF, the Emails tab and Correspondence tab show it, and a second click warns 'already notified on <date>' before sending again.
A client login sees only its own notices at /my-notices, cannot open another client's id in the URL, and can download only client_visible documents.
The monthly statement is produced only for opted-in clients with at least one open matter and is deduped per client per month.
The Fees tab totals appear in the MIS 'Unbilled litigation work' report.
email_events: client.notice_intimation (manual, staff-vetted) → clients.email; cc team_emails → template client_notice_intimation (notice, due date, document checklist, data_by_date) → immediate on send; dedupe client_notice:{notice_id}:{n}

client.matter_statement (opt-in clients with open matters) → clients.email; cc team_emails → template client_matter_statement with PDF → 1st of month 09:00 IST; dedupe client_statement:{client_id}:{yyyy-mm}

client.docs_reminder (awaiting_client_docs stage > 7 days) → clients.email (staff-vetted first time, then automatic weekly if enabled); cc assignee → template client_notice_intimation variant 'docs_pending' → weekly; dedupe client_docs:{matter_id}:{iso-week}
schema_changes: CREATE TABLE gst_matter_communications (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, client_id uuid, channel text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('email','phone','whatsapp','meeting','portal','letter')), direction text NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('outbound','inbound')), counterparty text NOT NULL CHECK (counterparty IN ('client','department','counsel','internal')), email_outbox_id uuid REFERENCES email_outbox(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, subject text, summary text, occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), logged_by uuid, follow_up_on date);

ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN client_notified_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN client_notified_by uuid; ALTER TABLE clients ADD COLUMN notice_statement_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN notice_alerts_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true;

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_fees (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, fee_type text NOT NULL CHECK (fee_type IN ('professional','counsel','pre_deposit_funding','court_fee','disbursement','other')), stage text, description text, quoted numeric, billed numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, collected numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, billed_on date, invoice_ref text, counsel_id uuid REFERENCES gst_counsels(id), created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_counsels (matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, counsel_id uuid REFERENCES gst_counsels(id), role text, brief_sent_on date, fee_agreed numeric, fee_paid numeric, notes text, PRIMARY KEY (matter_id, counsel_id));

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_time_entries (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id uuid NOT NULL, minutes int NOT NULL, work_date date NOT NULL, note text);

epics.name: E4.4 Reply templates and precedent library (drafts only)
items: notice_reply_templates (matter_type, stage, notice_form ASMT-10 / DRC-01A / DRC-01 / REG-17 / RFD-08 / APL-01 grounds, section, title, body_md, merge_fields) editable from Settings mirroring the editable_email_messages pattern; 'Draft reply' in the workspace renders merge fields into a .docx (existing docx tooling) saved as gst_documents doc_type reply_draft version n; partner approval via gst_matter_approvals; 'Mark filed' captures ARN/date, sets stage reply_filed, marks reply_due met. Findings: 'No reply templates or AI-assisted reply drafting', 'No reply-drafting workspace, templates or precedent library'.
Precedent search: gst_documents doc_type precedent tagged by section/issue/outcome; full-text index on extracted PDF text (edge function extract-pdf-text on upload) for search from the workspace.
Phase-later option flagged, not built: draft-notice-reply edge function calling Claude with the PDF text - output always a versioned draft behind approval.
acceptance_criteria: Drafting a reply for an ASMT-10 produces a .docx with the client name, GSTIN, reference and dates filled, stored as version 1; editing and re-saving produces version 2 and keeps version 1.
'Mark filed' is refused until an approved reply_draft approval exists for that matter; on success the reply_due deadline is met and the ladder stops.
Searching 'ITC 16(4)' in precedents returns tagged documents ranked by outcome.
schema_changes: CREATE TABLE notice_reply_templates (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_type text, stage text, notice_form text, section text, title text NOT NULL, body_md text NOT NULL, merge_fields text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, updated_by uuid, updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now());

ALTER TABLE gst_documents ADD COLUMN extracted_text text, ADD COLUMN text_tsv tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('english', coalesce(extracted_text,''))) STORED; CREATE INDEX ON gst_documents USING gin (text_tsv);

phases.name: Phase 5 - Keep it running: unattended sync, retention & recovery, hardening, WhatsApp adapter
phases.goal: By week 20 the data is fresh without a human solving 92 CAPTCHAs, nothing litigation-related can be deleted without a trace or a legal-hold check, backups are documented and drilled, sensitive writes are behind server-side checks, and the outbox is ready for a WhatsApp channel.

epics.name: E5.1 Unattended / assisted sync via the agent
items: agent/src/handlers.ts: PULL_NOTICES_BUNDLE job calling the same JSON endpoints the extension proved (services/auth/api/get/notices, litserv case/task/get, case/folder, case/search RFUND/ADJVP) via page.request with the saved portal_sessions cookie, then upsert_portal_notices / refunds / drc03 / folder items and per-step client_sync_log with run_id; fix claimNextJob with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED RPC. Finding: 'No unattended/headless notice sync exists'.

Dashboard 'Agent' panel in the sync strip: portal_agent_heartbeat status, 'Queue nightly sync' toggle inserting portal_jobs for every credentialed, active client whose session is fresh, a needs_human inbox (CAPTCHA image from human_prompt) so staff answer only expired sessions; pg_cron enqueue at 02:00 IST; 'Retry failed' button on Company List scoped to failed clients. Findings: 'No sync-run summary or completion signal', 'No retry ... retry failed clients path'.

Extension respects clients.inactive_at_hand; enumerate further caseTypeCd values (APL, ADT, recovery, registration) into matter events; typed manual-entry forms per matter_type (Appeal, Recovery, E-way bill MOV, Summons, SPL-01/02) replacing the generic AddNoticeDialog for those types. Findings: 'Sync All ignores the Company List Active/Inactive flag', 'Lifecycle capture gaps: appeals, GSTAT, recovery...'.

Firm decision recorded in docs/NOTICES_LITIGATION_FLOW.md §Legal/risk before any solver is enabled; portal_jobs writes moved behind enqueue_portal_job RPC checking a staff session; portal_sessions.expires_at with nightly purge; key-rotation runbook in agent/README.md. Finding: 'portal_jobs is writable by the anon key ... portal_sessions cookies never expire'.
acceptance_criteria: A nightly run over all active credentialed clients completes with at most the expired-session clients waiting in needs_human; the morning digest's 'New since yesterday' section reflects it at 08:30 IST.
client_sync_status.last_success_at is < 24 h for >= 90% of active credentialed clients on a normal night.
An anon-key INSERT into portal_jobs is refused; enqueue_portal_job from a staff session succeeds.
Inactive clients are skipped by Sync All and by the nightly enqueue.
email_events: sync.run_completed (sync_runs.finished_at set, clients_failed > 0 or new_notices > 0) → team_emails → template sync_failed variant 'sync_run_summary' → immediate; dedupe sync.run:{run_id}
schema_changes: ALTER TABLE portal_sessions ADD COLUMN expires_at timestamptz; SELECT cron.schedule('gst-purge-portal-sessions', '0 20 * * *', $$ DELETE FROM portal_sessions WHERE expires_at < now() $$);

CREATE FUNCTION enqueue_portal_job(p_client_id uuid, p_job_type text, p_mode text, p_payload jsonb, p_session_token text) RETURNS uuid SECURITY DEFINER; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE ON portal_jobs FROM anon;
CREATE FUNCTION claim_next_portal_job(p_runner text) RETURNS portal_jobs SECURITY DEFINER; -- FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT cron.schedule('gst-enqueue-nightly-notice-sync', '30 20 * * *', ...); -- 02:00 IST

epics.name: E5.2 Retention, legal hold, soft delete, backup & recovery
items: clients.deleted_at/deleted_by/delete_reason soft delete; client FKs on the litigation tables switched to ON DELETE RESTRICT; BEFORE DELETE trigger on clients writing audit_log with per-table counts; delete confirm shows counts and requires typing the GSTIN, 'Mark inactive at hand' as the primary action. Findings: 'Client delete cascades through all litigation tables', 'Delete confirm dialogs give no counts'.

gst_litigation_history (table_name, row_id, client_id, op, old_row jsonb, actor, reason) with BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE triggers on gst_notices, gst_refund_applications, gst_drc03_filings, gst_case_folder_items, gst_matters, gst_documents, no client FK, append-only RLS; History/Restore UI already from Phase 3 reads it. Finding: 'No history/snapshot or restore'.

retention_until (annual-return due date for the FY + 72 months) and legal_hold on gst_notices / refunds / DRC-03 / matters; trigger sets legal_hold while open/replied/appealed; hard deletes raise while legal_hold or now() < retention_until; 'Records on hold' count on the dashboard and a disposal register for superadmin. Finding: 'No retention policy or legal-hold concept (s.36 CGST)'.

Split DELETE out of the FOR ALL policies on the litigation tables; app deletes go through SECURITY DEFINER RPCs (delete_notice, delete_document) that validate a staff session token returned by authenticate_staff and stored alongside vjdesai_user; route UserControlPage.handleSave through grant_permission RPC; encrypt clients.gst_password with pgsodium into client_portal_credentials (RLS on, no policies) exposed via get_client_portal_credentials(client_id, token) used by extension and agent, then drop the plaintext column. Findings: 'Any holder of the anon key can delete litigation rows', 'clients.gst_password stored in plaintext', 'Every UI gate can be bypassed with the anon key'.

docs/BACKUP_AND_RECOVERY.md: enable PITR (>= 7 days) on gcquafqxbykxkbexcdpy, nightly pg_dump of the litigation tables + litigation-docs mirror to the firm's Drive via a cron edge function, quarterly restore drill log, 'Last backup' indicator on Settings; accepted-risk register entry for open RLS. Finding: 'No backup, PITR or recovery procedure is documented or tested'.
acceptance_criteria: Deleting a client with notices is refused at the DB level; marking it inactive hides it everywhere and keeps its matters queryable via the disposal register.
Bulk-closing 20 notices then Restore on one of them returns its previous status and writes both the close and the restore to gst_litigation_history with actor names.
An anon-key DELETE on gst_notices returns 403/0 rows; delete_notice RPC with a valid staff token and delete_notice permission succeeds and is logged.
SELECT gst_password FROM clients with the anon key errors (column gone); the extension still logs in using get_client_portal_credentials.
A restore drill from PITR to a scratch project is documented with date, operator and duration.
email_events: retention.disposal_due (rows past retention_until with no legal_hold) → partner_emails → template partner_weekly_summary section 'Disposal register' → monthly; dedupe retention:{yyyy-mm}
schema_changes: ALTER TABLE clients ADD COLUMN deleted_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN deleted_by uuid, ADD COLUMN delete_reason text;

risks: Extension rollout: the manifest/host fix, upsert RPC and per-step logging all require every staff PC to re-load the unpacked extension; until the version check (E0.3) ships, an old build can still call the deleted replaceNotices path. Mitigation: keep the old REST endpoints working for one release but make them no-ops that log 'outdated extension' to client_sync_log, and show the update banner.

Live-data cleanup before unique indexes: the audit found 0 duplicate (client_id, reference_number) pairs but 55 legitimate multi-task (client_id, case_id) pairs and duplicate ARNs on refunds; the partial index on case_id must only apply where reference_number IS NULL, and the refund/DRC-03 dedupe must keep the row with documents/pdf_url, not min(created_at) blindly. Verify counts on gcquafqxbykxkbexcdpy before applying; never touch SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF's project.

Redefining Open/Overdue will make the tiles drop from 1060/473 to much smaller numbers overnight; the principal must be told in advance (positions doc §Tile definitions, CONFIRM-WITH-FIRM items) or the change will read as data loss. Keep the 'Documents' count toggle and the baseline fixture as the audit trail of the change.

Email fatigue: a per-notice ladder over 92 GSTINs plus a digest can flood the team inbox in week one. Mitigations: batch notice.new per client per run, cap overdue repeats (overdue_max), respect quiet hours, and give the principal the firm_alert_settings card before enabling the ladder; start with the digest only for one week.

Public-bucket cutover: flipping return-pdfs private breaks every stored absolute URL until the path-strip migration and signedPdf helper land together; deploy them in one release and keep a fallback that strips the prefix at read time for any row missed.

Open RLS remains the design: until Phase 5's session-token RPCs, every gate is client-side; do not send client-facing emails with document links before Phase 0's bucket fix, and record the accepted-risk register entry so the firm has made the decision knowingly.

Statutory rules encoded in litigationLimitation.ts (3 months + 1 condonable for APL-01, 6 months s.161, 15 days RFD-08, 7 days DRC-22A, s.128A windows) are the firm's professional positions; they must be reviewed by a partner and pinned by tests, and the doc must carry the section references and the date confirmed.

Portal-side drift: the folder JSON keys used for due/hearing dates (duedt, sdtls.*.duedt, dmddtls, pysum) were reverse-engineered live; a portal change silently zeroes the derived fields. Log unknown shapes to client_sync_log and keep the raw_json so a re-extract is always possible.

Matter auto-grouping heuristics (orphan notices grouped by client + section + FY + officer) will mis-group some disputes; ship 'Link to matter' / 'Split' actions with the backfill and let staff correct in the workspace rather than aiming for a perfect algorithm.

No test runner exists today and npm run build is the only gate; the vitest introduction is small but the team must run it (add to the pre-commit habit in CLAUDE.md), otherwise the KPI fixture provides no protection.

CAPTCHA / GSTN terms: the nightly agent sync depends on a written firm decision (human CAPTCHA only vs solver) that is a principal-level legal call; Phase 5 E5.1 cannot start without it, and the fastcaptcha.org host permission should be removed unless approved.

Estimate risk: roughly 145 person-days across 20 weeks assumes one developer working with Claude Code plus the principal available for weekly position sign-offs; Phases 3-4 are the widest and can be re-cut per epic if the email and dashboard phases already deliver the workflow value.
kpis_to_track: Data integrity after sync: count of non-null staff_status / assigned_to / reply_date before vs after every Sync All (must be equal); zero rows with description LIKE 'PULL FAILED%'; zero duplicate portal keys.
Reconciliation: dashboard 'Needs action' tile = drill-down row count; Notice Summary grand total = GSTIN-wise grand total (checked by the SQL smoke script on every release).
Freshness: % of active credentialed clients with client_sync_status.last_success_at < 24 h (target 90% after Phase 5; < 7 days after Phase 1) and number of clients never synced (target 0).
Time to awareness: median minutes from first_seen_at of a new notice to the notice_new email sent_at (target < 15 min) and to first_viewed_at by a staff member (target < 4 working hours).
Ownership: % of open notices with assigned_to set (target 100% within 2 working days of first_seen_at); unassigned-and-due-within-7-days count on the dashboard (target 0).

Deadline discipline: overdue actionable notices (target trending to < 5% of open); statutory deadlines met on time in gst_matter_deadlines (target 100% for appeal_limitation, rfd08_reply, drc22a_objection); hearings marked ex_parte (target 0).
Reply throughput: median days from first_seen_at to reply_date per category and per owner; 'Awaiting reply' column trend week over week.
Exposure: total disputed demand ₹ (gst_demand_lines.disputed on open matters), pre-deposit paid vs required on appeal_filed matters, refunds pending ₹ and sanctioned-not-disbursed ₹.
Outcomes: matters closed per month by outcome (dropped / confirmed / partly / set aside / remanded), win rate by section and forum from /litigation/mis.
Email health: outbox rows by kind and status per day, send failures (target < 1%), duplicates prevented by dedupe_key (should be > 0 and stable), digest open/click via the deep-link route hits.
Sync health: sync_runs per week, clients_failed per run, login failures per client (repeat failures flag credential problems), runs aborted by the idle timeout (target 0).
Security posture: unauthenticated PDF fetch attempts returning 403 (all), credential_access_log reveals per week, zero anon-key DELETEs on litigation tables, backup drill date < 90 days old.

Adoption: daily active staff on /notices/:id drawer actions, approvals turned around in < 2 working days, client intimations sent per new SCN (target 100% within 3 working days), client /my-notices logins per month.

roadmap_drafts.angle: Platform and data-model first. The dashboard's numbers are wrong today for one structural reason: the extension's Sync All deletes and re-inserts every gst_notices row per client (extension/background.js:102-105 `replaceNotices: ... await del('gst_notices', client_id=eq.X); return post('gst_notices', rows)`), so staff status, priority, assignee, reply/order data and manually added notices are wiped on every pull, "Last 24 Hours" (NoticesDashboardPage.tsx:254 `daysAgo(r.pulled_at) <= 1`) measures sync activity, and Open = Total = 1060. Repainting tiles over that write path would produce a prettier wrong page. This plan therefore (Phase 0) stops the data loss and the security holes that would otherwise leak into every alert email, (Phase 1) lays the matter / stage / deadline / hearing / demand / document / activity schema and migrates the existing 1060 rows onto it with one canonical case view, (Phase 2) builds the event → notification engine on the existing email_outbox / send-gst-email / pg_cron pipeline so "every important matter is emailed to the GST team" is a property of the data model, not of any page, and only then (Phase 3) rebuilds the Notices Dashboard as a work queue that reads from RPCs over that model, (Phase 4) adds the litigation ERP pages (matter workspace, deadlines engine, hearings, demand and payments, approvals, MIS, client statement) on the same tables, and (Phase 5) hardens sync, retention and credentials. The visible start is slower (first redesigned screen lands around week 9) but every page is built once on the right model and every KPI is pinned by a fixture before it changes.
guiding_principles: Fix the write path before the read path: no dashboard work ships until gst_notices is upserted on a natural key and staff columns survive a sync (finding 'Every Sync All wipes staff workflow data and manually added notices').

One canonical unit of work: a Matter (gst_matters) groups the SCN, reminders, order, appeal, DRC-03 payments and case-folder items of one dispute; tiles, summary, queue, MIS and emails all count matters or actionable notices from the same SQL view, never from per-page JavaScript filters (findings 'KPI tiles and Notice Summary use different definitions of a notice', 'three different totals on one screen').

Actionable, not raw: Open / Overdue / Due-soon are computed from effective due date (extended_due_date ?? due_date, local-midnight compare), stage, reply evidence (REPLY folder items) and portal closure signals (ORDRS/CLOSR), with staff_status as an explicit override (findings 'Over Due counts Closed and Replied notices', 'DRC 03 Open 167 counts 131 acknowledged payments').

Events drive everything: every insert/update on the litigation tables emits a gst_notice_events row via trigger; emails, in-app bell, activity timeline and 'new since last sync' are consumers of that stream, never separate polling logic.

Reuse the existing email plumbing (email_outbox, email_templates, send-gst-email via Microsoft Graph from gst@vjdesai.com, pg_cron pattern in 20260726130000_gst_email_cron.sql); widen it with dedupe_key, cc/bcc, attachments and new kinds rather than building a second queue.

Emails to the team are automatic; emails to clients are always staff-vetted (preview dialog, permission notify_client) and never carry a raw storage URL - PDFs go through a private bucket and short-lived signed URLs.

Additive migrations only, applied to project gcquafqxbykxkbexcdpy with a matching file under supabase/migrations/; every new table gets `FOR ALL TO public USING (true) WITH CHECK (true)` per CLAUDE.md, destructive operations move behind SECURITY DEFINER RPCs that take the app user id.

Pin before you change: computeNoticeKpis / classifyNoticeCategory / computeNoticeSummary are extracted into pure functions and locked with a vitest fixture asserting today's 1060/3/64/92/1060/0/473/0 so each redefinition is a deliberate, reviewed diff (finding 'No test harness; KPI and category definitions are unpinned').
Keep every existing route working; new pages are added, old pages are re-pointed at the new views/RPCs, and NoticesTopNav/Sidebar gain the new entries.

Write the positions down: docs/NOTICES_LITIGATION_FLOW.md and a CLAUDE.md section are Phase 0 deliverables, and every elected position changed later is recorded there with its tag (KEEP / CONFIRM-WITH-FIRM / REPLACE).

Design-system compliance: text-sm body, text-xs captions, text-lg section titles, text-3xl tabular-nums KPI values, 12-column gap-6 grid, semantic tokens only, aria-labels on every icon button, per docs/UI-UX-REDESIGN.md.
roadmap_drafts.target_dashboard_layout:
Route stays /notices-dashboard (title becomes "Notices & Litigation"). Everything below reads from two RPCs built in Phase 1/3 (notice_dashboard_stats(filters) and notice_action_queue(tab, filters, limit)) through one useQuery with staleTime 60s; no page-level fetchAllRows.

ABOVE THE FOLD (1920x1080 with sidebar open)

Section 1 - PageHeader + sync-health strip (full width). Title "Notices & Litigation"; subtitle built from v_client_sync_status: "Portal data as of 13 Sep 10:42 · 92 GSTINs with matters / 121 onboarded · 13 never synced · 1 failed last attempt" with each count a Link to /notices-company-list?status=…. Actions right: [Sync All] primary (three-state extension chip: not desktop Chrome → hidden with hint; Chrome but no bridge reply within 1.5 s → Alert with install link and current origin; ready → version shown, disabled if below MIN_EXTENSION_VERSION), [Add Notice], [Export] (gated by export_notices). When a sync_runs row is open, a slim progress strip appears under the header via Supabase Realtime: "Syncing 12/92 · 2 failed · started 10:12 by Priya · Retry failed".

Section 2 - Filter bar (sticky, full width): Financial year, Client (searchable), Owner (staff picker, default "Me" for employees), Matter type / Category, Stage, Forum, Date range, and the existing Registration/Other toggle. Values propagate through drillParams so tiles, queue, summary, charts and agenda all honour them; active filters render as chips with an X. The top-nav pill group is replaced by an underline Tabs row (Overview | Notices | Submissions | Refunds | DRC-03 | Matters | Reports) whose active state derives from useLocation (fixes 'NoticesTopNav shows Dashboard as active on every page').

Section 3 - KPI row, six tiles (col-span-2 each in a 12-column grid, gap-6): Needs action (actionable open matters); Overdue (destructive, actionable and effective due < today); Due in 7 days (warning, today..today+7 inclusive); Hearings / limitation ≤30 days (from gst_matter_deadlines + gst_hearings); Unassigned (info, assigned_to IS NULL and actionable); Demand under dispute ₹ (sum of gst_demand_lines.disputed on open matters, lakh/crore formatting). Each tile: label text-xs muted, value text-3xl tabular-nums, 7-day delta caption from gst_notice_events, 30-day sparkline, whole tile a focusable Link with focus-visible ring. Total notices / GSTIN count move to the header subtitle; Failed Logins becomes "Sync failures" in the health strip.

Section 4 - Action queue (col-span-8) beside By-category (col-span-4). Action queue is a real table of matters/notices, tabs: Overdue · Due 7 days · Hearings this week · Limitation ≤30d · Unassigned · High priority · New since last sync · Awaiting my approval. Columns: Client (GSTIN + trade name), Category/stage chip, Description (truncate, title tooltip), Due (date + "x days" Badge red/amber, honours extended_due_date), Owner (inline staff Select), Amount ₹, Priority chip, row actions (open drawer, log reply, assign, notify client). Max 10 rows; footer "View all N" to /notices-all with the same filter. Rows open the NoticeDrawer (Sheet, 560px) without leaving the page. By-category card: Notice Summary sorted by Open desc, real rows only; placeholders behind a "Show uncaptured categories (n)" toggle with a 'not captured' Badge; per-row inline Open/Total bar; columns Total · Needs action · Awaiting reply · Closed · ₹ disputed; clicking a category adds a filter chip (no navigation); card grows to content, no fixed 620px.

BELOW THE FOLD

Section 5 - Three chart cards (col-span-4 each, recharts via src/components/ui/chart.tsx, dataviz palette rules): (a) Ageing of open matters 0-7 / 8-30 / 31-90 / 90+ days stacked by category, bars clickable to /notices-all?age=…; (b) Issued vs closed per month, trailing 12 months (bar + line) from gst_notice_events; (c) Workload by owner (horizontal bars: open, overdue, due 7d per staff member). All fed by notice_dashboard_stats.

Section 6 - Clients needing attention (col-span-8) beside This-week agenda (col-span-4). Clients card: top 8 clients ranked by overdue then open, columns GSTIN, Trade name, Open, Overdue, ₹ disputed, Last successful sync (red clock if >7 days or never), Owner; replaces the current "5 most recently created clients" Company card - Add Company / Import / Download Template move to /notices-company-list. Agenda: 7-day list (today first) of reply-due, hearing, statutory-limitation and issue events with counts and first two client names, each row linking to the filtered list; a "Month" toggle restores a grid using 4px dot markers (bg-destructive / bg-warning / bg-info / purple for hearing) under a text-foreground digit, never white-on-pastel; markers computed from the same filtered actionable set as the tiles, with aria-label "13 September 2026, 2 replies due, 1 hearing".

Section 7 - Activity since last visit (full width, collapsible): a feed from gst_notice_events (new notices, due-date changes, orders received, status changes, emails sent) with "Mark all read" tied to staff_notifications; a NotificationBell in MainLayout header shows the unread count everywhere.

States and responsiveness: Skeleton tiles/rows while loading; Alert variant=destructive with Retry when any RPC errors (fetchAllRows/RPC return {data,error}); TableEmptyState with icon for empty queues; 'No companies yet.' flash removed. Tiles 6 → 3 → 2 columns at lg/md/sm; queue and category stack below 1280px; charts stack below 1024px; below md the summary renders as a stacked list and the queue as card rows; any table lives in its own overflow-x-auto. Every icon-only button has an aria-label; clickable cells are <Link> elements, not onClick on <td>. Sidebar 'Notices Dashboard' stays active on all /notices-*, /refunds-all, /drc03-all, /litigation/* routes via activePrefixes.

phases.name: Phase 1 - Litigation data model and migration of existing rows
phases.goal: Introduce the Matter as the unit of work with stage, deadlines, hearings, demand lines, documents, notes, assignments and a trigger-fed activity/event stream; migrate all 1060 gst_notices rows, 37 refunds, 53 DRC-03s and the case folders onto it; expose one canonical SQL view and the RPCs every later page will read.

epics.name: E1.1 Core matter schema
items: Migration 20260928100000_gst_matters.sql creating gst_matters, gst_matter_stage_history, gst_matter_deadlines, gst_hearings, gst_demand_lines, gst_matter_notes, gst_counsels, gst_matter_fees, all with open RLS and indexes (findings 'No matter/case entity', 'No stage/status state machine', 'No statutory limitation dates', 'No hearings/adjournments table', 'Demand is a single number', 'No notes/comments thread', 'No counsel/advocate, authority or forum details', 'No fees/billing hook per matter').

gst_notices gains matter_id, assigned_to uuid, assigned_by, assigned_at, status_changed_at/by, hearing_date (denormalised from gst_hearings for list views), section_of_law text[], financial_years text[], client_notified_at, deleted_at/deleted_by (soft delete); staff_status gets a CHECK on ('Open','Closed','Replied','On Hold') after normalising existing values (findings 'assign_to is free text, not a user FK', 'Section of law and financial year are free text', 'No way to delete a wrongly added notice').

gst_drc03_filings gains matter_id, notice_id, payment_purpose, cause_code, cause_text, scn_reference, scn_date, period_from/to, linked_by/at; gst_refund_applications gains matter_id, period_from/to, application_status, rfd04_provisional, sanctioned/rejected amounts populated from RFD-05/06 folder items, plus the staff workflow columns (staff_status, priority, assigned_to, remarks, reply_date, next_action_date) (findings 'DRC-03 payments are not linkable to the notice/matter', 'DRC-03 cause-of-payment code, period and SCN linkage are discarded', 'sanctioned_amount is hard-coded null', 'No staff workflow fields on refund or DRC-03 rows').

gst_case_folder_items gains notice_id FK (ON DELETE CASCADE) and matter_id; SQL function gst_extract_folder_dates() fills issue_date/due_date/item_type from raw_json for NOTCE/INTIM/ORDRS/REPLY/NOTAC/APLCN shapes (finding 'gst_case_folder_items has no FK to the notice').

tax_authorities master + gst_matters.authority_id, jurisdiction; clients gains gst_range/gst_division/gst_commissionerate copied from gst_taxpayer_profile on sync (finding 'Authority is a free-text issued_by').

Retention columns: retention_until (FY annual-return due + 72 months) and legal_hold on the four litigation tables, set automatically when a matter is open (finding 'No retention policy or legal-hold concept').
Regenerate src/integrations/supabase/types.ts.

Inserting a gst_matters row with stage 'appeal_filed' via the anon key succeeds; an invalid stage is rejected by the CHECK.
npm run build passes with regenerated types.
schema_changes: CREATE TABLE gst_matters (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, matter_no text UNIQUE, title text NOT NULL, matter_type text NOT NULL CHECK (matter_type IN ('scn_demand_s73','scn_demand_s74','scrutiny_asmt10','audit','refund','registration','eway_bill','non_filer','rectification','recovery','appeal','gstat','high_court','supreme_court','amnesty_128a','summons','itc_mismatch_drc01b','other')), forum text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proper_officer' CHECK (forum IN ('proper_officer','appellate_authority','gstat','high_court','supreme_court')), stage text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new' CHECK (stage IN ('new','under_review','awaiting_client_docs','reply_drafted','reply_filed','ph_scheduled','order_awaited','order_received','rectification_filed','appeal_filed','gstat_filed','closed_dropped','closed_paid','closed_favourable','closed_partly','closed_time_barred')), outcome text CHECK (outcome IN ('dropped','confirmed_full','confirmed_part','set_aside','remanded','withdrawn','appealed','paid_settled','amnesty_128a','time_barred')), financial_years text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', section_of_law text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', period_from date, period_to date, jurisdiction text CHECK (jurisdiction IN ('centre','state')), authority_id uuid, authority_designation text, portal_case_id text, assigned_to uuid, reviewer_id uuid, partner_id uuid, counsel_id uuid, tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', priority text, first_response_due timestamptz, first_responded_at timestamptz, internal_target_date date, opened_at date NOT NULL DEFAULT current_date, closed_at date, closure_reason text, tax_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GST', created_by uuid, updated_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matters (client_id, stage); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matters (assigned_to) WHERE stage NOT LIKE 'closed_%'; CREATE INDEX ON gst_matters USING gin (tags);

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_stage_history (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, from_stage text, to_stage text NOT NULL, changed_by uuid, changed_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), note text);

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_deadlines (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE SET NULL, kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('reply_due','ph_date','appeal_limitation','appeal_condonable_limit','rectification_s161','gstat_limitation','revocation_reg21','rfd08_reply','drc22a_objection','spl02_payment','pre_deposit_due','internal_target','other')), basis_section text, computed_from date, due_on date NOT NULL, is_statutory boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, is_met boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, met_on date, notes text, created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matter_deadlines (due_on) WHERE NOT is_met;

CREATE TABLE gst_hearings (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE SET NULL, scheduled_on timestamptz NOT NULL, venue text, officer text, mode text CHECK (mode IN ('physical','video','written')), attended_by uuid, counsel_id uuid, outcome text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled' CHECK (outcome IN ('scheduled','held','adjourned_by_dept','adjourned_by_us','ex_parte','cancelled')), adjourned_to timestamptz, notes text, created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_hearings (scheduled_on) WHERE outcome = 'scheduled';

CREATE TABLE gst_demand_lines (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE SET NULL, document_stage text NOT NULL CHECK (document_stage IN ('drc01a','drc01','drc07','apl04','gstat_order','hc_order','other')), financial_year text, act text NOT NULL CHECK (act IN ('CGST','SGST','IGST','CESS')), head text NOT NULL CHECK (head IN ('tax','interest','penalty','late_fee','other')), demanded numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, admitted numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, disputed numeric GENERATED ALWAYS AS (demanded - admitted) STORED, paid numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed' CHECK (status IN ('proposed','confirmed','dropped','set_aside','remanded')), UNIQUE (matter_id, document_stage, financial_year, act, head));

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_notes (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE SET NULL, body text NOT NULL, is_pinned boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, author_id uuid NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), edited_at timestamptz);

CREATE TABLE gst_counsels (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name text NOT NULL, firm text, email text, phone text, bar_enrolment_no text, forum_expertise text[], default_fee numeric, is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true); CREATE TABLE gst_matter_counsels (matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, counsel_id uuid REFERENCES gst_counsels, role text, brief_sent_on date, fee_agreed numeric, fee_paid numeric, notes text, PRIMARY KEY (matter_id, counsel_id));

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_fees (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, fee_type text NOT NULL CHECK (fee_type IN ('professional','counsel','pre_deposit_funding','court_fee','disbursement','other')), description text, quoted numeric, billed numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, collected numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, billed_on date, invoice_ref text, counsel_id uuid REFERENCES gst_counsels, created_by uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now());

CREATE TABLE tax_authorities (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), administration text NOT NULL CHECK (administration IN ('CGST','SGST','DGGI','Appellate','GSTAT','HC','SC')), designation text, office_name text, commissionerate text, division text, range text, state text, email text, address text);

ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN assigned_to uuid, ADD COLUMN assigned_by uuid, ADD COLUMN assigned_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN status_changed_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN status_changed_by uuid, ADD COLUMN hearing_date date, ADD COLUMN section_of_law text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', ADD COLUMN financial_years text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', ADD COLUMN client_notified_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN first_viewed_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN first_viewed_by uuid, ADD COLUMN deleted_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN deleted_by uuid, ADD COLUMN retention_until date, ADD COLUMN legal_hold boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false; CREATE INDEX ON gst_notices (matter_id); CREATE INDEX ON gst_notices (assigned_to) WHERE staff_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Closed'; CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_due ON gst_notices (due_date) WHERE staff_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Closed'; CREATE INDEX idx_gst_notices_case ON gst_notices (client_id, case_id) WHERE case_id IS NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE gst_notices ADD CONSTRAINT gst_notices_staff_status_check CHECK (staff_status IS NULL OR staff_status IN ('Open','Closed','Replied','On Hold'));

ALTER TABLE gst_drc03_filings ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN payment_purpose text CHECK (payment_purpose IN ('voluntary_s73_5','voluntary_s74_5','against_scn','against_order','pre_deposit_s107','pre_deposit_s112','annual_return','audit','other')), ADD COLUMN cause_code text, ADD COLUMN cause_text text, ADD COLUMN scn_reference text, ADD COLUMN scn_date date, ADD COLUMN period_from date, ADD COLUMN period_to date, ADD COLUMN payment_ref text, ADD COLUMN linked_by uuid, ADD COLUMN linked_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN staff_status text, ADD COLUMN assigned_to uuid, ADD COLUMN remarks text; CREATE INDEX ON gst_drc03_filings (matter_id);

ALTER TABLE gst_refund_applications ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN period_from date, ADD COLUMN period_to date, ADD COLUMN application_status text, ADD COLUMN rfd04_provisional boolean, ADD COLUMN rejected_amount numeric, ADD COLUMN order_date date, ADD COLUMN reason_code text, ADD COLUMN staff_status text, ADD COLUMN priority text, ADD COLUMN assigned_to uuid, ADD COLUMN remarks text, ADD COLUMN reply_date date, ADD COLUMN next_action_date date; ALTER TABLE gst_refund_applications ALTER COLUMN claimed_amount DROP NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE gst_case_folder_items ADD COLUMN notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ADD COLUMN matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN section_ref text; CREATE INDEX ON gst_case_folder_items (notice_id);

ALTER TABLE gst_matters ADD COLUMN authority_id uuid REFERENCES tax_authorities(id); ALTER TABLE clients ADD COLUMN gst_range text, ADD COLUMN gst_division text, ADD COLUMN gst_commissionerate text, ADD COLUMN notice_handler_user_id uuid;

ALTER TABLE gst_refund_applications ADD COLUMN retention_until date, ADD COLUMN legal_hold boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false; ALTER TABLE gst_drc03_filings ADD COLUMN retention_until date, ADD COLUMN legal_hold boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

epics.name: E1.2 Documents, activity/audit and events
items: Migration 20260930100000_gst_documents_activity_events.sql: gst_documents unified repository (private bucket litigation-docs), gst_matter_activity trigger-fed audit trail, gst_litigation_history archive of OLD rows on UPDATE/DELETE, gst_notice_events domain event stream with dedupe_key, gst_matter_communications, staff_notifications (findings 'No document repository', 'No audit trail of who changed what on a notice', 'No history/snapshot or restore', 'No new-vs-updated detection or change log for notices', 'No communications log', 'No in-app notification bell').

Trigger functions: log_gst_row_change() (jsonb diff of OLD/NEW, actor from current_setting('app.user_id', true) set via a tiny RPC set_app_user(user_id, token) the SPA calls after login and before writes; actor_source 'extension'/'agent' passed in by the RPCs) attached to gst_notices, gst_matters, gst_drc03_filings, gst_refund_applications, gst_matter_deadlines, gst_hearings; emit_gst_notice_event() AFTER INSERT (notice.new when origin='portal' and first_seen_at = now()), AFTER UPDATE OF due_date/extended_due_date (notice.due_date_changed), staff_status (notice.status_changed), assigned_to (notice.assigned), pdf_url (notice.pdf_captured), portal_missing_at (notice.missing_from_portal); on gst_matters stage (matter.stage_changed); on gst_hearings insert/update (hearing.scheduled); on gst_matter_deadlines insert (deadline.created); on gst_refund_applications status (refund.status_changed); on gst_drc03_filings insert (drc03.new); on client_sync_log insert WHEN status='failed' (sync.failed).
upsert_portal_notices (Phase 0) extended to pass p_run_id/p_actor into the events and to run emit for genuinely new rows only.

Migrate existing document references into gst_documents: gst_notices.pdf_url, gst_case_folder_items.attachments[], gst_refund_applications.documents[], gst_drc03_filings.pdf_url → one row each with source='portal', portal_doc_id; keep the legacy columns populated for one release; move objects to litigation-docs (or keep return-pdfs private and reference it - decision recorded in the positions doc).
Migrate existing remarks into one gst_matter_notes row each; keep remarks as a headline.

audit_log rows written from: client delete, bulk status/priority changes, per-row status change, AddNoticeDialog insert, sync RPC (module 'notices', action 'portal_sync') (finding 'audit_log is the only append-only table and is not used for any notice or client event').
acceptance_criteria: Updating staff_status on a notice via the anon key produces one gst_matter_activity row with changed_fields = ['staff_status'], the actor id, and one gst_notice_events row kind 'notice.status_changed' with a unique dedupe_key.
A second sync of the same client emits zero notice.new events; adding one notice on the portal (or a fixture row) emits exactly one.
Every existing PDF is reachable from gst_documents (count of gst_documents rows = 734 notice PDFs + 879 folder attachments + refund/DRC-03 docs, within 1%).
Deleting a gst_notices row leaves a gst_litigation_history row with its full old_row.
schema_changes: INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public) VALUES ('litigation-docs','litigation-docs', false) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

CREATE TABLE gst_documents (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES clients ON DELETE RESTRICT, matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE SET NULL, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE SET NULL, drc03_id uuid REFERENCES gst_drc03_filings ON DELETE SET NULL, refund_id uuid REFERENCES gst_refund_applications ON DELETE SET NULL, doc_type text NOT NULL CHECK (doc_type IN ('notice','intimation','reply_draft','reply_filed','annexure','order','apl01','apl02','apl04','hearing_notes','drc03','refund_doc','working','precedent','client_communication','other')), title text NOT NULL, version int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, storage_bucket text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'litigation-docs', storage_path text NOT NULL, mime_type text, size_bytes bigint, sha256 text, portal_doc_id text, folder_section text, client_visible boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, filed_on_portal boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, portal_ref text, uploaded_by uuid, source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'portal' CHECK (source IN ('portal','manual')), created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (storage_bucket, storage_path)); CREATE INDEX ON gst_documents (matter_id); CREATE INDEX ON gst_documents (notice_id);

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_activity (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, matter_id uuid, notice_id uuid, client_id uuid, table_name text NOT NULL, row_id uuid NOT NULL, action text NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('insert','update','delete','sync')), changed_fields text[], old_values jsonb, new_values jsonb, actor_id uuid, actor_name text, actor_source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'app' CHECK (actor_source IN ('app','extension','agent','system')), created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matter_activity (matter_id, created_at DESC); CREATE INDEX ON gst_matter_activity (notice_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE gst_litigation_history (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, table_name text NOT NULL, row_id uuid NOT NULL, client_id uuid, op text NOT NULL CHECK (op IN ('UPDATE','DELETE','SYNC_DELETE')), old_row jsonb NOT NULL, actor text, reason text, changed_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); -- no client FK; RLS SELECT+INSERT only

CREATE TABLE gst_notice_events (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), client_id uuid, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE CASCADE, matter_id uuid REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, event_kind text NOT NULL CHECK (event_kind IN ('notice.new','notice.due_date_changed','notice.status_changed','notice.assigned','notice.pdf_captured','notice.missing_from_portal','matter.stage_changed','deadline.created','deadline.due','deadline.overdue','hearing.scheduled','hearing.upcoming','refund.status_changed','drc03.new','order.received','sync.failed','email.sent')), payload jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', old_value jsonb, new_value jsonb, sync_run_id uuid, actor_id uuid, occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), processed_at timestamptz, dedupe_key text UNIQUE); CREATE INDEX ON gst_notice_events (processed_at) WHERE processed_at IS NULL; CREATE INDEX ON gst_notice_events (occurred_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE gst_matter_communications (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), matter_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gst_matters ON DELETE CASCADE, notice_id uuid REFERENCES gst_notices ON DELETE SET NULL, channel text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('email','phone','whatsapp','meeting','portal','letter')), direction text NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('outbound','inbound')), counterparty text NOT NULL CHECK (counterparty IN ('client','department','counsel','internal')), email_outbox_id uuid REFERENCES email_outbox(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, subject text, summary text, occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), logged_by uuid, follow_up_on date);

CREATE TABLE staff_notifications (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid, kind text NOT NULL, title text NOT NULL, body text, link text, notice_id uuid, matter_id uuid, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), read_by uuid[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}');
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_app_user(p_user_id uuid, p_token text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER; -- validates app_sessions then set_config('app.user_id', ...)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_gst_row_change() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql; CREATE TRIGGER trg_gst_notices_audit AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON gst_notices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION log_gst_row_change(); -- same trigger on gst_matters, gst_drc03_filings, gst_refund_applications, gst_matter_deadlines, gst_hearings

epics.name: E1.3 Backfill: build matters from existing rows
items: SQL script (in migration 20261002100000_gst_matters_backfill.sql, idempotent): one gst_matters row per (client_id, case_id) where case_id IS NOT NULL (matter_type from CASE_NOTICE_TYPE_MAP equivalents: Determination Of Tax → scn_demand_s73, Scrutiny Of Returns → scrutiny_asmt10, Refunds → refund, Voluntary Payment → linked as payment not matter, Enforcement Case → other/enforcement, Rectification Of Orders → rectification, Pre-Gst Recovery → recovery, Waiver Scheme U/S 128a → amnesty_128a, Letter Of Undertaking → registration/informational), one per orphan notice (grouped by client_id + reference_number family), refund matters from gst_refund_applications by ARN, DRC-03 rows linked to the matter whose case_id/scn_reference matches, else to a 'voluntary payment' matter per client per FY (findings 'Documents of one dispute are not chained', 'REFUTED duplicates claim; the real duplication is tasks-per-case').

Stage derivation: from latest gst_case_folder_items per case (ORDRS/CLOSR → order_received/closed_*, REPLY → reply_filed, NOTCE with no REPLY → new, APLCN → refund filed); informational types (LUT, RFD-11 ack, Registration Certificate) get stage closed_dropped with outcome null and a non_actionable flag; staff_status overrides where set (findings 'Open (1060/1060) and Over Due (473) are inflated', 'Refund lifecycle stages are not modelled', 'CONFIRMED: Open Notices equals Total Notices').

gst_seed_statutory_deadlines(matter_id) SQL function: reply_due from notice due_date/folder duedt; appeal_limitation = order_date + 3 months and appeal_condonable_limit = + 4 months (s.107); rectification_s161 = order_date + 6 months; gstat_limitation = apl04 date + 3 months (s.112); rfd08_reply = RFD-08 issue + 15 days; revocation_reg21 = cancellation order + 90 days; drc22a_objection = DRC-22 + 7 days; run for every backfilled matter (findings 'No statutory limitation dates', 'RFD-08 reply due dates are captured but dropped').

Hearings back-fill from the 35 hearing dates present in gst_case_folder_items.raw_json; demand lines back-fill from dmddtls/pymtdtls and vp.pysum in raw_json (Rs 6.46 Cr DRC-03 detail, Rs 7.72 Cr sanctioned refunds) (findings 'DRC-03 drill-down shows Rs 0 for 130 of 183 rows', 'Demand vs paid ledger per matter is impossible').
assigned_to back-fill: UPDATE gst_notices n SET assigned_to = p.user_id FROM profiles p WHERE lower(trim(n.assign_to)) = lower(p.first_name); log unmatched names.

Source normalisation: source CHECK ('notices','additional_notices','manual'); UPDATE case rows to 'additional_notices'; content.js writes 'additional_notices' for task rows; readers use .in('source', [...]) (finding 'gst_notices.source semantics are inconsistent').

Extension task loop and RPC create/attach matters going forward: upsert_portal_notices resolves matter_id by (client_id, case_id) and creates the matter when absent, and calls gst_seed_statutory_deadlines.
acceptance_criteria: Every gst_notices row has a matter_id; count(distinct matter_id) ≈ 863 plain notices + 180 cases (documented in the positions doc with the reconciliation '1060 rows = N notices in M matters').

Notice Summary computed on matters shows DRC 03 open ≤ 40 (from 167) and Refund open ≤ 20 (from 41) and each difference is explainable by the stage derivation rule; the principal signs off the derived numbers for 10 sampled matters against the portal.
Every order_received matter has an appeal_limitation deadline; every open RFD-08 has an rfd08_reply deadline; the backfill script is re-runnable without creating duplicates.

ALTER TABLE gst_matters ADD COLUMN non_actionable boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

epics.name: E1.4 Canonical read model: views and RPCs
items: VIEW v_notice_cases: one row per matter with client, category (classifyNoticeCategory ported to SQL or a matter_category column maintained by trigger), stage, effective_due (min unmet deadline due_on, else coalesce(extended_due_date, due_date)), next_hearing, next_statutory_deadline, is_actionable (stage not closed and not non_actionable and no reply evidence), is_overdue (is_actionable and effective_due < current_date), due_in_7d, assigned_to, priority, disputed_amount (sum gst_demand_lines.disputed), paid_amount, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, last_event_at (findings 'KPI tiles and Notice Summary use different definitions of a notice', 'Three different definitions of closed for the same refund case').

VIEW v_client_sync_status (client_id, last_success_at, last_attempt_at, last_status, last_message, extension_version, is_stale_7d, never_synced) reading client_sync_log level='outcome' AND action='notices' (finding 'Last successful sync time per client / data freshness is not shown').
VIEW gst_notice_counts_by_client and gst_notice_category_counts over v_notice_cases (finding 'GSTIN-wise Notice Count silently truncates at 1000 rows').

RPC notice_dashboard_stats(p_fy text, p_client uuid, p_owner uuid, p_category text, p_stage text, p_from date, p_to date) RETURNS jsonb: tile counts with 7-day deltas, category rows, ageing buckets, issued-vs-closed 12 months, workload by owner, top-8 clients, 7-day agenda, sync health.
RPC notice_action_queue(p_tab text, filters..., p_limit int, p_offset int) RETURNS SETOF v_notice_cases plus total count.

RPC update_notice_status(p_ids uuid[], p_status text, p_reason text, p_user uuid, p_token text), assign_notice(...), delete_notice(...), set_matter_stage(...), log_reply(...), log_order(...), log_hearing(...) SECURITY DEFINER, validating app_sessions and the permission keys server-side (findings 'Every UI gate on the notices surface can be bypassed with the anon key', 'Closing/reopening a notice needs no reason').

Re-point existing readers (NoticesDashboardPage, AllClientsNoticesPage, NoticeSummaryReportPage, GstinWiseNoticeCountPage, CompanyProfilePage, AllClientsRefundsPage, AllClientsDrc03Page, noticeRefundDrc03Reports.ts) at the views so the old pages already show corrected numbers before the redesign; 'Additional Notices and Orders' report repointed at gst_case_folder_items joined to gst_notices (finding 'Additional Notices and Orders per-client report is a dead end').
Fixture tests updated to the new definitions with the explicit before/after table in the PR.
acceptance_criteria: SELECT count(*) FROM v_notice_cases WHERE is_overdue reproduces the dashboard Overdue tile, the AllClientsNoticesPage overdue filter and the Notice Summary overdue column exactly.
notice_dashboard_stats returns in under 300 ms on the live dataset (EXPLAIN ANALYZE recorded in the PR).
GSTIN-wise, Notice Summary and the dashboard tile show the same grand total.
A direct anon-key UPDATE of gst_notices.staff_status still works (open RLS) but the app only calls update_notice_status; a call with an invalid token is rejected.
schema_changes: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_notice_cases AS SELECT ... FROM gst_matters m JOIN clients c ... LEFT JOIN LATERAL (deadlines) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (hearings) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (demand) ...;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_client_sync_status AS SELECT DISTINCT ON (client_id) ... FROM client_sync_log WHERE level='outcome' AND action='notices' ORDER BY client_id, created_at DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW gst_notice_counts_by_client AS SELECT client_id, count(*) total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_actionable) open, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_overdue) overdue, count(*) FILTER (WHERE replied) replied, sum(disputed_amount) disputed FROM v_notice_cases GROUP BY client_id;

phases.name: Phase 2 - Event → notification engine (email the GST team about every important matter)
phases.goal: Turn the gst_notice_events stream into emails and in-app notifications through the existing outbox and Microsoft Graph sender: immediate alerts for new notices, orders and sync failures; a T-7/T-3/T-1/T0/overdue ladder per assignee; hearing and limitation reminders; a daily team digest and a weekly partner summary; a staff-vetted client intimation.

epics.name: E2.1 Outbox and template plumbing for notice kinds
items: Migration 20261012100000_email_outbox_notice_alerts.sql: widen email_outbox (nullable client_id, new kinds, cc/bcc arrays, attachments jsonb, dedupe_key with partial unique index, notice_id/matter_id/event_id, audience, not_before, channel, to_phone) and email_templates (same kind list, audience, variables text[]) (findings 'email_outbox schema physically blocks team alerts', 'No idempotency key for alerts', 'Email pipeline cannot carry a notice').

firm_alert_settings single-row table editable from a new 'Notice alerts' card on RemindersPage (team_emails default {gst@vjdesai.com}, partner_emails, ladder_days {7,3,1,0}, overdue_repeat_days 3, overdue_max 5, first_response_hours 48, digest_time 08:30 IST, weekly_day Monday, quiet hours, digest_enabled, weekly_enabled) and staff_notification_prefs per user (finding 'Single recipient only - no cc/bcc, no team distribution list', 'No per-recipient preferences, quiet hours or opt-out').

Seed email_templates rows (editable via the existing EmailTemplatesEditor): notice_new, notice_due_t7, notice_due_t3, notice_due_t1, notice_due_today, notice_overdue, notice_assigned, notice_hearing, notice_appeal_limitation, order_received, refund_action_required, sync_failed, notice_digest_daily, partner_weekly_summary, client_notice_intimation, client_matter_statement; variables listed per template.

supabase/functions/send-gst-email/index.ts: map cc_emails/bcc_emails to ccRecipients/bccRecipients; attachments from litigation-docs via service key as base64 fileAttachment under Graph's 3 MB inline limit (else '(PDF too large - open in app)'); honour not_before; select the new columns; on status='sent' insert gst_matter_communications and gst_notice_events kind email.sent (findings 'Sender cannot attach the notice PDF', 'No communications log').

supabase/functions/_shared/email.ts and src/lib/emailTemplate.ts: shell entries per kind (navy 'New notice', amber→red due ladder, red 'Overdue', purple 'Hearing', grey 'Sync failed', table-per-section digest shell, gold client audience); detail rows from vars.detail_rows JSON (finding 'Outbox UI and email shell are hard-wired to return/period semantics').
RemindersPage: KIND_META for all kinds, 'Regarding' column (client + reference or 'Firm digest'), Kind filter tabs, Recipients column, 'Send queued now' for notice kinds.
Email links always point to app routes (/notices/:id, /litigation/matters/:id, /notices/:id/pdf redeeming a signed URL) - never to storage.
acceptance_criteria: INSERT into email_outbox with kind='notice_new', client_id NULL, cc_emails 2 addresses and one attachment sends through send-gst-email and arrives at gst@vjdesai.com with the PDF attached and both cc's.
Inserting the same dedupe_key twice raises a unique violation; the functions use ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
RemindersPage lists the notice email with the correct kind badge and recipients; the template editor previews notice_new with sample variables.
schema_changes: ALTER TABLE email_outbox ALTER COLUMN client_id DROP NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE email_outbox DROP CONSTRAINT email_outbox_kind_check; ALTER TABLE email_outbox ADD CONSTRAINT email_outbox_kind_check CHECK (kind IN ('reminder','confirmation','builder_setup','builder_fsi','builder_cancellation','builder_agreement_confirm','notice_new','notice_due','notice_overdue','notice_assigned','notice_hearing','notice_limitation','order_received','refund_action','sync_failed','notice_digest','partner_weekly','client_notice','client_matter_statement'));

epics.name: E2.2 Event processors and reminder ladders (edge functions + pg_cron)
items: supabase/functions/notify-notice-events/index.ts: reads gst_notice_events WHERE processed_at IS NULL, groups by client and kind, renders the template, inserts email_outbox + staff_notifications, sets processed_at, then invokes send-gst-email immediately for urgent kinds; pg_cron every 15 min using the vault-anon-key http_post pattern from 20260726130000_gst_email_cron.sql; also callable by the extension after upsert_portal_notices returns inserted > 0 so the email goes out within seconds of the CAPTCHA run (findings 'No new notice landed event or email', 'Failed portal logins are recorded but nobody is told', 'Assignment is a free-text field, so an assignee can never be notified').

supabase/functions/queue-notice-reminders/index.ts at 03:30 UTC daily (09:00 IST): due ladder over v_notice_cases (actionable, effective_due), hearing pass over gst_hearings, limitation pass over gst_matter_deadlines (appeal_limitation T-15/T-7/T-1, rfd08_reply T-7/T-3/T-1, others T-7/T-1), first-response escalation when a matter has no first_viewed_at within first_response_hours; recipients resolved from assigned_to → profiles.email, fallback team list, cc gst_manager from T-1, cc partners once overdue; quiet hours via not_before (findings 'No due-date escalation ladder for notices', 'No hearing-date, appeal-limitation or order-received reminders').

supabase/functions/notice-daily-digest/index.ts at 03:00 UTC Mon-Sat (08:30 IST): sections New since yesterday, Due in 7 days, Overdue by ₹ desc, Unassigned, Hearings this week, Limitation ≤30 days, Awaiting approval, Failed syncs, Not synced 7+ days, Refund deficiency/rejection, DRC-03 filed 24h; skip when every section is empty; dedupe digest:daily:{date} (finding 'No daily digest to the GST team and no weekly portfolio summary to partners').

supabase/functions/partner-weekly-summary/index.ts Monday 03:30 UTC: computeNoticeSummary ported to _shared/noticeSummary.ts plus ageing buckets, disputed exposure by client/FY/forum, per-staff open/overdue, week-over-week deltas, outcomes.
Migration 20261014100000_gst_notice_alert_cron.sql registering the four cron jobs; backstop send cron changed to */10 * * * *.
NotificationBell component in MainLayout header: unread badge from staff_notifications via postgres_changes, dropdown linking to /notices/:id, mark all read (finding 'No in-app notification bell').
docs/NOTICES_LITIGATION_FLOW.md §Alerts: the event → recipient → template → schedule matrix and how to change it from RemindersPage.
acceptance_criteria: Sync a client with one new portal notice: within 15 minutes (or seconds via the extension callback) gst@vjdesai.com receives notice_new with the PDF attached, and the bell shows 1 unread for every staff user; a second sync sends nothing.

A notice due in 3 days assigned to an employee: at 09:00 IST the employee receives notice_due_t3, the team list is cc'd, RemindersPage shows the row with dedupe_key notice.due:{id}:3; re-running the function sends nothing.
The daily digest arrives Mon-Sat at 08:30 IST ± 5 min with correct section counts matching the dashboard tiles at that moment; the weekly summary arrives Monday with ageing and exposure tables.
A forced login failure produces exactly one sync_failed email per client per day.
A client_notice email can only be queued from the preview dialog by a user holding notify_client; it never contains a storage URL.
schema_changes: SELECT cron.schedule('gst-notify-notice-events', '*/15 * * * *', $$ ... http_post(.../functions/v1/notify-notice-events ...) $$);
SELECT cron.schedule('gst-queue-notice-reminders-daily', '30 3 * * *', $$ ... $$);
SELECT cron.schedule('gst-notice-daily-digest', '0 3 * * 1-6', $$ ... $$);
SELECT cron.schedule('gst-partner-weekly-summary', '30 3 * * 1', $$ ... $$);
SELECT cron.unschedule('gst-send-email-hourly'); SELECT cron.schedule('gst-send-email-10min', '*/10 * * * *', $$ ... $$);
email_events: notice.new (first time a (client, reference_number) is seen; origin portal or manual) → firm_alert_settings.team_emails + assigned_to email if set, in-app bell to all staff → template notice_new with PDF attached, vars client_name, gstin, notice_type, reference_number, issue_date, due_date, amount, issued_by, app_url → immediate (15-min poller, or seconds via extension callback); dedupe notice.new:{notice_id}

notice.due T-7 / T-3 / T-1 / T0 (actionable, effective_due = extended_due_date ?? deadline due_on ?? due_date) → assignee (fallback team list), cc gst_manager users from T-1 → templates notice_due_t7 / t3 / t1 / today → daily 09:00 IST; dedupe notice.due:{notice_id}:{step}

notice.overdue (actionable and effective_due < today, every 3 days up to 5 sends) → assignee + team list, cc partner_emails → template notice_overdue → daily 09:00 IST; dedupe notice.due:{notice_id}:overdue:{n}

hearing.upcoming T-3 / T-1 / T0 (gst_hearings outcome scheduled) → assignee + partner_emails + counsel email if set → template notice_hearing (with venue, mode, officer, .ics attachment) → daily 09:00 IST; dedupe hearing:{hearing_id}:{step}

deadline.due for statutory kinds (appeal_limitation T-15/T-7/T-1, gstat_limitation T-15/T-7/T-1, rfd08_reply T-7/T-3/T-1, rectification_s161 T-15/T-1, revocation_reg21 T-15/T-7/T-1, drc22a_objection T-3/T-1, spl02_payment T-15/T-7/T-1) while is_met = false → assignee + team list + partner_emails → template notice_limitation → daily 09:00 IST; dedupe deadline:{deadline_id}:{step}

notice.assigned (assigned_to changes to a non-null user) → the assignee's profiles.email, cc team list, in-app bell to assignee → template notice_assigned → immediate; dedupe notice.assigned:{notice_id}:{assigned_at}

order.received (matter stage → order_received, or ORDRS/DRC-07 folder item captured) → team list + assignee + partner_emails → template order_received with 'appeal by {appeal_limitation}' → immediate; dedupe order:{matter_id}:{order_ref}
refund.status_changed to deficiency memo / RFD-08 / rejection / PMT-03 → team list + assignee → template refund_action → immediate; other refund statuses fold into the daily digest
drc03.new → folded into the daily digest only (no immediate mail)

matter.first_response_overdue (no first_viewed_at within first_response_hours of notice.new) → gst_manager users, cc team list → template notice_overdue (escalation variant) → hourly check inside notify-notice-events; dedupe escalation:{matter_id}:1
sync.failed (client_sync_log level outcome, status failed) → team list → template sync_failed with message and 'Fix credentials' link → immediate; dedupe sync.failed:{client_id}:{yyyy-mm-dd}

digest.daily → team_emails + every profiles.email with role superadmin/gst_manager (respecting staff_notification_prefs.email_digest) → template notice_digest_daily → Mon-Sat 08:30 IST; dedupe digest:daily:{date}; skipped when empty
digest.weekly → partner_emails → template partner_weekly_summary → Monday 09:00 IST; dedupe digest:weekly:{iso-week}

client.notice_intimation (manual 'Notify client' action, permission notify_client, preview dialog with editable document checklist per category) → clients.email / client_notice_prefs.alert_emails, cc team list → template client_notice_intimation with PDF attached, no storage URL → immediate; dedupe client_notice:{notice_id}:{n}; sets gst_notices.client_notified_at

client.matter_statement (monthly, only for clients with client_notice_prefs.notice_alerts_enabled) → clients.email, cc team list → template client_matter_statement + PDF register → 1st of month 09:00 IST; dedupe statement:{client_id}:{yyyy-mm}

src/hooks/useNoticeDashboard.ts: single useQuery(['notices-dashboard', filters]) staleTime 60s over the two RPCs; Supabase Realtime subscription on sync_runs/gst_notice_events to invalidate and show 'N new' toast (finding 'No sync-run summary or completion signal; the dashboard never refreshes after Sync All').

phases.name: Phase 5 - Sync hardening, retention, credentials and unattended sync
phases.goal: Make the portal sync observable and resilient (per-step logging, run tracking, retries, freshness), protect litigation records against deletion and loss (soft delete, RESTRICT, legal hold, backups), take credentials out of the anon-readable row, and lay the path to a scheduled agent sync with a human CAPTCHA inbox.

epics.name: E5.1 Observable, resilient sync
